definitionEnglish: A condition attached to an agreement.
exampleEnglish: He was released with the proviso that he leave the country.
exampleKurdish: ئەو هاتە ئازادکرن ب وی مەرجی کو وەلات بجهـ بهێلیت.

meaning: پارێزکەر / هاندەر
definition: تشتەکێ کو ببیتە ئەگەرێ تورەییێ یان هاندانا خەلکی بۆ ئاخفتنێ.
definitionEnglish: Causing annoyance, anger, or another strong reaction, especially deliberately.
exampleEnglish: A provocative remark.

meaning: ئازایەتی / زیرەکی
definition: ئازایەتییەکا مەزن د شەڕی دا یان زیرەکییەکا زۆر د بوارەکێ دا.
definitionEnglish: Skill or expertise in a particular activity or field.
exampleEnglish: His prowess as a fisherman.

meaning: ژیر / ب ئاگەهـ
definition: کەسەکێ کو ب ژیری و ب ئاگەهـ کار بکەت بۆ هندێ کو زیانێ نەگەهینیتە خۆ.
definitionEnglish: Acting with or showing care and thought for the future.
exampleEnglish: A prudent decision.

meaning: حەز ل سەر تشتێن خراب / بێ رەوشت
definition: هەبوونا حەزەکا نەدروست بۆ تشتێن پەیوەندیدار ب سێکس یان تشتێن خراب.
definitionEnglish: Having or encouraging an excessive interest in sexual matters.
exampleEnglish: Prurient curiosity.

meaning: زارۆکانە / بێ مانا
definition: رەفتارەکا کو زۆر یا زارۆکانە و بێ مانا بیت بۆ کەسەکێ مەزن.
definitionEnglish: Childishly silly and trivial.
exampleEnglish: Puerile jokes.

meaning: شەڕفرۆش / حەز ب شەڕ
definition: کەسەکێ کو زۆر حەز ب شەڕ و مشتومڕان بکەت و ب ئاسانی تورە ببیت.
definitionEnglish: Eager or quick to argue, quarrel, or fight.
exampleEnglish: His public image was that of a pugnacious politician.
exampleKurdish: وێنەیێ وی یێ گشتی وەک سیاسییەکێ شەڕفرۆش بوو.

meaning: هێز / دەستەڵات
definition: هێز یان دەستەڵاتەکا مەزن.
definitionEnglish: Great power, influence, or prowess.
exampleEnglish: The puissance of the empire.

meaning: جوانی
definition: جوانییەکا زۆر یا جەستەیی.
definitionEnglish: Beauty.
exampleEnglish: A woman of great pulchritude.

meaning: هویرکردن / تێکشکاندن
definition: هویرکردنا تشتەکی بۆ تۆزێ یان تێکشکاندنا تەمام یا دوژمنی.
definitionEnglish: Reduce to fine particles.
exampleEnglish: The rocks were pulverized.

meaning: وردەکاریخواز / ب رێکوپێک
definition: کەسەکێ کو زۆر گرنگیێ ب وردەکارییان و رەفتارێن دروست بدەت.
definitionEnglish: Showing great attention to detail or correct behavior.
exampleEnglish: He was punctilious in providing every amenity for his guests.
exampleKurdish: ئەو زۆر یێ وردەکاریخواز بوو د دابینکردنا هەمی پێدڤییان بۆ مێوانێن خۆ.

meaning: پسپۆڕ / زانا
definition: کەسەکێ کو پسپۆڕ بیت د بوارەکێ تایبەت دا و راییا خۆ بڵاو بکەتەوە.
definitionEnglish: An expert in a particular subject or field who is frequently called on to give opinions about it to the public.
exampleEnglish: A political pundit.

meaning: تیژ / بێهن توند
definition: بێهنەک یان تامەکا زۆر توند و تیژ.
definitionEnglish: Having a sharply strong taste or smell.
exampleEnglish: The pungent smell of onions.

meaning: سزادەر
definition: تشتەکێ کو بۆ سزادانا کەسەکی بهێتە ئەنجامدان.
definitionEnglish: Inflicting or intended as punishment.
exampleEnglish: Punitive measures.

meaning: دزین / برن ب دزی
definition: برنا تشتەکێ کەسەکێ دی ب دزی ڤە.
definitionEnglish: Steal (something).
exampleEnglish: He purloined a copy of the exam.
exampleKurdish: ئەوی کۆپییەکا ئەزموونێ ب دزی ڤە بر.

meaning: بانگەشەکردن / مانا
definition: بانگەشەکرنا تشتەکی کو رەنگە یێ راستی نەبیت، یان مانا گشتی یا تشتەکی.
definitionEnglish: Appear or claim to be or do something, especially falsely; profess.
exampleEnglish: The document purports to be official.
exampleKurdish: بەڵگەنامە بانگەشە دکەت کو یا فەرمی یە.

meaning: ترسنۆک / بێ جورئەت
definition: کەسەکێ کو زۆر یێ ترسنۆک بیت و نەشێت بڕیارێن ب جورئەت بدەت.
definitionEnglish: Showing a lack of courage or determination; timid.
exampleEnglish: A pusillanimous politician.

meaning: گومانلێکراو / وسا دهێتە زانین
definition: تشتەکێ کو خەلک وسا دزانن یێ دروستە بەلێ هێشتا نەهاتییە سەلماندن.
definitionEnglish: Generally considered or reputed to be.
exampleEnglish: The putative father.

meaning: گنیبووی / بێهن خراب
definition: تشتەکێ کو ژبەر مانا زۆر گنیبوو بیت و بێهنەکا خراب ژێ بهێت.
definitionEnglish: (of organic matter) decaying or rotting and emitting a fetid smell.
exampleEnglish: The putrid smell of rotting fish.

meaning: دکتۆرێ درەو / فێڵباز
definition: کەسەکێ کو بانگەشە بکەت یێ زانایە د پزیشکیێ دا بەلێ د راستی دا نە وسا بیت.
definitionEnglish: A person who dishonestly claims to have special knowledge and skill in some field, typically in medicine.
exampleEnglish: A quack doctor.

meaning: ڤەخوارن ب توندی
definition: ڤەخوارنا ڤەخوارنەکێ ب خێرایی و ب بڕەکێ زۆر.
definitionEnglish: Drink (something, especially an alcoholic drink) heartily.
exampleEnglish: To quaff a pint of beer.

meaning: زۆنگاو / رەوشا ب زەحمەت
definition: عەردەکێ نەرم و تەڕ، یان رەوشەکا زۆر ب زەحمەت کو مروڤ نەشێت ب ئاسانی ژێ دەرکەڤیت.
definitionEnglish: A soft boggy area of land that gives way underfoot.
exampleEnglish: A legal quagmire.

meaning: ترسان / پاشەکشەکرن ژ ترسان
definition: نیشادانا ترسا زۆر و پاشەکشەکرن بەرامبەر مەترسییێ.
definitionEnglish: Feel or show fear or apprehension.
exampleEnglish: He quailed at the thought of the exam.

meaning: گومان / هەستکردن ب خەلەتیێ
definition: هەستەکێ نەخۆش د ناخێ مروڤی دا کو کارەکێ خەلەت دکەت.
definitionEnglish: An uneasy feeling of doubt, worry, or fear, especially about one's own conduct; a misgiving.
exampleEnglish: He had no qualms about lying.
exampleKurdish: ئەوی چو گومان نەبوو دەربارەی درەوکردنێ.

meaning: دوودڵی / رەوشا ب زەحمەت
definition: رەوشەکا کو تێدا مروڤ نەزانیت چ بڕیار بدەت.
definitionEnglish: A state of perplexity or uncertainty over what to do in a difficult situation.
exampleEnglish: I'm in a quandary about what to do.
exampleKurdish: ئەز د دوودڵییەکێ دا مە کا دێ چ کەم.

meaning: کەرەنتینە / جوداکردنەوە
definition: جوداکردنەوا کەسەکێ نەخۆش بۆ دەمەکێ دیاریکری بۆ رێگریکردن ل بەڵاڤبوونا نەخۆشییێ.
definitionEnglish: A state, period, or place of isolation in which people or animals that have arrived from elsewhere or been exposed to infectious or contagious disease are placed.
exampleEnglish: The horse was kept in quarantine.
exampleKurdish: هەسپ د کەرەنتینێ دا هاتە گرتن.

meaning: نێچیر / کانزا
definition: گیانەوەرەکێ کو دهێتە راوکرن، یان جهەکێ کو بەرد ژێ دهێنە دەرخستن.
definitionEnglish: An animal pursued by a hunter, hound, predatory mammal, or bird of prey.
exampleEnglish: The hunter pursued his quarry.

meaning: هەڵوەشاندنەوە / تێکشکاندن
definition: هەڵوەشاندنەوا بڕیارەکا فەرمی یان تێکشکاندنا بزاڤەکێ ب هێز.
definitionEnglish: Reject or void, especially by legal procedure.
exampleEnglish: The court quashed the conviction.

meaning: لێڤا دەریا / جهێ کەشتییان
definition: جهەکێ ئاڤاکری ل لێڤا دەریا یان رووباری بۆ هندێ کەشتی لێ بوەستن.
definitionEnglish: A concrete, stone, or metal platform lying alongside or projecting into water for loading and unloading ships.
exampleEnglish: The ship was moored at the quay.
exampleKurdish: کەشتی ل لێڤا دەریا هاتە بەستن.

meaning: دڵ تێکچوون / دڵەڕاوکێ
definition: هەستکردن ب دڵ تێکچوونێ یان هەبوونا دڵەڕاوکێیەکا زۆر دەربارەی تشتەکی.
definitionEnglish: Nauseous; feeling sick.
exampleEnglish: The thought of the exam made him feel queasy.

meaning: کۆنتڕۆڵکردن / ئارامکردنەوە
definition: کۆنتڕۆڵکردنا توندوتیژییەکێ یان ئارامکردنەوا هەستەکێ توند وەک ترسێ.
definitionEnglish: Put an end to (a rebellion or other disorder), typically by the use of force.
exampleEnglish: To quell the riots.

meaning: تێنوویەتی شکاندن / کوژاندنەوە
definition: شکاندنا تێنوویەتییێ ب ڤەخوارنا ئاڤێ یان کوژاندنەوا ئاگرەکی.
definitionEnglish: Satisfy (one's thirst) by drinking.
exampleEnglish: To quench your thirst.

meaning: گازندەکەر / بێزارکەر
definition: کەسەکێ کو زۆر گازندان بکەت و ب دەنگەکێ بێزارکەر باخڤیت.
definitionEnglish: Complaining in a petulant or whining manner.
exampleEnglish: A querulous voice.

meaning: پسیار / گومان
definition: پسیارەک یان گومانەک دەربارەی تشتەکی بۆ هندێ کو راستییێ بزانی.
definitionEnglish: A question, especially one addressed to an official or organization.
exampleEnglish: A query about the bill.

meaning: رێز / سەرە
definition: رێزەکا خەلکی یان ترۆمبێلان کو ل هیڤییا سەرێ خۆ بن.
definitionEnglish: A line or sequence of people or vehicles awaiting their turn to be attended to or to proceed.
exampleEnglish: A long queue for tickets.

meaning: مشتومڕ ل سەر تشتێن بچووک
definition: مشتومڕکردن یان گازندەکرن ل سەر تشتێن زۆر بچووک و بێ مفا.
definitionEnglish: A slight objection or criticism.
exampleEnglish: The only quibble I have is with the price.
exampleKurdish: ب تنێ مشتومڕا من ل سەر بهایی یە.

meaning: بێ دەنگ / نەچالاک
definition: تشتەکێ کو د رەوشەکا بێ دەنگ و نەچالاک دا بیت بۆ دەمەکی.
definitionEnglish: In a state or period of inactivity or dormancy.
exampleEnglish: The volcano is quiescent.

meaning: ئارامی / بێ دەنگی
definition: رەوشەکا ئارام و بێ دەنگ و بێ کێشە.
definitionEnglish: A state of stillness, calmness, and quiet in a person or place.
exampleEnglish: The quietude of the countryside.

meaning: نموونەیا هەرە باش / رەوشا رەسەن
definition: باشترین و رەسەنترین نموونەیا تشتەکی.
definitionEnglish: The most perfect or typical example of a quality or class.
exampleEnglish: He was the quintessence of a gentleman.
exampleKurdish: ئەو نموونەیا هەرە باش یا کەسەکێ رەوشت بەرز بوو.

meaning: گۆتنەکا زیرەکانە و گاڵتەجاڕ
definition: ئاخفتنەکا کورت و زیرەکانە کو بۆ گاڵتەکرنێ دهێتە گۆتن.
definitionEnglish: A witty remark.
exampleEnglish: He ended his speech with a quip.
exampleKurdish: ئەوی ئاخفتنا خۆ ب گۆتنەکا گاڵتەجاڕ ب دوماهی ئینا.

meaning: رەفتارەکا سەیر / رووداوەکا چاڤنەڕێکری
definition: رەفتارەکا سەیر یان تایبەت یا کەسەکی, یان رووداوەکا سەیر.
definitionEnglish: A peculiar behavioral habit.
exampleEnglish: A quirk of fate.

meaning: خاین / جاش
definition: کەسەکێ کو هاریکارییا دوژمنێن وەلاتی بکەت دەمێ هێرشێ دکەنە سەر.
definitionEnglish: A traitor who collaborates with an enemy force occupying their country.
exampleEnglish: He was branded a quisling.

meaning: لەرزین / کیڤەر
definition: لەرزینەکا کورت و خێرا ژبەر ترسێ یان سەرمایێ, یان کیڤەرێ تیران.
definitionEnglish: Tremble or shake with a slight rapid motion.
exampleEnglish: His lip quivered.

meaning: خەیاڵی / نەگونجاو
definition: هزرەک یان پلانەکا کو زۆر یا خەیاڵی بیت و ب زەحمەت د راستیێ دا جێبەجێ ببیت.
definitionEnglish: Exceedingly idealistic; unrealistic and impractical.
exampleEnglish: A quixotic quest.

meaning: سەرسام / پسیارکەر
definition: نیشادانا سەرسامییێ یان پسیارکرنێ ب رێکا رووخسارێ مروڤی.
definitionEnglish: (of a person's expression or behavior) indicating mild or amused puzzlement.
exampleEnglish: A quizzical look.

meaning: رێژەیا یاسایی
definition: کێمترین ژمارەیا ئەندامان کو پێدڤییە ئامادە بن بۆ هندێ بڕیارەکا فەرمی بهێتە دان.
definitionEnglish: The minimum number of members of an assembly or society that must be present at any of its meetings to make the proceedings of that meeting valid.
exampleEnglish: The meeting was cancelled because there was no quorum.
exampleKurdish: کۆبوونەوە هاتە هەڵوەشاندن چونکی رێژەیا یاسایی ئامادە نەبوو.

meaning: رۆژانە / ئاسایی
definition: تشتەکێ کو هەمی رۆژان روودەت و زۆر یێ ئاسایی و بێ تام بووی.
definitionEnglish: Of or occurring every day; daily.
exampleEnglish: Quotidian tasks.

meaning: هار / توندڕەو
definition: گیانەوەرەکێ کو نەخۆشییا هارییێ هەبیت, یان کەسەکێ کو زۆر یێ توندڕەو بیت د باوەرییەکێ دا.
definitionEnglish: Having or proceeding from an extreme or fanatical support of or belief in something.
exampleEnglish: A rabid fan.

meaning: چیرۆکبێژێ زیرەک
definition: کەسەکێ کو زۆر یێ زیرەک بیت د گێڕانا چیرۆکێن خۆش دا.
definitionEnglish: A person who tells anecdotes in a skillful and amusing way.
exampleEnglish: He was a brilliant raconteur.
exampleKurdish: ئەو چیرۆکبێژەکێ زیرەک و بلیمەت بوو.

meaning: گەش / درەوشاوە
definition: تشتەکێ کو روناهییەکا زۆر بدەت یان کەسەکێ کو زۆر یێ کەیفخۆش و گەش بیت.
definitionEnglish: Sending out light; shining or glowing brightly.
exampleEnglish: A radiant smile.

meaning: بنەڕەتی / توندڕەو
definition: گوهۆڕینەکا زۆر مەزن و بنەڕەتی, یان کەسەکێ کو حەز ل سەر گوهۆڕینێن توند هەبیت.
definitionEnglish: (especially of change or action) relating to or affecting the fundamental nature of something; far-reaching or thorough.
exampleEnglish: Radical changes.

meaning: بێ سەروبەر بەلێ سەرنجڕاکێش
definition: کەسەکێ کو رەفتارێن وی نە یێن رێکوپێک بن بەلێ ب شێوازەکێ سەرنجڕاکێش بن.
definitionEnglish: Unconventional and slightly disreputable, especially in an attractive manner.
exampleEnglish: A raffish charm.

meaning: پشککێشان / تیروپشک
definition: جۆرەکێ پشککێشانێ یە بۆ برنا خەڵاتەکی ب رێکا کڕینا بلیتان.
definitionEnglish: A means of raising money by selling numbered tickets, one or some of which are subsequently drawn at random, the holder or holders such tickets winning a prize.
exampleEnglish: A raffle ticket.

meaning: کەڵەک / بڕەکێ زۆر
definition: تەختەکێ تەخت کو ل سەر ئاڤێ مەلەڤانیێ دکەت, یان بڕەکێ زۆر یێ تشتەکی.
definitionEnglish: A flat buoyant structure of timber or other materials fastened together, used as a boat or floating platform.
exampleEnglish: A raft of measures.

meaning: تورەیییا توند / باو
definition: تورەییەکا زۆر مەزن و توند, یان تشتەکێ کو زۆر یێ باو بیت د ناڤ خەلکی دا.
definitionEnglish: Violent uncontrollable anger.
exampleEnglish: He was shaking with rage.

meaning: گازندەکرن ب توندی / هێلا ئاسن
definition: گازندەکرن یان رەخنەگرتنەکا توند ل کەسەکی, یان هێلا ئاسن یا شەمەندەفەرێ.
definitionEnglish: Complain or protest strongly and persistently about something.
exampleEnglish: He railed against the injustice.
exampleKurdish: ئەوی ب توندی دژی نەدادپەروەرییێ ئاخفت.

meaning: جلوبەرگ
definition: پەیڤەکا کۆنە بۆ جلوبەرگان دهێتە بکارئینان.
definitionEnglish: Clothing; apparel.
exampleEnglish: Ladies in fine raiment.

meaning: کۆبوونەوە / ب هێز بوونەوە
definition: کۆبوونەوەیا خەلکی بۆ پشتگیرییا هزرەکێ, یان ب هێز بوونەوا بهایێ تشتەکی یان تەندروستییا کەسەکی.
definitionEnglish: (of troops) come together again in order to continue fighting after a defeat or dispersion.
exampleEnglish: The market rallied.

meaning: پیاسەکرن / درێژدادڕی
definition: پیاسەکرنەکا درێژ بۆ کەیفێ, یان ئاخفتنەکا درێژ و بێ سەروبەر.
definitionEnglish: Walk for pleasure, typically without a definite route.
exampleEnglish: He rambled on for hours.
exampleKurdish: ئەوی ب دەمژمێران بێ سەروبەر ئاخفت.

meaning: ئەنجام / لێکەوتە
definition: ئەنجامەکێ چاڤنەڕێکری یان ئاڵۆز یێ کارەکی یان بڕیارەکێ.
definitionEnglish: A consequence of an action or event, especially when complex or unwelcome.
exampleEnglish: The political ramifications of the decision.

meaning: چڵ و پۆ بوون / بەڵاڤ بوون
definition: دابەشبوونا تشتەکی بۆ چەندین بەشێن جیاواز و ئاڵۆز.
definitionEnglish: Form branches or subdivisions; branch out.
exampleEnglish: The issue ramified into several problems.
exampleKurdish: کێشە بۆ چەندین کێشەیێن دی بەڵاڤ بوو.

meaning: بەڵاڤ / بێ کۆنتڕۆڵ
definition: تشتەکێ خراب کو ب رەنگەکێ زۆر و بێ کۆنتڕۆڵ بەڵاڤ ببیت.
definitionEnglish: (especially of something unwelcome or unpleasant) flourishing or spreading unchecked.
exampleEnglish: Rampant corruption.

meaning: دیوارێ بەرگریێ / شوورە
definition: دیوارەکێ بلند و ب هێز کو ل دەورێ باژێڕەکی دهێتە ئاڤاکرن بۆ بەرگریێ.
definitionEnglish: A defensive wall of a castle or walled city, having a broad top with a walkway and typically a stone parapet.
exampleEnglish: The castle ramparts.

meaning: بێهن خراب / گنیبووی
definition: تشتەکێ کو چەوری تێدا بیت و بێهنەکا خراب ژێ بهێت ژبەر مانا زۆر.
definitionEnglish: (of foods containing fat or oil) smelling or tasting unpleasant as a result of being old and stale.
exampleEnglish: Rancid butter.

meaning: کین و قین / تورەیییا کۆن
definition: هەستەکێ تورەیی و کینێ یێ کۆن بەرامبەر کەسەکی.
definitionEnglish: Bitterness or resentfulness, especially when long-standing.
exampleEnglish: He spoke without rancor.
exampleKurdish: ئەوی بێ کین و قین ئاخفت.

meaning: هەرەمەکی / بێ پلان
definition: تشتەکێ کو بێ پلان و ب رەنگەکێ رێکەفت رووبدەت.
definitionEnglish: Made, done, happening, or chosen without method or conscious decision.
exampleEnglish: A random sample.

meaning: ئێشاندن / بێزارکردن ب بەردەوامی
definition: رووداوەک یان ئاخفتنەکا خراب کو بۆ دەمەکێ درێژ مروڤی بێزار بکەت.
definitionEnglish: (of a comment, event, or fact) cause annoyance or resentment that persists.
exampleEnglish: The criticism rankled.

meaning: هاوارکردن ب تورەیی / ئاخفتنا توند
definition: ئاخفتن ب دەنگەکێ بلند و ب تورەیی بۆ دەمەکێ درێژ.
definitionEnglish: Speak or shout at length in a wild, impassioned way.
exampleEnglish: He ranted about the government.
exampleKurdish: ئەوی ب هاوار و تورەیی دژی حکومەتێ ئاخفت.

meaning: چاوبرسی / دز و جەردە
definition: کەسەکێ کو زۆر یێ چاوبرسی بیت و حەز بکەت هەمی تشتان بۆ خۆ بگریت.
definitionEnglish: Aggressively greedy or grasping.
exampleEnglish: Rapacious landlords.

meaning: پەیوەندییا باش / لێکگەهشتن
definition: هەبوونا پەیوەندییەکا باش و لێکگەهشتنەکا تەمام د ناڤبەرا دوو کەسان دا.
definitionEnglish: A close and harmonious relationship in which the people or groups concerned understand each other's feelings or ideas and communicate well.
exampleEnglish: She has a good rapport with her students.
exampleKurdish: وێ پەیوەندییەکا باش ل گەڵ قوتابیێن خۆ هەبوو.

meaning: ئاشتەوایی / نێزیکبوونەوە
definition: دروستبوونا پەیوەندییەکا باش د ناڤبەرا دوو وەلاتان یان دوو کەسان دا پشتی ناکۆکییان.
definitionEnglish: (especially in international relations) an establishment or resumption of harmonious relations.
exampleEnglish: A rapprochement between the two countries.
exampleKurdish: ئاشتەوایییەک د ناڤبەرا هەردوو وەلاتان دا.

meaning: سەرسام / تەمام مژوول
definition: کەسەکێ کو زۆر یێ سەرسام بیت ب تشتەکی و هەمی سەرنجا وی ل سەر بیت.
definitionEnglish: Completely fascinated by what one is seeing or hearing.
exampleEnglish: He listened with rapt attention.
exampleKurdish: ئەوی ب سەرنجەکا تەمام گوهداری دکر.

meaning: کێم / تایبەت و بەرز
definition: هەوایەکێ کو ئۆکسجین تێدا کێم بیت (ل جهێن بلند), یان تشتەکێ کو ب تنێ بۆ کەسێن تایبەت بیت.
definitionEnglish: (of air, especially that at high altitudes) of lower pressure than usual; thin.
exampleEnglish: The rarefied atmosphere of academia.
exampleKurdish: کەشوهەوایێ تایبەت و بەرز یێ زانکۆیێ.

meaning: دەنگێ زبر
definition: دەنگەکێ زبر و نەخۆش کو وەک یێ کەسەکێ قورگ ئێش بیت.
definitionEnglish: Hoarse or harsh-sounding.
exampleEnglish: A raspy voice.

meaning: پەسەندکردن / واژۆکردن
definition: پەسەندکردنا رێککەفتنەکێ ب رەنگەکێ فەرمی.
definitionEnglish: Sign or give formal consent to (a treaty, contract, or agreement), making it officially valid.
exampleEnglish: The treaty was ratified.

meaning: مەنتیق / هزرکردنا ژیرانە
definition: پرۆسەیا هزرکردنێ ب رەنگەکێ مەنتیقی و ژیرانە.
definitionEnglish: The forming of judgments by a process of logical thought.
exampleEnglish: The power of ratiocination.

meaning: پاساو هێنانەوە / ژیرانەکرن
definition: هەوڵدان بۆ دیتنا ئەگەرەکێ ژیرانە بۆ کارەکێ خەلەت, یان رێکخستنا کارەکی ب رەنگەکێ باشتر.
definitionEnglish: Attempt to explain or justify (one's own or another's behavior or attitude) with logical, plausible reasons, even if these are not true or appropriate.
exampleEnglish: She tried to rationalize her decision.
exampleKurdish: وێ هەوڵ دا پاساوەکێ بۆ بڕیارا خۆ بینیتەوە.

meaning: دەنگێ بلند و زبر
definition: دەنگەکێ زۆر بلند و زبر و بێ سەروبەر.
definitionEnglish: Making or constituting a disturbingly harsh and loud noise.
exampleEnglish: Raucous laughter.

meaning: وێرانکردن / تێکدان
definition: وێرانکردن و تێکدانا تەمام یا تشتەکی یان جهەکی.
definitionEnglish: Cause severe and extensive damage to.
exampleEnglish: The hurricane ravaged the coast.

meaning: زۆر برسی
definition: هەبوونا برسییەتییەکا زۆر مەزن و توند.
definitionEnglish: Extremely hungry.
exampleEnglish: I'm ravenous.

meaning: تەختکردن / رووخاندن
definition: رووخاندنا ئاڤاهییەکی ب تەمامی هەتا دگەهیتە عەردی.
definitionEnglish: Completely destroy (a building, town, or other site).
exampleEnglish: The village was razed to the ground.

meaning: کۆنەپەرست / دژی گوهۆڕینێ
definition: کەسەکێ کو دژی گوهۆڕینێن سیاسی و جڤاکی بیت و حەز ل سەر رەوشا کۆن هەبیت.
definitionEnglish: (of a person or a set of views) opposing political or social liberalization or reform.
exampleEnglish: Reactionary policies.

meaning: پاشدانا پارەی / داشکاندن
definition: پاشدانا بڕەکێ پارەی بۆ کڕیارەکی پشتی کڕینا تشتەکی.
definitionEnglish: A partial refund to someone who has paid too much money for tax, rent, or a utility.
exampleEnglish: A tax rebate.

meaning: رەتکردنەوە ب توندی
definition: رەتکردنەوا پێشنیارەکێ یان داخوازەکێ ب رەنگەکێ توند و سارد.
definitionEnglish: Reject (someone or something) in an abrupt or ungracious manner.
exampleEnglish: She rebuffed his advances.
exampleKurdish: وێ داخوازا وی ب توندی رەتکر.

meaning: سەرزەنشتکردن / رەخنەگرتن
definition: رەخنەگرتنەکا توند ل کەسەکی ژبەر رەفتارەکا خراب.
definitionEnglish: Express sharp disapproval or criticism of (someone) because of their actions or anomalies.
exampleEnglish: He was rebuked for his rudeness.
exampleKurdish: ئەو هاتە سەرزەنشتکردن ژبەر بێ رێزییا وی.

meaning: مەتەلا وێنەیی
definition: مەتەلەک کو تێدا وێنە دهێنە بکارئینان بۆ گۆتنا پەیڤان یان رستان.
definitionEnglish: A puzzle in which words are represented by combinations of pictures and individual letters.
exampleEnglish: Solving a rebus.

meaning: رەتکردنەوە ب بەڵگە
definition: سەلماندنا هندێ کو ئاخفتنەک یان بەڵگەیەکا کەسەکێ دی یا خەلەتە.
definitionEnglish: A refutation or contradiction.
exampleEnglish: A strong rebuttal of the charges.

meaning: سەرکێش / یاخی
definition: کەسەکێ کو گوهدارییا فەرمانان نەکەت و زۆر یێ سەرکێش بیت.
definitionEnglish: Having an obstinately uncooperative attitude toward authority or discipline.
exampleEnglish: A recalcitrant child.

meaning: پاشەکشەکرن ژ باوەرییێ
definition: راگەیاندنا هندێ کو باوەرییا تە یا پێشتر یا خەلەت بوویە و پاشەکشە لێ بکەی.
definitionEnglish: Say that one no longer holds an opinion or belief, especially one considered heretical.
exampleEnglish: He was forced to recant his views.
exampleKurdish: ئەو نەچار بوو پاشەکشە ژ رایێن خۆ بکەت.

meaning: پوختەکردن / دووبارەکرنەوە
definition: دووبارەکرنەوا خالێن سەرەکی یێن ئاخفتنەکێ ب کورتی.
definitionEnglish: Summarize and state again the main points of.
exampleEnglish: To recapitulate the argument.

meaning: پاشەکشەکرن / دوورکەفتنەوە
definition: دوورکەفتنەوا تشتەکی یان پاشەکشەکرنا ئاڤێ.
definitionEnglish: Go or move back or further away from a previous position.
exampleEnglish: The flood waters receded.

meaning: قاپ / جامی
definition: تشتەکێ کو بۆ هەڵگرتنا تشتێن دی دهێتە بکارئینان.
definitionEnglish: A hollow object used to contain something.
exampleEnglish: A trash receptacle.

meaning: دووبارەکرنەوا تاوانێ
definition: دووبارە ئەنجامدانا تاوانێ ژ لایێ کەسەکێ کو بەری نوکە هاتییە سزادان.
definitionEnglish: The tendency of a convicted criminal to reoffend.
exampleEnglish: The rate of recidivism.

meaning: وەرگر
definition: کەسەکێ کو تشتەکی وەردگریت (وەک نامەیەک یان خەڵاتەک).
definitionEnglish: A person who gets or receives something.
exampleEnglish: The recipient of the Nobel Prize.

meaning: دوولایەنە / هەڤپشک
definition: کارەک یان هەستەکێ کو ژ هەردوو لایان ڤە هەبیت ب هەمان رەنگ.
definitionEnglish: Given, felt, or done in return.
exampleEnglish: Reciprocal help.

meaning: وەڵامدانەوە ب هەمان رەنگ
definition: ئەنجامدانا هەمان کار یان هەست بۆ کەسەکی پشتی وی بۆ تە ئەنجامدای.
definitionEnglish: Respond to (a gesture or action) by making a corresponding one.
exampleEnglish: To reciprocate a favor.

meaning: گۆشەگیر / دوور ژ خەلکی
definition: کەسەکێ کو ب تنێ بژیت و حەز نەکەت تێکەڵی خەلکی ببیت.
definitionEnglish: A person who lives a solitary life and tends to avoid other people.
exampleEnglish: He lived as a recluse.

meaning: ئاڵۆز / نەدیار
definition: تشتەکێ کو زۆر یێ ئاڵۆز بیت و ب تنێ کەسێن پسپۆڕ تێبگەهن.
definitionEnglish: (of a subject or knowledge) little known; abstruse.
exampleEnglish: Recondite information.

meaning: سیخوڕی / پشکنینا پێشوەخت
definition: کۆمکرنا زانیارییان دەربارەی دوژمنی یان ناوچەیەکێ بەری ئەنجامدانا هێرشێ.
definitionEnglish: Military observation of a region to locate an enemy or ascertain strategic features.
exampleEnglish: A reconnaissance mission.

meaning: گێڕانەوە / دووبارە هەژمارتن
definition: گێڕانەوا چیرۆکەکێ یان رووداوەکێ ب وردی, یان دووبارە هەژمارتنا دەنگان.
definitionEnglish: Tell someone about something; give an account of an event or experience.
exampleEnglish: He recounted his adventures.

meaning: پەنابردن / هاریکاری
definition: پەنابردن بۆ کەسەکێ یان تشتەکی بۆ وەرگرتنا هاریکارییێ د رەوشەکا ب زەحمەت دا.
definitionEnglish: A source of help in a difficult situation.
exampleEnglish: Surgery is the last recourse.

meaning: ترسنۆک / خاین
definition: کەسەکێ کو یێ ترسنۆک بیت یان باوەرییا کەسەکی بشکێنیت.
definitionEnglish: Cowardly.
exampleEnglish: A recreant knight.

meaning: تاوانبارکردنەوە
definition: تاوانبارکردنا کەسەکی پشتی وی تە تاوانبارکری.
definitionEnglish: Make counter-accusations.
exampleEnglish: They recriminated each other.

meaning: راستکردنەوە / چاککردن
definition: راستکردنەوا خەلەتییەکێ یان چاککردنا رەوشەکا خراب.
definitionEnglish: Put (something) right; correct.
exampleEnglish: To rectify a mistake.

meaning: راستی / رەوشت بەرزی
definition: هەبوونا رەوشتەکێ بەرز و راستگۆیییا تەمام.
definitionEnglish: Morally correct behavior or thinking; righteousness.
exampleEnglish: A man of rectitude.

meaning: درێژبووی / پاڵکەفتی
definition: کەسەکێ کو درێژ بووبیت یان پاڵ کەفتبیت.
definitionEnglish: (especially of a person or human figure) lying down.
exampleEnglish: A recumbent statue.

meaning: باشبوونەوە / چاکبوونەوە
definition: باشبوونەوا تەندروستییا مروڤی پشتی نەخۆشییەکێ یان ماندیبوونەکێ.
definitionEnglish: Recover from illness or exertion.
exampleEnglish: She is recuperating at home.
exampleKurdish: ئەو ل ماڵێ یا باش دبیتەوە.

meaning: دووبارەبووەوە
definition: تشتەکێ کو ب بەردەوامی دووبارە ببیتەوە.
definitionEnglish: Occurring often or repeatedly.
exampleEnglish: Recurrent headaches.

meaning: قەرەبووکردنەوە / رزگارکردن
definition: قەرەبووکردەوا خەلەتییەکێ ب کارەکێ باش, یان رزگارکردنا کەسەکی.
definitionEnglish: Compensate for the faults or bad aspects of (something).
exampleEnglish: A redeeming feature.

meaning: بێهن خۆش / بیرهێنەرەوە
definition: تشتەکێ کو بێهنەکا خۆش هەبیت یان تشتەکێ دی بینیتە بیرا مروڤی.
definitionEnglish: Strongly reminiscent or suggestive of (something).
exampleEnglish: The air was redolent of roses.

meaning: ب هێز و ترسناک / رێزلێگیراو
definition: کەسەکێ کو ژبەر هێزا خۆ ترس ل نک خەلکی دروست بکەت و رێز لێ بهێتە گرتن.
definitionEnglish: (of a person) formidable, especially as an opponent.
exampleEnglish: A redoubtable opponent.

meaning: قەرەبووکردنەوە / راستکردنەوە
definition: قەرەبووکردنەوا زیانەکێ یان راستکردنەوا نەدادپەروەرییەکێ.
definitionEnglish: Remedy or set right (an undesirable or unfair situation).
exampleEnglish: To redress the balance.

meaning: زێدە / بێ مفا
definition: تشتەکێ کو زێدە بیت و پێدڤی پێ نەبیت, یان کارمەندەکێ کو ژ کار بهێتە لادان چونکی پێدڤی پێ نینە.
definitionEnglish: Not or no longer needed or useful; superfluous.
exampleEnglish: Redundant information.

meaning: بێهنەکا توند و خراب
definition: بێهنەکا زۆر توند و خراب کو ژ تشتەکی بهێت.
definitionEnglish: Smell strongly and unpleasantly; stink.
exampleEnglish: The room reeked of tobacco.

meaning: ژوورا خوارنێ
definition: ژوورەکا مەزن بۆ خوارنێ د زانکۆیان یان کەنیسەیان دا.
definitionEnglish: A room used for communal meals, especially in an educational or religious institution.
exampleEnglish: Lunch in the refectory.

meaning: شکانەوەیا روناهییێ
definition: گوهۆڕینا ئاراستەیا روناهییێ دەمێ د ناڤ تشتەکی دا دەرباز دبیت (وەک ئاڤێ).
definitionEnglish: The fact or phenomenon of light, radio waves, etc., being deflected in passing obliquely through the interface between one medium and another or through a medium of varying density.
exampleEnglish: Refraction of light in water.

meaning: سەرکێش / نەهێتە چارەسەرکردن
definition: کەسەکێ کو گوهدارییێ نەکەت, یان نەخۆشییەکا کو ب ئاسانی چارەسەر نەبیت.
definitionEnglish: Stubborn or unmanageable.
exampleEnglish: A refractory child.

meaning: خۆ پاراستن / دووبارەبووەوە
definition: خۆ پاراستن ژ ئەنجامدانا کارەکی, یان پشکەکا سترانێ کو دووبارە دبیتەوە.
definitionEnglish: Stop oneself from doing something.
exampleEnglish: Please refrain from smoking.
exampleKurdish: هیڤییە خۆ ژ کێشانا جگارێ بپارێزن.

meaning: نووژەنکردنەوە / جوانکردن
definition: پاقژکردن و نووژەنکردنەوا تشتەکی یان جهەکی بۆ هندێ وەک یێ نوو لێ بهێت.
definitionEnglish: Renovate and redecorate (something, especially a building).
exampleEnglish: The house was refurbished.

meaning: رەتکردنەوە ب بەڵگە
definition: سەلماندنا هندێ کو گۆتنەک یان تیۆرییەک یا خەلەتە.
definitionEnglish: Prove (a statement or theory) to be wrong or false; disprove.
exampleEnglish: To refute an argument.

meaning: پاشایانە / شاهانە
definition: تشتەکێ کو گونجاو بیت بۆ پاشایەکی یان شاهەکێ.
definitionEnglish: Of, resembling, or fit for a monarch, especially in being magnificent or dignified.
exampleEnglish: A regal bearing.

meaning: کەیفخۆشکردن / مێوانداری
definition: کەیفخۆشکردنا کەسەکی ب چیرۆکان یان ب خوارنەکا باش.
definitionEnglish: Entertain or amuse (someone) with talk.
exampleEnglish: He regaled us with stories.
exampleKurdish: ئەوی ب چیرۆکان ئەم کەیفخۆش دکرن.

meaning: نوو بوونەوە / گەشەکرنەوە
definition: دروستبوونەوە یان گەشەکرنەوا بەشەکێ جەستەی یان ناوچەیەکێ.
definitionEnglish: The action or process of regenerating or being regenerated, in particular the formation of new animal or plant tissue.
exampleEnglish: Economic regeneration.

meaning: دەستەڵات / رژێم
definition: سیستەمەکێ حکومڕانییێ, یان سیستەمەکێ رێکخستی یێ ژیانێ.
definitionEnglish: A government, especially an authoritarian one.
exampleEnglish: A military regime.

meaning: بەرنامەیێ تەندروستی
definition: بەرنامەیەکێ رێکخستی یێ خوارنێ یان وەرزشێ بۆ باشتربوونا تەندروستییێ.
definitionEnglish: A prescribed course of medical treatment, way of life, or diet for the promotion or restoration of health.
exampleEnglish: A strict fitness regimen.

meaning: پاشکەفتوو / بەرەڤ پاش
definition: تشتەکێ کو بەرەڤ پاش بچیت یان بەرەڤ رەوشەکا خرابتر بچیت.
definitionEnglish: Returning to a former or less developed state; characterized by regression.
exampleEnglish: A regressive tax.

meaning: ڤەڕشاندن / دووبارەکرنەوە بێ هزر
definition: ڤەڕشاندنا خوارنێ, یان دووبارەکرنەوا زانیارییان بێ هندێ مروڤ تێبگەهیت.
definitionEnglish: Bring (swallowed food) up again to the mouth.
exampleEnglish: To regurgitate information for an exam.

meaning: چاککردنەوە / گەڕاندنەوە بۆ رەوشا باش
definition: هاریکاریکردنا کەسەکێ نەخۆش یان تاوانبار بۆ هندێ ب رەنگەکێ دروست بژیتەوە د جڤاکی دا.
definitionEnglish: Restore (someone) to health or normal life by training and therapy after imprisonment, addiction, or illness.
exampleEnglish: To rehabilitate a prisoner.

meaning: دووبارەکرنەوە
definition: گۆتنا تشتەکی بۆ چەندین جاران بۆ هندێ خەلک تێبگەهن یان پشتڕاست ببیت.
definitionEnglish: Say something again or a number of times, typically for emphasis or clarity.
exampleEnglish: She reiterated her request.

meaning: وەڵامەکا زیرەکانە
definition: وەڵامەکا خێرا و زیرەکانە بۆ ئاخفتن یان رەخنەیەکێ.
definitionEnglish: A reply, especially a sharp or witty one.
exampleEnglish: A witty rejoinder.

meaning: گەنجکردنەوە / نووکردنەوە
definition: گەنجکردنەوا کەسەکی یان نووکردنەوا تشتەکی بۆ هندێ ب هێز و گەش لێ بهێتەوە.
definitionEnglish: Make (someone or something) look or feel younger, fresher, or more lively.
exampleEnglish: The vacation rejuvenated him.

meaning: دووبارە نەخۆشبوونەوە / پاشەکشە
definition: دووبارە تووشبوونەوە ب نەخۆشییەکێ پشتی باشبوونێ، یان گەڕانەوە بۆ رەفتارەکا خراب.
definitionEnglish: (of someone suffering from a disease) suffer a deterioration after a period of improvement.
exampleEnglish: He had a relapse.

meaning: دابەزاندن / نزمکردنەوە
definition: دابەزاندنا پلەیەکێ یان رۆڵێ کەسەکی بۆ ئاستەکێ نزمتر.
definitionEnglish: Consign or dismiss to an inferior rank or position.
exampleEnglish: They were relegated to the second division.
exampleKurdish: ئەو بۆ خولا دووێ هاتنە دابەزاندن.

meaning: بەردەوام و بێ بەزەیی
definition: تشتەکێ کو ب بەردەوامی و ب توندی رووبدەت و نەهێتە راوەستاندن.
definitionEnglish: Oppressively constant; incessant.
exampleEnglish: Relentless heat.

meaning: پەیوەندیدار / گونجاو
definition: تشتەکێ کو پەیوەندییەکا راستەوخۆ ب بابەتێ بەحس لێکری هەبیت.
definitionEnglish: Closely connected or appropriate to what is being done or considered.
exampleEnglish: Relevant information.

meaning: شوێنەوار / تشتێ کۆن
definition: تشتەکێ کو ژ سەردەمەکێ کۆن مابیت و گرنگییا خۆ هەبیت.
definitionEnglish: An object surviving from an earlier time, especially one of historical or sentimental interest.
exampleEnglish: A relic of the past.

meaning: دەستبەرداربوون / وازهێنان
definition: دەستبەرداربوونا دەستەڵاتەکێ یان مافەکی ب رەنگەکێ ئارەزوومەندانە.
definitionEnglish: Voluntarily cease to keep or claim; give up.
exampleEnglish: He relinquished his claim to the throne.
exampleKurdish: ئەو دەستبەردارێ مافێ خۆ یێ تەختی بوو.

meaning: چێژوەرگرتن / حەزکردن
definition: چێژوەرگرتنەکا زۆر ژ تشتەکی یان کارەکی.
definitionEnglish: Enjoy greatly.

meaning: وەک هەڵۆ (بۆ لووت)
definition: Like an eagle; (of a person's nose) curved like an eagle's beak.
definitionEnglish: Like an eagle; (of a person's nose) curved like an eagle's beak.
exampleEnglish: He had a prominent aquiline nose.

meaning: گونجاو بۆ کشتوکاڵ
definition: (Of land) used or suitable for growing crops.
definitionEnglish: (Of land) used or suitable for growing crops.
exampleEnglish: The country has very little arable land.
exampleKurdish: وڵاتەکە زەوییەکی کشتوکاڵی زۆر کەمی هەیە.

meaning: ناوبژیوان، بڕیاردەر
definition: A person who settles a dispute or has ultimate authority in a matter.
definitionEnglish: A person who settles a dispute or has ultimate authority in a matter.
exampleEnglish: The court is the final arbiter of the law.

meaning: هەڕەمەکی، بێ سەروبەر
definition: Based on random choice or personal whim, rather than any reason or system.
definitionEnglish: Based on random choice or personal whim, rather than any reason or system.
exampleEnglish: The decision was completely arbitrary.

meaning: نهێنی، تێگەیشتنی قورسە، تەنها بۆ کەسانی تایبەت
definition: Understood by few; mysterious or secret.
definitionEnglish: Understood by few; mysterious or secret.
exampleEnglish: The rules of the game were arcane and difficult to follow.
exampleKurdish: یاساکانی یارییەکە نهێنی و تێگەیشتنیان قورس بوو.

meaning: زۆر کۆن، هی سەردەمانی پێشوو
definition: Very old or old-fashioned.
definitionEnglish: Very old or old-fashioned.
exampleEnglish: The prison system is based on archaic principles.
exampleKurdish: سیستەمی زیندانەکە لەسەر بنەمای کۆن و دواکەوتوو دامەزراوە.

meaning: نموونەی باڵا، بنەڕەت
definition: A very typical example of a certain person or thing.
definitionEnglish: A very typical example of a certain person or thing.
exampleEnglish: He is the archetype of a successful businessman.
exampleKurdish: ئەو نموونەی باڵای پیاوێکی کاری سەرکەوتووە.

meaning: بەجۆش و خرۆش، پڕ لە حەز
definition: Enthusiastic or passionate.
definitionEnglish: Enthusiastic or passionate.
exampleEnglish: She is an ardent supporter of the environmental movement.
exampleKurdish: ئەو پشتگیریکەرێکی بەجۆش و خرۆشی بزووتنەوەی ژینگەییە.

meaning: قورس، پڕ لە زەحمەت
definition: Involving or requiring strenuous effort; difficult and tiring.
definitionEnglish: Involving or requiring strenuous effort; difficult and tiring.
exampleEnglish: The journey across the mountains was long and arduous.
exampleKurdish: گەشتەکە بە ناو چیاکاندا درێژ و پڕ لە زەحمەت بوو.

meaning: وشک و بێ ئاو، بێزارکەر
definition: (Of land or a climate) having little or no rain; too dry or barren to support vegetation; lacking in interest, excitement, or meaning.
definitionEnglish: (Of land or a climate) having little or no rain; too dry or barren to support vegetation; lacking in interest, excitement, or meaning.
exampleEnglish: The region has an arid climate.

meaning: ئەرستۆکراسی، چینی باڵای کۆمەڵگا
definition: The highest class in certain societies, especially those holding hereditary titles or offices.
definitionEnglish: The highest class in certain societies, especially those holding hereditary titles or offices.
exampleEnglish: He was born into the French aristocracy.
exampleKurdish: ئەو لە ناو چینی ئەرستۆکراسی فەڕەنسیدا لەدایکبووە.

meaning: ئاگربەست
definition: An agreement made by opposing sides in a war to stop fighting for a certain time; a truce.
definitionEnglish: An agreement made by opposing sides in a war to stop fighting for a certain time; a truce.
exampleEnglish: The armistice was signed on November 11th.
exampleKurdish: ئاگربەستەکە لە ١١ی تشرینی دووەمدا واژۆ کرا.

meaning: بۆنی خۆش
definition: A distinctive, typically pleasant smell.
definitionEnglish: A distinctive, typically pleasant smell.
exampleEnglish: The aroma of fresh coffee filled the room.
exampleKurdish: بۆنی خۆشی قاوەی تازە ژوورەکەی پڕ کرد.

meaning: بانگکردن بۆ دادگا، تۆمەتبارکردن
definition: Call or bring (someone) before a court to answer a criminal charge.
definitionEnglish: Call or bring (someone) before a court to answer a criminal charge.
exampleEnglish: He was arraigned on charges of theft.
exampleKurdish: بانگی دادگا کرا بە تۆمەتی دزیکردن.

meaning: ڕیزبەندی، کۆمەڵێکی زۆر
definition: An impressive display or range of a particular type of thing.
definitionEnglish: An impressive display or range of a particular type of thing.
exampleEnglish: There was a vast array of food on the table.
exampleKurdish: ڕیزبەندییەکی زۆر لە خواردن لەسەر مێزەکە هەبوو.

meaning: قەرزی دواکەوتوو
definition: Money that is owed and should have been paid earlier.
definitionEnglish: Money that is owed and should have been paid earlier.
exampleEnglish: He is in arrears with his rent.

meaning: فیز، خۆبەگەورەزانین
definition: The quality of being arrogant.
definitionEnglish: The quality of being arrogant.
exampleEnglish: His arrogance made him very unpopular.
exampleKurdish: خۆبەگەورەزانینەکەی وایکردبوو کەس حەزی لێ نەبێت.

meaning: زمانپاراو، ڕوون لە قسەکردندا
definition: (Of a person or a person's words) having or showing the ability to speak fluently and coherently.
definitionEnglish: (Of a person or a person's words) having or showing the ability to speak fluently and coherently.
exampleEnglish: She is an articulate and intelligent young woman.
exampleKurdish: ئەو خانمێکی گەنجی زمانپاراو و زیرەکە.

meaning: شوێنەوار، شتی دەستکردی کۆن
definition: An object made by a human being, typically one of cultural or historical interest.
definitionEnglish: An object made by a human being, typically one of cultural or historical interest.
exampleEnglish: The museum has a large collection of ancient artifacts.
exampleKurdish: مۆزەخانەکە کۆمەڵەیەکی زۆری لە شوێنەوارە کۆنەکان هەیە.

meaning: فێڵ، زیرەکی لە فێڵدا
definition: Clever or cunning devices or expedients, especially as used to trick or deceive others.
definitionEnglish: Clever or cunning devices or expedients, especially as used to trick or deceive others.
exampleEnglish: The whole story was just an artifice to get money.
exampleKurdish: تەواوی چیرۆکەکە تەنها فێڵێک بوو بۆ دەستکەوتنی پارە.

meaning: وەستا، کەسی لێهاتوو لە کارێکی دەستیدا
definition: A worker in a skilled trade, especially one that involves making things by hand.
definitionEnglish: A worker in a skilled trade, especially one that involves making things by hand.
exampleEnglish: The market is full of local artisans selling their wares.
exampleKurdish: بازاڕەکە پڕە لە وەستای ناوخۆیی کە کەلوپەلەکانیان دەفرۆشن.

meaning: سادە و بێ فێڵ، سروشتی
definition: Without guile or deception; without effort or pretentiousness; natural and simple.
definitionEnglish: Without guile or deception; without effort or pretentiousness; natural and simple.
exampleEnglish: She has an artless and charming personality.
exampleKurdish: ئەو کەسایەتییەکی سادە و سەرنجڕاکێشی هەیە.

meaning: باڵادەستی، دەسەڵات
definition: Occupation of a position of dominant power or influence.
definitionEnglish: Occupation of a position of dominant power or influence.
exampleEnglish: The party is currently in the ascendancy.

meaning: دڵنیابوونەوە، دۆزینەوەی ڕاستی
definition: Find (something) out for certain; make sure of.
definitionEnglish: Find (something) out for certain; make sure of.
exampleEnglish: The police are trying to ascertain the cause of the fire.
exampleKurdish: پۆلیس هەوڵ دەدات دڵنیا بێتەوە لە هۆکاری ئاگرکەوتنەوەکە.

meaning: زاهید، کەسێک کە وازی لە چێژەکانی ژیان هێناوە
definition: Characterized by or suggesting the practice of severe self-discipline and abstention from all forms of indulgence, typically for religious reasons.
definitionEnglish: Characterized by or suggesting the practice of severe self-discipline and abstention from all forms of indulgence, typically for religious reasons.
exampleEnglish: He led an ascetic life in the mountains.
exampleKurdish: ژیانێکی زاهیدانەی لە چیاکاندا بەسەر دەبرد.

meaning: گەڕاندنەوە (بۆ هۆکارێک یان کەسێک)
definition: Attribute something to (a cause).
definitionEnglish: Attribute something to (a cause).
exampleEnglish: He ascribes his success to hard work.

meaning: خاوێن، بێ میکرۆب
definition: Free from contamination caused by harmful bacteria, viruses, or other microorganisms.
definitionEnglish: Free from contamination caused by harmful bacteria, viruses, or other microorganisms.
exampleEnglish: The surgery was performed in an aseptic environment.
exampleKurdish: نەشتەرگەرییەکە لە ژینگەیەکی بێ میکرۆبدا ئەنجامدرا.

meaning: گەمژانە، بێ مانا
definition: Extremely stupid or foolish.
definitionEnglish: Extremely stupid or foolish.
exampleEnglish: That was an asinine comment to make.
exampleKurdish: ئەوە تێبینییەکی گەمژانە بوو کە کرا.

meaning: بە گومانەوە، بە چاوێکی ترەوە
definition: With an attitude or look of suspicion or disapproval.
definitionEnglish: With an attitude or look of suspicion or disapproval.
exampleEnglish: The neighbors looked askance at the new arrivals.
exampleKurdish: دراوسێکان بە گومانەوە سەیری هاتووانی نوێیان دەکرد.

meaning: توندی، زبری (لە ڕەفتار یان دەنگدا)
definition: Harshness of tone or manner.
definitionEnglish: Harshness of tone or manner.
exampleEnglish: She spoke with some asperity.
exampleKurdish: بە جۆرێک لە توندییەوە قسەی کرد.

meaning: تۆمەت، ناوزڕاندن
definition: An attack on the reputation or integrity of someone or something.
definitionEnglish: An attack on the reputation or integrity of someone or something.
exampleEnglish: He cast aspersions on my character.

meaning: خوازەیار، کەسێک کە هەوڵی گەیشتن بە شتێک دەدات
definition: A person who has ambitions to achieve something.
definitionEnglish: A person who has ambitions to achieve something.
exampleEnglish: He is an aspirant for the position of manager.
exampleKurdish: ئەو خوازەیارە بۆ وەرگرتنی پێگەی بەڕێوەبەر.

meaning: ئاوات، حەز و خولیا
definition: A hope or ambition of achieving something.
definitionEnglish: A hope or ambition of achieving something.
exampleEnglish: She has aspirations to become a doctor.
exampleKurdish: ئەو ئاواتی هەیە ببێت بە پزیشک.

meaning: هێرشکردنە سەر (بە توندی)، پەلاماردان
definition: Make a concerted or violent attack on.
definitionEnglish: Make a concerted or violent attack on.
exampleEnglish: The army began to assail the fortress.
exampleKurdish: سوپاکە دەستی کرد بە هێرشکردنە سەر قەڵاکە.

meaning: تاقیکردنەوە، هەڵسەنگاندن (بۆ کانزا یان شت)
definition: Determine the content or quality of (a metal or ore).
definitionEnglish: Determine the content or quality of (a metal or ore).
exampleEnglish: The gold was assayed to determine its purity.

meaning: ڕەزامەندی، قبوڵکردن
definition: The expression of approval or agreement.
definitionEnglish: The expression of approval or agreement.
exampleEnglish: The proposal was met with general assent.
exampleKurdish: پێشنیارەکە بە ڕەزامەندی گشتی پێشوازی لێکرا.

meaning: دووپاتکردنەوە، جەختکردنەوە
definition: State a fact or belief confidently and forcefully.
definitionEnglish: State a fact or belief confidently and forcefully.
exampleEnglish: He continued to assert his innocence.
exampleKurdish: بەردەوام بوو لە دووپاتکردنەوەی بێتاوانی خۆی.

meaning: هەڵسەنگاندن
definition: The evaluation or estimation of the nature, quality, or ability of someone or something.
definitionEnglish: The evaluation or estimation of the nature, quality, or ability of someone or something.
exampleEnglish: The teacher made an assessment of the students' progress.
exampleKurdish: مامۆستاکە هەڵسەنگاندنێکی بۆ پێشکەوتنی قوتابییەکان کرد.

meaning: کۆششکەر، ماندوونەناس
definition: Showing great care and perseverance.
definitionEnglish: Showing great care and perseverance.
exampleEnglish: She was assiduous in her studies.

meaning: تێکەڵ بوون، هەرسکردن (بۆ زانیاری یان کلتوور)
definition: Take in (information, ideas, or culture) and understand fully; cause (something) to resemble; liken.
definitionEnglish: Take in (information, ideas, or culture) and understand fully; cause (something) to resemble; liken.
exampleEnglish: It takes time to assimilate new information.
exampleKurdish: کات دەوێت بۆ هەرسکردنی زانیاری نوێ.

meaning: هێورکردنەوە، کەمکردنەوە (بۆ ئازار یان هەست)
definition: Make (an unpleasant feeling) less intense.
definitionEnglish: Make (an unpleasant feeling) less intense.
exampleEnglish: The news helped to assuage her fears.
exampleKurdish: هەواڵەکە یارمەتیدەر بوو بۆ هێورکردنەوەی ترسەکانی.

meaning: پێشبینی، گریمانە
definition: A thing that is accepted as true or as certain to happen, without proof.
definitionEnglish: A thing that is accepted as true or as certain to happen, without proof.
exampleEnglish: Your assumption is based on incorrect information.

meaning: دڵنیایی، متمانە
definition: A positive declaration intended to give confidence; a promise.
definitionEnglish: A positive declaration intended to give confidence; a promise.
exampleEnglish: He gave me his assurance that the work would be finished on time.
exampleKurdish: دڵنیایی پێدام کە کارەکە لە کاتی خۆیدا تەواو دەبێت.

meaning: هەسارۆکە
definition: A small rocky body orbiting the sun.
definitionEnglish: A small rocky body orbiting the sun.
exampleEnglish: The scientists are tracking a large asteroid.

meaning: ئەستێرەیی، پەیوەندیدار بە ئەستێرەکانەوە
definition: Of, connected with, or resembling the stars.
definitionEnglish: Of, connected with, or resembling the stars.
exampleEnglish: The telescope revealed many astral bodies.

meaning: توند، تاڵ، کۆکەرەوە (بۆ دەرمان یان قسە)
definition: Slightly acidic or bitter; sharp or severe in manner or style.
definitionEnglish: Slightly acidic or bitter; sharp or severe in manner or style.
exampleEnglish: His astringent remarks offended many people.
exampleKurdish: تێبینییە توندەکانی ئەو زۆر کەسی بێزار کرد.

meaning: زیرەک، وردبین، بەئاگا
definition: Having or showing an ability to accurately assess situations or people and turn this to one's advantage.
definitionEnglish: Having or showing an ability to accurately assess situations or people and turn this to one's advantage.
exampleEnglish: He is an astute observer of human behavior.

meaning: لە یەک جیا، پارچە پارچە
definition: Apart; divided.
definitionEnglish: Apart; divided.
exampleEnglish: The family was torn asunder by the war.
exampleKurdish: خێزانەکە بەهۆی شەڕەکەوە لە یەک جیا بوونەوە.

meaning: پەنابەری، پەناگە، نەخۆشخانەی دەروونی
definition: The protection granted by a nation to someone who has left their native country as a political refugee; an institution for the care of people who are mentally ill.
definitionEnglish: The protection granted by a nation to someone who has left their native country as a political refugee; an institution for the care of people who are mentally ill.
exampleEnglish: He applied for political asylum in the UK.
exampleKurdish: داوای پەنابەری سیاسی کرد لە بەریتانیا.

meaning: ناڕێک، بێ هاوسەنگی
definition: Having parts or aspects that are not equal or equivalent; lacking symmetry.
definitionEnglish: Having parts or aspects that are not equal or equivalent; lacking symmetry.
exampleEnglish: The building has an asymmetric design.

meaning: گەڕانەوە بۆ سیفەتە کۆنەکان، دواکەوتوویی
definition: A tendency to revert to something ancient or ancestral.
definitionEnglish: A tendency to revert to something ancient or ancestral.
exampleEnglish: The violence was seen as a form of atavism.
exampleKurdish: توندوتیژییەکە وەک جۆرێک لە گەڕانەوە بۆ سیفەتە کۆنەکان بینرا.

meaning: بێباوەڕی (بە خودا)
definition: Disbelieving or lacking belief in the existence of God.
definitionEnglish: Disbelieving or lacking belief in the existence of God.
exampleEnglish: He holds atheistic views.

meaning: قەرەبووکردنەوەی هەڵە، تۆبەکردن
definition: Make amends or reparation.
definitionEnglish: Make amends or reparation.
exampleEnglish: He tried to atone for his past mistakes.

meaning: تاوانی گەورە، دڕندەیی
definition: An extremely wicked or cruel act, typically one involving physical violence or injury.
definitionEnglish: An extremely wicked or cruel act, typically one involving physical violence or injury.
exampleEnglish: The war was marked by many atrocities.
exampleKurdish: شەڕەکە بە چەندین تاوانی گەورە ناسرا.

meaning: پووکاندنەوە، لاوازبوون (بۆ ماسولکە یان ئەندام)
definition: (Of body tissue or an organ) waste away, typically due to the degeneration of cells, or become vestigial during evolution; gradually decline in effectiveness or vigor due to underuse or neglect.
definitionEnglish: (Of body tissue or an organ) waste away, typically due to the degeneration of cells, or become vestigial during evolution; gradually decline in effectiveness or vigor due to underuse or neglect.
exampleEnglish: Lack of exercise can cause muscles to atrophy.
exampleKurdish: نەبوونی وەرزش دەبێتە هۆی پووکانەوەی ماسولکەکان.

meaning: لاوازکردن، کەمکردنەوەی هێز یان نرخ
definition: Reduce the force, effect, or value of.
definitionEnglish: Reduce the force, effect, or value of.
exampleEnglish: The radiation is attenuated by the lead shield.
exampleKurdish: تیشکەکە لەلایەن قەڵغانی قورقوشمەکەوە لاواز دەکرێت.

meaning: شایەتیدان، پشتڕاستکردنەوە
definition: Provide or serve as clear evidence of.
definitionEnglish: Provide or serve as clear evidence of.
exampleEnglish: His success attests to his hard work.

meaning: سیفەت، گەڕاندنەوە (بۆ هۆکارێک)
definition: Regard something as being caused by (someone or something); a quality or feature regarded as a characteristic or inherent part of someone or something.
definitionEnglish: Regard something as being caused by (someone or something); a quality or feature regarded as a characteristic or inherent part of someone or something.
exampleEnglish: Patience is an essential attribute for a teacher.

meaning: داخوران، کەمبوونەوەی پلەبەپلە (بۆ هێز یان ژمارە)
definition: The action or process of gradually reducing the strength or effectiveness of someone or something through sustained attack or pressure.
definitionEnglish: The action or process of gradually reducing the strength or effectiveness of someone or something through sustained attack or pressure.
exampleEnglish: The war became a battle of attrition.
exampleKurdish: شەڕەکە بوو بە جەنگی داخورانی هێز.

meaning: نائاسایی، جیاواز لە جۆری باو
definition: Not representative of a type, group, or class.
definitionEnglish: Not representative of a type, group, or class.
exampleEnglish: The cold weather is atypical for this time of year.
exampleKurdish: کەشوهەوا ساردەکە نائاساییە بۆ ئەم کاتەی ساڵ.

meaning: ئازا، چاونەترس، بێشەرم
definition: Showing a willingness to take surprisingly bold risks; showing an impudent lack of respect.
definitionEnglish: Showing a willingness to take surprisingly bold risks; showing an impudent lack of respect.
exampleEnglish: It was an audacious plan to rob the bank.
exampleKurdish: پلانێکی ئازایانە بوو بۆ دزینی بانکەکە.

meaning: ئازایەتی، بێشەرمی
definition: A willingness to take bold risks; rude or disrespectful behavior; impudence.
definitionEnglish: A willingness to take bold risks; rude or disrespectful behavior; impudence.
exampleEnglish: I can't believe he had the audacity to ask for more money.
exampleKurdish: ناتوانم بڕوا بکەم ئەو بێشەرمییەی هەبوو داوای پارەی زیاتر بکات.

meaning: زیادکردن، گەورەکردن
definition: Make (something) greater by adding to it; increase.
definitionEnglish: Make (something) greater by adding to it; increase.
exampleEnglish: He took a second job to augment his income.
exampleKurdish: کارێکی دووەمی گرت بۆ زیادکردنی داهاتەکەی.

meaning: پێشبینیکردن، نیشانەی داهاتوو
definition: (Of an event or circumstance) portend a good or bad outcome.
definitionEnglish: (Of an event or circumstance) portend a good or bad outcome.
exampleEnglish: The recent success augurs well for the future.
exampleKurdish: سەرکەوتنەکەی ئەم دواییە نیشانەیەکی باشە بۆ داهاتوو.

meaning: نیشانە، پێشبینی
definition: A sign of what will happen in the future; an omen.
definitionEnglish: A sign of what will happen in the future; an omen.
exampleEnglish: They looked for an augury before making a decision.
exampleKurdish: بەدوای نیشانەیەکدا دەگەڕان پێش ئەوەی بڕیار بدەن.

meaning: بەڕێز، شکۆدار
definition: Respected and impressive.
definitionEnglish: Respected and impressive.
exampleEnglish: The ceremony was held in the presence of an august group of leaders.
exampleKurdish: مەراسیمەکە لەبەردەم گروپێکی شکۆداری سەرکردەکاندا بەڕێوەچوو.

meaning: کەشوهەوا، هەستی دەوروبەری کەسێک یان شوێنێک
definition: The distinctive atmosphere or quality that seems to surround and be generated by a person, thing, or place.
definitionEnglish: The distinctive atmosphere or quality that seems to surround and be generated by a person, thing, or place.
exampleEnglish: The old house had an aura of mystery.

meaning: بەخت، نیشانەی سەرکەوتن
definition: Conducive to success; favorable.
definitionEnglish: Conducive to success; favorable.
exampleEnglish: It was an auspicious start to the new year.
exampleKurdish: دەستپێکێکی بەختەوەر بوو بۆ ساڵی نوێ.

meaning: سادە و بێ ڕازاوە، توند
definition: Severe or strict in manner, attitude, or appearance; (of living conditions or a way of life) having no comforts or luxuries; very plain and simple.
definitionEnglish: Severe or strict in manner, attitude, or appearance; (of living conditions or a way of life) having no comforts or luxuries; very plain and simple.
exampleEnglish: The monks lead an austere life.
exampleKurdish: دەروێشەکان ژیانێکی سادە و توند بەسەر دەبەن.

meaning: سادەیی، توندی، کەمکردنەوەی خەرجی
definition: Sternness or severity of manner or attitude; extreme plainness and simplicity of style or appearance; difficult economic conditions created by government measures to reduce a budget deficit.
definitionEnglish: Sternness or severity of manner or attitude; extreme plainness and simplicity of style or appearance; difficult economic conditions created by government measures to reduce a budget deficit.
exampleEnglish: The government introduced austerity measures to reduce the debt.
exampleKurdish: حکومەت ڕێکاری کەمکردنەوەی خەرجی گرتەبەر بۆ کەمکردنەوەی قەرزەکان.

meaning: ڕاستەقینە، باوەڕپێکراو
definition: Of undisputed origin; genuine.
definitionEnglish: Of undisputed origin; genuine.
exampleEnglish: The painting is an authentic Picasso.

meaning: پشتڕاستکردنەوەی ڕاستی شتێک
definition: Prove or show (something, especially an artistic work or a document) to be true, genuine, or valid.
definitionEnglish: Prove or show (something, especially an artistic work or a document) to be true, genuine, or valid.
exampleEnglish: Experts were called in to authenticate the signature.

meaning: دکتاتۆر، دەسەڵاتخواز
definition: Favoring or enforcing strict obedience to authority, especially that of the government, at the expense of personal freedom.
definitionEnglish: Favoring or enforcing strict obedience to authority, especially that of the government, at the expense of personal freedom.
exampleEnglish: The country was ruled by an authoritarian regime.
exampleKurdish: وڵاتەکە لەلایەن ڕژێمێکی دکتاتۆرەوە بەڕێوە دەبرا.

meaning: باوەڕپێکراو، خاوەن دەسەڵات
definition: Able to be trusted as being accurate or true; reliable; commanding and self-confident; likely to be respected and obeyed.
definitionEnglish: Able to be trusted as being accurate or true; reliable; commanding and self-confident; likely to be respected and obeyed.
exampleEnglish: He wrote an authoritative book on the subject.
exampleKurdish: کتێبێکی باوەڕپێکراوی لەسەر ئەو بابەتە نووسی.

meaning: تاکڕەو، دکتاتۆر
definition: Relating to a ruler who has absolute power.
definitionEnglish: Relating to a ruler who has absolute power.
exampleEnglish: The manager had an autocratic style of leadership.
exampleKurdish: بەڕێوەبەرەکە شێوازێکی تاکڕەوانەی هەبوو لە سەرکردایەتیکردندا.

meaning: ڕۆبۆت، کەسێک کە بێ بیرکردنەوە کار دەکات
definition: A moving mechanical device made in imitation of a human being; a person who seems to act in a mechanical or unemotional way.
definitionEnglish: A moving mechanical device made in imitation of a human being; a person who seems to act in a mechanical or unemotional way.
exampleEnglish: He worked like an automaton, never stopping to rest.
exampleKurdish: وەک ڕۆبۆتێک کاری دەکرد، هەرگیز بۆ پشوودان نەدەوەستا.

meaning: خۆبەڕێوەبەر، سەربەخۆ
definition: (Of a country or region) having the freedom to govern itself or control its own affairs; having the power of self-government.
definitionEnglish: (Of a country or region) having the freedom to govern itself or control its own affairs; having the power of self-government.
exampleEnglish: The region is an autonomous province.

meaning: سەربەخۆیی، خۆبەڕێوەبەری
definition: The right or condition of self-government.
definitionEnglish: The right or condition of self-government.
exampleEnglish: The university has a high degree of autonomy.

meaning: یارمەتیدەر، زیادە
definition: Providing supplementary or additional help and support.
definitionEnglish: Providing supplementary or additional help and support.
exampleEnglish: The ship has an auxiliary engine.

meaning: چاوبرسییەتی بۆ پارە، ڕەزیلی
definition: Extreme greed for wealth or material gain.
definitionEnglish: Extreme greed for wealth or material gain.
exampleEnglish: His avarice led him to commit fraud.
exampleKurdish: چاوبرسییەتییەکەی وای لێکرد تاوانی فێڵکردن ئەنجام بدات.

meaning: تۆڵەکردنەوە
definition: Inflict harm in return for (an injury or wrong done to oneself or another).
definitionEnglish: Inflict harm in return for (an injury or wrong done to oneself or another).
exampleEnglish: He swore to avenge his brother's death.
exampleKurdish: سوێندی خوارد تۆڵەی مردنی براکەی بکاتەوە.

meaning: دووپاتکردنەوە، جەختکردنەوە
definition: State or assert to be the case.
definitionEnglish: State or assert to be the case.
exampleEnglish: He averred that he was innocent.

meaning: دژ، حەز نەکردن
definition: Having a strong dislike of or opposition to something.
definitionEnglish: Having a strong dislike of or opposition to something.
exampleEnglish: I am not averse to the idea.

meaning: ڕق، حەز نەکردنێکی زۆر
definition: A strong dislike or disinclination.
definitionEnglish: A strong dislike or disinclination.
exampleEnglish: She has a strong aversion to snakes.

meaning: ڕێگری لێکردن، لادانی چاو
definition: Turn away (one's eyes or thoughts); prevent or ward off (an undesirable occurrence).
definitionEnglish: Turn away (one's eyes or thoughts); prevent or ward off (an undesirable occurrence).
exampleEnglish: He averted his eyes from the scene.

meaning: ماڵی باڵندە (قەفەسی گەورە)
definition: A large cage, building, or enclosure for keeping birds in.
definitionEnglish: A large cage, building, or enclosure for keeping birds in.
exampleEnglish: The zoo has a beautiful aviary.
exampleKurdish: باخچەی ئاژەڵان ماڵێکی باڵندەی جوانی هەیە.

meaning: بە پەرۆش، پڕ لە حەز
definition: Having or showing a keen interest in or enthusiasm for something.
definitionEnglish: Having or showing a keen interest in or enthusiasm for something.
exampleEnglish: He is an avid reader of science fiction.
exampleKurdish: ئەو خوێنەرێکی بە پەرۆشی چیرۆکە خەیاڵییە زانستییەکانە.

meaning: خولیای لاوەکی، کارێک جگە لە پیشەی سەرەکی
definition: A hobby or minor occupation.
definitionEnglish: A hobby or minor occupation.
exampleEnglish: Photography is his favorite avocation.

meaning: دانپێدانان بە ئاشکرا
definition: Assert or confess openly.
definitionEnglish: Assert or confess openly.
exampleEnglish: He avowed his love for her.

meaning: وەک مام یان خاڵ (میهرەبان و دڵسۆز)
definition: Relating to an uncle; kind and friendly towards a younger person.
definitionEnglish: Relating to an uncle; kind and friendly towards a younger person.
exampleEnglish: He gave me some avuncular advice.

meaning: سەرسامی و ڕێز، ترسێکی تێکەڵ بە ڕێز
definition: A feeling of reverential respect mixed with fear or wonder.
definitionEnglish: A feeling of reverential respect mixed with fear or wonder.
exampleEnglish: They stared in awe at the giant waterfall.
exampleKurdish: بە سەرسامییەوە سەیری تاڤگە زەبەلاحەکەیان دەکرد.

meaning: خوار، هەڵە، تێکچوو
definition: Away from the appropriate, planned, or expected course; amiss.
definitionEnglish: Away from the appropriate, planned, or expected course; amiss.
exampleEnglish: Our plans went awry because of the weather.

meaning: بەڵگەنەویست، ڕاستییەکی ئاشکرا
definition: A statement or proposition which is regarded as being established, accepted, or self-evidently true.
definitionEnglish: A statement or proposition which is regarded as being established, accepted, or self-evidently true.
exampleEnglish: It is an axiom of economics that resources are limited.
exampleKurdish: ئەوە ڕاستییەکی بەڵگەنەویستی ئابوورییە کە سەرچاوەکان سنووردارن.

meaning: شینی ئاسمانی
definition: Bright blue in color, like a cloudless sky.
definitionEnglish: Bright blue in color, like a cloudless sky.
exampleEnglish: The azure water of the Mediterranean was beautiful.
exampleKurdish: ئاوە شینە ئاسمانییەکەی دەریای ناوەڕاست جوان بوو.

meaning: قسەی بێ مانا، زۆربڵێیی
definition: Talk rapidly and continuously in a foolish, excited, or incomprehensible way.
definitionEnglish: Talk rapidly and continuously in a foolish, excited, or incomprehensible way.
exampleEnglish: The baby began to babble.
exampleKurdish: منداڵەکە دەستی کرد بە قسەی بێ مانا.

meaning: پڕ لە کەیف و سەفا و سەرخۆشی
definition: Characterized by or given to drunken revelry.
definitionEnglish: Characterized by or given to drunken revelry.
exampleEnglish: The party turned into a bacchanalian celebration.
exampleKurdish: ئاهەنگەکە گۆڕا بۆ ئاهەنگێکی پڕ لە کەیف و سەفا و سەرخۆشی.

meaning: بێزارکردن بە داواکاری بەردەوام
definition: Ask (someone) repeatedly and annoyingly for something; pester.
definitionEnglish: Ask (someone) repeatedly and annoyingly for something; pester.
exampleEnglish: The children badgered their parents for a new toy.
exampleKurdish: منداڵەکان دایک و باوکیان بێزار کرد بۆ کڕینی یارییەکی نوێ.

meaning: گاڵتەوگەپ، قسەی خۆش
definition: Humorous or witty conversation.
definitionEnglish: Humorous or witty conversation.
exampleEnglish: The two friends engaged in a light-hearted badinage.
exampleKurdish: دوو هاوڕێکە کەوتنە ناو گاڵتەوگەپێکی خۆشەوە.

meaning: سەرلێشێواندن، تێنەگەیشتن
definition: Totally bewilder or perplex.
definitionEnglish: Totally bewilder or perplex.
exampleEnglish: The mystery continues to baffle the police.

meaning: شتی بێ بایەخ، وردەواڵە
definition: A thing of little importance; a very easy task.
definitionEnglish: A thing of little importance; a very easy task.
exampleEnglish: The cost was a mere bagatelle to him.
exampleKurdish: تێچووەکە لای ئەو شتێکی زۆر بێ بایەخ بوو.

meaning: پاسەوانی دادگا، بەرپرسی جێبەجێکردن
definition: An official in a court of law who keeps order, looks after prisoners, etc.
definitionEnglish: An official in a court of law who keeps order, looks after prisoners, etc.
exampleEnglish: The bailiff led the defendant into the courtroom.
exampleKurdish: پاسەوانەکە تۆمەتبارەکەی برد بۆ ناو هۆڵی دادگا.

meaning: تەڵە، بێزارکردن، خواردنی ناو تەڵە
definition: Food placed on a hook or in a net, trap, or fishing area to entice fish or other animals as prey; deliberately annoy or taunt (someone).
definitionEnglish: Food placed on a hook or in a net, trap, or fishing area to entice fish or other animals as prey; deliberately annoy or taunt (someone).
exampleEnglish: He used a worm as bait.

meaning: مەترسیدار، پڕ لە قین
definition: Threatening harm; menacing.
definitionEnglish: Threatening harm; menacing.
exampleEnglish: She gave him a baleful look.

meaning: ڕێگری لێکردن، ڕازی نەبوون بە کارێک
definition: Hesitate or be unwilling to accept an idea or undertaking.
definitionEnglish: Hesitate or be unwilling to accept an idea or undertaking.
exampleEnglish: He balked at the high price of the car.
exampleKurdish: ڕازی نەبوو بە نرخە بەرزەکەی ئۆتۆمبێلەکە.

meaning: هاوسەنگکەر، شتێک کە هاوسەنگی ڕادەگرێت
definition: Heavy material, such as gravel, sand, iron, or lead, placed low in a vessel to improve its stability.
definitionEnglish: Heavy material, such as gravel, sand, iron, or lead, placed low in a vessel to improve its stability.
exampleEnglish: The ship used sand as ballast.

meaning: مەرهەم، هێورکەرەوە
definition: A fragrant ointment or preparation used to heal or soothe the skin; something that has a comforting, soothing, or restorative effect.
definitionEnglish: A fragrant ointment or preparation used to heal or soothe the skin; something that has a comforting, soothing, or restorative effect.
exampleEnglish: The music was a balm to his soul.
exampleKurdish: مۆسیقاکە مەرهەمێک بوو بۆ ڕۆحی ئەو.

meaning: خۆش و هێمن (بۆ کەشوهەوا)
definition: (Of the weather) pleasantly warm.
definitionEnglish: (Of the weather) pleasantly warm.
exampleEnglish: It was a balmy summer evening.
exampleKurdish: ئێوارەیەکی هاوینی خۆش و هێمن بوو.

meaning: بێ مانا، دووبارە، بێزارکەر
definition: So lacking in originality as to be obvious and boring.
definitionEnglish: So lacking in originality as to be obvious and boring.
exampleEnglish: The movie had a banal plot.
exampleKurdish: فیلمەکە چیرۆکێکی بێ مانا و دووبارەی هەبوو.

meaning: ئاڵوگۆڕکردنی قسە، بڵاوکردنەوەی دەنگۆ
definition: Pass on or discuss (an idea or rumor) in a casual or uninformed way.
definitionEnglish: Pass on or discuss (an idea or rumor) in a casual or uninformed way.
exampleEnglish: His name was bandied about as a possible candidate.
exampleKurdish: ناوی ئەو وەک کاندیدێکی ئەگەری دەستاودەستی پێ دەکرا.

meaning: بەڵا، هۆکاری ناخۆشی
definition: A cause of great distress or annoyance.
definitionEnglish: A cause of great distress or annoyance.
exampleEnglish: The constant noise is the bane of my life.

meaning: گاڵتەوگەپ، قسەی خۆش و دۆستانە
definition: The playful and friendly exchange of teasing remarks.
definitionEnglish: The playful and friendly exchange of teasing remarks.
exampleEnglish: The two friends enjoyed a bit of friendly banter.
exampleKurdish: دوو هاوڕێکە چێژیان لە گاڵتەوگەپێکی دۆستانە دەبینی.

meaning: قسەی توند، نووک، دڕک
definition: A sharp projection near the end of an arrow, fishhook, or similar object, which is angled away from the main point so as to make extraction difficult; a deliberate insulting or cutting remark.
definitionEnglish: A sharp projection near the end of an arrow, fishhook, or similar object, which is angled away from the main point so as to make extraction difficult; a deliberate insulting or cutting remark.
exampleEnglish: His speech was full of barbs directed at his opponent.
exampleKurdish: وتارەکەی پڕ بوو لە قسەی توند کە ئاراستەی نەیارەکەی کرابوو.

meaning: پڕ لە نەخش و نیگار، ئاڵۆز (بۆ شێوازی هونەری)
definition: Relating to or denoting a style of European architecture, music, and art of the 17th and 18th centuries that followed mannerism and is characterized by ornate detail.
definitionEnglish: Relating to or denoting a style of European architecture, music, and art of the 17th and 18th centuries that followed mannerism and is characterized by ornate detail.
exampleEnglish: The church was decorated in a baroque style.
exampleKurdish: کەنیسەکە بە شێوازێکی بارۆکی پڕ لە نەخش و نیگار ڕازێنرابووەوە.

meaning: هێرشی چڕ، زۆری شتێک (وەک پرسیار)
definition: A concentrated outpouring, as of questions or blows.
definitionEnglish: A concentrated outpouring, as of questions or blows.
exampleEnglish: The minister faced a barrage of questions from reporters.
exampleKurdish: وەزیرەکە ڕووبەڕووی هێرشێکی چڕی پرسیار لەلایەن ڕۆژنامەنووسانەوە بووەوە.

meaning: بێ بەرهەم، وشک، نەزۆک
definition: (Of land) too poor to produce much or any vegetation; (of a tree or plant) not producing fruit or seed; (of a woman) unable to bear children.
definitionEnglish: (Of land) too poor to produce much or any vegetation; (of a tree or plant) not producing fruit or seed; (of a woman) unable to bear children.
exampleEnglish: The desert is a barren landscape.
exampleKurdish: بیابانەکە دیمەنێکی وشک و بێ بەرهەمە.

meaning: بەربەست، ڕێگری
definition: An improvised barrier erected across a street or other thoroughfare to prevent or delay the movement of opposing forces.
definitionEnglish: An improvised barrier erected across a street or other thoroughfare to prevent or delay the movement of opposing forces.
exampleEnglish: The protesters built a barricade across the road.

meaning: ئاڵوگۆڕی کەلوپەل بە کەلوپەل (بێ پارە)
definition: Exchange (goods or services) for other goods or services without using money.
definitionEnglish: Exchange (goods or services) for other goods or services without using money.
exampleEnglish: They bartered their crops for tools.
exampleKurdish: بەرهەمە کشتوکاڵییەکانیان گۆڕییەوە بە کەلوپەلی کار.

meaning: شەرمن، کەمڕوو
definition: Reluctant to draw attention to oneself; shy.
definitionEnglish: Reluctant to draw attention to oneself; shy.
exampleEnglish: The young boy was very bashful around strangers.
exampleKurdish: کوڕە گەنجەکە زۆر شەرمن بوو لەگەڵ کەسانی نەناسدا.

meaning: خۆ دانە بەر (خۆر یان خۆشی)، چێژوەرگرتن
definition: Lie exposed to warmth and light, typically from the sun, for relaxation and pleasure; revel in and make the most of (something pleasing).
definitionEnglish: Lie exposed to warmth and light, typically from the sun, for relaxation and pleasure; revel in and make the most of (something pleasing).
exampleEnglish: The cat lay basking in the sun.
exampleKurdish: پشیلەکە خۆی دابوو بە بەر خۆرەکەدا.

meaning: قەڵا، پەناگە، پارێزەری باوەڕێک
definition: A projecting part of a fortification built at an angle to the line of a wall, so as to allow defensive fire in several directions; an institution, place, or person strongly defending or upholding particular principles, attitudes, or activities.
definitionEnglish: A projecting part of a fortification built at an angle to the line of a wall, so as to allow defensive fire in several directions; an institution, place, or person strongly defending or upholding particular principles, attitudes, or activities.
exampleEnglish: The university is a bastion of free speech.

meaning: کەمکردنەوە، هێورکردنەوە (بۆ هەناسە)
definition: Restrain or moderate (the force or intensity of something).
definitionEnglish: Restrain or moderate (the force or intensity of something).
exampleEnglish: We waited with bated breath for the results.
exampleKurdish: بە هەناسەیەکی هێورەوە چاوەڕێی ئەنجامەکانمان دەکرد.

meaning: شتی بێ بایەخ و ڕازاوە، وردەواڵە
definition: A small, showy trinket or decoration.
definitionEnglish: A small, showy trinket or decoration.
exampleEnglish: The Christmas tree was decorated with many baubles.
exampleKurdish: دارە سەری ساڵەکە بە چەندین وردەواڵەی ڕازاوە ڕازێنرابووەوە.

meaning: قسەی ناشرین، بێ ڕەوشتانە (بۆ گاڵتە)
definition: Dealing with sexual matters in a comical way; humorously indecent.
definitionEnglish: Dealing with sexual matters in a comical way; humorously indecent.
exampleEnglish: He told a bawdy joke that made everyone laugh.
exampleKurdish: گاڵتەیەکی ناشرینی کرد کە هەمووانی هێنایە پێکەنین.

meaning: تیشک، زەردەخەنەی گەورە، ستوونی بینا
definition: A long, sturdy piece of squared timber or metal spanning an opening or part of a building, typically to support the roof or floor above; a ray or shaft of light; smile radiantly.
definitionEnglish: A long, sturdy piece of squared timber or metal spanning an opening or part of a building, typically to support the roof or floor above; a ray or shaft of light; smile radiantly.
exampleEnglish: She beamed with pride when she received the award.
exampleKurdish: بە شانازییەوە زەردەخەنەی دەکرد کاتێک خەڵاتەکەی وەرگرت.

meaning: پڕ لە خۆشی و ئارامی، پیرۆز
definition: Blissfully happy.
definitionEnglish: Blissfully happy.
exampleEnglish: She had a beatific expression on her face.
exampleKurdish: دەربڕینێکی پڕ لە خۆشی و ئارامی لەسەر دەموچاوی هەبوو.

meaning: وپەڕی خۆشی، پیرۆزی
definition: Supreme blessedness.
definitionEnglish: Supreme blessedness.
exampleEnglish: The saint lived in a state of beatitude.
exampleKurdish: پیاوە چاکەکە لە دۆخێکی پیرۆز و پڕ لە خۆشیدا دەژیا.

meaning: ڕازاندنەوەی زۆر و ناشرین
definition: Dress up or decorate gaudily.
definitionEnglish: Dress up or decorate gaudily.
exampleEnglish: The room was bedizened with cheap decorations.
exampleKurdish: ژوورەکە بە ڕازاندنەوەیەکی زۆر و هەرزان ڕازێنرابووەوە.

meaning: پیسکردن بە قوڕ یان ئاو، شێواندن
definition: Dirty and disheveled.
definitionEnglish: Dirty and disheveled.
exampleEnglish: The rain had bedraggled her hair.

meaning: سەرلێشێواندن، تێکەڵکردنی مێشک
definition: Make (someone) unable to think clearly.
definitionEnglish: Make (someone) unable to think clearly.
exampleEnglish: The complex instructions befuddled the students.
exampleKurdish: ڕێنماییە ئاڵۆزەکان مێشکی قوتابییەکانیان تێکەڵ کرد.

meaning: بوونە هۆی، دروستکردن (بۆ منداڵ یان ئەنجام)
definition: (Especially of a male parent) bring (a child) into existence by the process of reproduction; give rise to; bring about.
definitionEnglish: (Especially of a male parent) bring (a child) into existence by the process of reproduction; give rise to; bring about.
exampleEnglish: Violence begets violence.

meaning: بە چاوپیسی سەیرکردن، حەز نەکردن بە خۆشی کەسێک
definition: Envy (someone) the possession or enjoyment of (something); give reluctantly or resentfully.
definitionEnglish: Envy (someone) the possession or enjoyment of (something); give reluctantly or resentfully.
exampleEnglish: I don't begrudge him his success.
exampleKurdish: من چاوپیسی لە سەرکەوتنەکەی ئەو ناکەم.

meaning: هەڵخەڵەتاندن بە جوانی یان زیرەکی، ڕاکێشان
definition: Charm or enchant (someone), sometimes in a deceptive way.
definitionEnglish: Charm or enchant (someone), sometimes in a deceptive way.
exampleEnglish: She beguiled him with her beauty.

meaning: شتی زەبەلاح و گەورە
definition: A huge or monstrous creature; something enormous, especially a big and powerful organization.
definitionEnglish: A huge or monstrous creature; something enormous, especially a big and powerful organization.
exampleEnglish: The company has grown into a global behemoth.
exampleKurdish: کۆمپانیاکە گەشەی کردووە بۆ شتێکی زەبەلاحی جیهانی.

meaning: قەرزاربار، سوپاسگوزار (بۆ چاکەیەک)
definition: Owing thanks or having a duty to someone in return for help or a service.
definitionEnglish: Owing thanks or having a duty to someone in return for help or a service.
exampleEnglish: I don't want to be beholden to anyone.

meaning: پێویست بوون، شیاو بوون
definition: It is a duty or responsibility for someone to do something; it is incumbent on.
definitionEnglish: It is a duty or responsibility for someone to do something; it is incumbent on.
exampleEnglish: It behooves us to think carefully before we act.
exampleKurdish: پێویستە لەسەرمان بە وردی بیر بکەینەوە پێش ئەوەی کار بکەین.

meaning: دووبارەکردنەوەی زۆری شتێک، هێرشکردنە سەر بە قسە
definition: Argue or elaborate (a subject) in excessive detail; attack or assault (someone) physically or verbally.
definitionEnglish: Argue or elaborate (a subject) in excessive detail; attack or assault (someone) physically or verbally.
exampleEnglish: There is no need to belabor the point.
exampleKurdish: پێویست ناکات بابەتەکە زۆر دووبارە بکرێتەوە.

meaning: دواکەوتوو
definition: Coming or happening later than should have been the case.
definitionEnglish: Coming or happening later than should have been the case.
exampleEnglish: Happy belated birthday!

meaning: دەورەدان، بێزارکردن بە کێشە
definition: Beset with difficulties; lay siege to.
definitionEnglish: Beset with difficulties; lay siege to.
exampleEnglish: The company is beleaguered by financial problems.
exampleKurdish: کۆمپانیاکە بەهۆی کێشە داراییەکانەوە دەورە دراوە.

meaning: پێچەوانە دەرخستن، شاردنەوەی ڕاستی
definition: (Of an appearance) fail to give a true notion or impression of (something); disguise or contradict.
definitionEnglish: (Of an appearance) fail to give a true notion or impression of (something); disguise or contradict.
exampleEnglish: His calm face belied his inner panic.

meaning: بچووککردنەوە، سووککردنی کەسێک یان شتێک
definition: Make (someone or something) seem unimportant.
definitionEnglish: Make (someone or something) seem unimportant.

definitionEnglish: A formal declaration that someone is guilty of a criminal offense, made by the verdict of a jury or the decision of a judge in a court of law.

meaning: خۆش مەشرەب، کەسێک کە حەزی لە ئاهەنگ و کۆبوونەوەی دۆستانەیە

definitionEnglish: (Of an atmosphere or event) friendly, lively, and enjoyable.

definitionEnglish: (Especially of an argument, story, or sentence) extremely complex and difficult to follow.

meaning: زۆر، تێروتەسەل، پڕ و فراوان

exampleKurdish: تێبینییەکی زۆری نووسی لە کاتی وانەکەدا.

meaning: ئافرەتێک کە حەزی لە ڕاکێشانی سەرنجی پیاوانە بەبێ مەبەستی جدی

definitionEnglish: A woman who flirts.

exampleKurdish: ئەو ئافرەتێکی سەرنجڕاکێش و دڵڕفێن بوو.

definition: Warm and friendly.

exampleKurdish: پیاوە قەڵەوەکە بە زەحمەت بە پلەکانەکاندا سەرکەوت.

exampleKurdish: پەیوەندییەکی بەهێز لە نێوان جگەرەکێشان و شێرپەنجەی سییەکاندا هەیە.

meaning: پشتڕاستکردنەوە، هێنانەوەی بەڵگە بۆ ڕاستی شتێک
definition: Confirm or give support to (a statement, theory, or finding).
definitionEnglish: Confirm or give support to (a statement, theory, or finding).

meaning: پێچاوپێچ، شێوەی شەپۆلاوی (بۆ کانزا یان کارتۆن)

exampleKurdish: سوپا کودەتایەکی ئەنجامدا بۆ ڕووخاندنی حکومەت.

meaning: جووت، دوو شت یان دوو کەس پێکەوە، لکاندن

definitionEnglish: Two people or things of the same sort considered together.

meaning: پەیماننامە، ڕێککەوتنی فەرمی و پیرۆز

exampleKurdish: ژنە پیرە ناشرینەکە بە تەنها لە دارستانەکەدا دەژیا.

definition: Responsibility for a fault or wrong; blame.
