exampleKurdish: هەوڵیاندا جرجەکانی ناو ژێرزەمینەکە بە تەواوی لەناو ببەن.

meaning: دەرەکی، شتێک کە لە دەرەوەی شتێکی ترە
definition: Belonging to or forming the outer surface or structure of something.
definitionEnglish: Belonging to or forming the outer surface or structure of something.
exampleEnglish: The external walls of the house are made of stone.
exampleKurdish: دیوارە دەرەکییەکانی خانوەکە لە بەرد دروستکراون.

meaning: قڕبوو، شتێک کە چیتر بوونی نەماوە (وەک جۆرە ئاژەڵێک)
definition: (Of a species, family, or other larger group) having no living members.
definitionEnglish: (Of a species, family, or other larger group) having no living members.
exampleEnglish: Dinosaurs became extinct millions of years ago.
exampleKurdish: دایناسۆرەکان ملیۆنان ساڵ لەمەوبەر قڕیان تێکەوت.

meaning: کوژاندنەوەی ئاگر یان هیوا
definition: Cause (a fire or light) to cease to burn or shine.
definitionEnglish: Cause (a fire or light) to cease to burn or shine.
exampleEnglish: Firefighters worked to extinguish the blaze.
exampleKurdish: ئاگرکوژێنەوەکان کاریان کرد بۆ کوژاندنەوەی ئاگرەکە.

meaning: لە ڕەگەوە دەرهێنان، لەناوبردنی تەواوەتی شتێکی خراپ
definition: Root out and destroy completely.
definitionEnglish: Root out and destroy completely.
exampleEnglish: The government is trying to extirpate corruption.
exampleKurdish: حکومەت هەوڵ دەدات گەندەڵی لە ڕەگەوە هەڵبکێشێت.

meaning: ستایشکردنی زۆر، پیاهەڵدان بە کەسێک یان شتێکدا
definition: Praise enthusiastically.
definitionEnglish: Praise enthusiastically.
exampleEnglish: He extolled the virtues of the new system.
exampleKurdish: ستایشی زۆری باشییەکانی سیستمە نوێیەکەی کرد.

meaning: سەندن، وەرگرتنی پارە یان زانیاری بە زۆر و هەڕەشە
definition: Obtain (something) by force, threats, or other unfair means.
definitionEnglish: Obtain (something) by force, threats, or other unfair means.
exampleEnglish: He was accused of trying to extort money from the company.
exampleKurdish: تۆمەتبار کرا بە هەوڵدان بۆ وەرگرتنی پارە لە کۆمپانیاکە بە زۆر.

meaning: سەندن بە زۆر، وەرگرتنی پارە بە هەڕەشە
definition: The practice of obtaining something, especially money, through force or threats.
definitionEnglish: The practice of obtaining something, especially money, through force or threats.
exampleEnglish: He was arrested for extortion.
exampleKurdish: بەهۆی وەرگرتنی پارە بە زۆر (extortion) دەستگیر کرا.

meaning: دەرهێنان، وەرگرتنی شتێک لە ناو شتێکی تردا
definition: Remove or take out, especially by effort or force.
definitionEnglish: Remove or take out, especially by effort or force.
exampleEnglish: The dentist had to extract the tooth.
exampleKurdish: پزیشکی ددانەکە ناچار بوو ددانەکە دەربهێنێت.

meaning: ڕادەستکردنەوەی تاوانبار بە وڵاتێکی تر
definition: Hand over (a person accused or convicted of a crime) to the jurisdiction of the foreign state in which the crime was committed.
definitionEnglish: Hand over (a person accused or convicted of a crime) to the jurisdiction of the foreign state in which the crime was committed.
exampleEnglish: The suspect was extradited to the UK.

meaning: زیادە، شتێک کە پەیوەندی بە بابەتەکەوە نییە و پێویست نییە
definition: Irrelevant or unrelated to the subject being dealt with.
definitionEnglish: Irrelevant or unrelated to the subject being dealt with.
exampleEnglish: We should remove all extraneous information from the report.
exampleKurdish: پێویستە هەموو زانیارییە زیادە و ناپەیوەندیدارەکان لە ڕاپۆرتەکە لابدەین.

meaning: پێشبینیکردن، بەکارهێنانی زانیاری هەبوو بۆ تێگەیشتن لە شتێکی نادیار
definition: Extend the application of (a method or conclusion, especially one based on statistics) to an unknown situation by assuming that existing trends will continue or similar methods will be applicable.
definitionEnglish: Extend the application of (a method or conclusion, especially one based on statistics) to an unknown situation by assuming that existing trends will continue or similar methods will be applicable.
exampleEnglish: It is difficult to extrapolate from such a small sample.
exampleKurdish: سەختە لە نموونەیەکی ئاوا بچووکەوە پێشبینی ئەنجامەکان بکەیت.

meaning: دەستبڵاوی، خەرجکردنی پارەیەکی زۆر بە شێوەیەکی بێ مانا
definition: Lack of restraint in spending money or use of resources.
definitionEnglish: Lack of restraint in spending money or use of resources.
exampleEnglish: His extravagance led to financial ruin.
exampleKurdish: دەستبڵاوییەکەی بووە هۆی تێکچوونی باری دارایی.

meaning: دەستبڵاو، کەسێک کە پارە زۆر خەرج دەکات
definition: Lacking restraint in spending money or using resources.
definitionEnglish: Lacking restraint in spending money or using resources.
exampleEnglish: She has extravagant tastes.
exampleKurdish: ئارەزووی لە شتی زۆر گرانبەها و دەستبڵاوییە.

meaning: ڕزگارکردن، دەرهێنانی کەسێک لە بارودۆخێکی سەخت یان شوێنێکی تەسک
definition: Free (someone or something) from a constraint or difficulty.
definitionEnglish: Free (someone or something) from a constraint or difficulty.
exampleEnglish: He managed to extricate himself from the difficult situation.
exampleKurdish: توانی خۆی لەو بارودۆخە سەختە ڕزگار بکات.

meaning: دەرەکی، شتێک کە بەشێکی سەرەکی نییە لە شتێک بەڵکو لە دەرەوەیە
definition: Not part of the essential nature of someone or something; coming or operating from outside.
definitionEnglish: Not part of the essential nature of someone or something; coming or operating from outside.
exampleEnglish: Extrinsic factors can influence the outcome.
exampleKurdish: هۆکارە دەرەکییەکان دەتوانن کاریگەرییان هەبێت لەسەر ئەنجامەکە.

meaning: کەسێکی کراوە، کەسێک کە حەزی لە تێکەڵبوونی خەڵکە
definition: An outgoing, socially confident person.
definitionEnglish: An outgoing, socially confident person.
exampleEnglish: She is an extrovert who loves meeting new people.
exampleKurdish: ئەو کەسێکی کراوەیە و حەزی لە ناسینی خەڵکی نوێیە.

meaning: گوشین، دەرکردنی شتێک بە هێز لە کونی بچووکەوە
definition: Thrust or force out.
definitionEnglish: Thrust or force out.
exampleEnglish: Lava was extruded from the volcano.

meaning: جۆش و خرۆشی زۆر، وزەیەکی زۆر و دڵخۆشی
definition: The quality of being full of energy, excitement, and cheerfulness; ebullience.
definitionEnglish: The quality of being full of energy, excitement, and cheerfulness; ebullience.
exampleEnglish: The children were full of exuberance.
exampleKurdish: منداڵەکان پڕ بوون لە جۆش و خرۆش و وزە.

meaning: پڕ لە وزە و جۆش و خرۆش، گەشاوە
definition: Filled with or characterized by a lively energy and excitement.
definitionEnglish: Filled with or characterized by a lively energy and excitement.
exampleEnglish: She gave an exuberant performance.
exampleKurdish: نمایشێکی پڕ لە وزە و جۆش و خرۆشی پێشکەش کرد.

meaning: دەردانی شتێک بە هێواشی (وەک بۆن یان متمانە)
definition: Discharge (a moisture or a smell) slowly and steadily.
definitionEnglish: Discharge (a moisture or a smell) slowly and steadily.
exampleEnglish: He exudes confidence.
exampleKurdish: متمانەیەکی زۆری پێوە دیارە (متمانەی لێ دەبارێت).

meaning: دڵخۆشییەکی زۆر بەهۆی سەرکەوتنەوە
definition: Show or feel elation or jubilation, especially as the result of a success.
definitionEnglish: Show or feel elation or jubilation, especially as the result of a success.
exampleEnglish: The team exulted in their victory.
exampleKurdish: تیمەکە زۆر دڵخۆش بوون بە سەرکەوتنەکەیان.

meaning: زۆر دڵخۆش، سەرکەوتوو و دڵشاد
definition: Triumphantly happy.
definitionEnglish: Triumphantly happy.
exampleEnglish: The exultant crowd cheered loudly.
exampleKurdish: جەماوەرە دڵخۆشەکە بە دەنگی بەرز هاواریان دەکرد.

meaning: دروستکردن، هەڵبەستنی درۆ یان بەڵگەی ساختە
definition: Invent or concoct (something), typically with deceitful intent.
definitionEnglish: Invent or concoct (something), typically with deceitful intent.
exampleEnglish: He fabricated a story to explain his absence.

meaning: ڕوکاری پێشەوەی بینا، ڕوکارێکی ساختە بۆ شاردنەوەی ڕاستی
definition: The face of a building, especially the principal front that looks onto a street or open space.
definitionEnglish: The face of a building, especially the principal front that looks onto a street or open space.
exampleEnglish: Behind her facade of confidence, she was very nervous.
exampleKurdish: لە پشت ڕوکارە پڕ لە متمانەکەیەوە، ئەو زۆر شڵەژابوو.

meaning: لایەن، ڕوویەکی شتێک (وەک لایەنێکی کێشەیەک یان لایەنێکی ئەڵماس)
definition: A particular aspect or feature of something.
definitionEnglish: A particular aspect or feature of something.
exampleEnglish: We need to consider every facet of the problem.
exampleKurdish: پێویستە هەموو لایەنەکانی کێشەکە ڕەچاو بکەین.

meaning: گاڵتەجاڕ، بەکارهێنانی گاڵتە لە کاتێکی نەگونجاودا
definition: Treating serious issues with deliberately inappropriate humor.
definitionEnglish: Treating serious issues with deliberately inappropriate humor.
exampleEnglish: Stop being facetious; this is a serious matter.
exampleKurdish: واز لە گاڵتەجاڕی بهێنە؛ ئەمە بابەتێکی جدییە.

meaning: سادە، شتێک کە زۆر بە ئاسانی دەکرێت بەبێ بیرکردنەوەی قووڵ
definition: (Especially of a theory or argument) appearing neat and comprehensive only by ignoring the true complexities of an issue; superficial.
definitionEnglish: (Especially of a theory or argument) appearing neat and comprehensive only by ignoring the true complexities of an issue; superficial.
exampleEnglish: He gave a facile explanation for the complex problem.
exampleKurdish: ڕوونکردنەوەیەکی سادە و سەرپێیی بۆ کێشە ئاڵۆزەکە دا.

meaning: ئاسانکردن، یارمەتیدانی پرۆسەیەک بۆ ئەوەی ئاسانتر بڕوات
definition: Make (an action or process) easy or easier.
definitionEnglish: Make (an action or process) easy or easier.
exampleEnglish: The new software will facilitate the data analysis.
exampleKurdish: سۆفتوێرە نوێیەکە شیکردنەوەی زانیارییەکان ئاسانتر دەکات.

meaning: کۆپییەکی تەواو، وێنەیەکی هاوشێوەی دەق یان وێنەیەک
definition: An exact copy, especially of written or printed material.
definitionEnglish: An exact copy, especially of written or printed material.
exampleEnglish: The museum has a facsimile of the original document.
exampleKurdish: مۆزەخانەکە کۆپییەکی تەواوی دەستنووسە ڕەسەنەکەی لایە.

meaning: باڵ، گروپێکی بچووک لە ناو گروپێکی گەورەدا کە بیروڕای جیاوازیان هەیە
definition: A small organized dissenting group within a larger one, especially in politics.
definitionEnglish: A small organized dissenting group within a larger one, especially in politics.
exampleEnglish: The party is split into several factions.
exampleKurdish: حزبەکە دابەش بووە بۆ چەند باڵێکی جیاواز.

meaning: ئاژاوەگێڕ، شتێک کە دەبێتە هۆی دروستبوونی گروپ و دووبەرەکی
definition: Relating or inclined to a state of faction.
definitionEnglish: Relating or inclined to a state of faction.
exampleEnglish: The factious nature of the committee made it difficult to reach a decision.
exampleKurdish: سروشتە دووبەرەکییەکەی لیژنەکە وای کرد گەیشتن بە بڕیار سەخت بێت.

meaning: ساختە، شتێک کە بە شێوەیەکی دەستکرد دروستکراوە نەک سروشتی
definition: Artificially created or developed.
definitionEnglish: Artificially created or developed.
exampleEnglish: The excitement was factitious and didn't last long.
exampleKurdish: جۆش و خرۆشەکە ساختە بوو و زۆری نەخایاند.

meaning: زانیارییەکی ساختە کە وەک ڕاستی بڵاودەکرێتەوە، زانیارییەکی بچووک و بێ مانا
definition: An item of unreliable information that is reported and repeated so often that it becomes accepted as fact.
definitionEnglish: An item of unreliable information that is reported and repeated so often that it becomes accepted as fact.
exampleEnglish: The internet is full of factoids that aren't actually true.
exampleKurdish: ئینتەرنێت پڕە لە زانیاری ساختە کە لە ڕاستیدا دروست نین.

meaning: کارگوزار، کەسێک کە هەموو جۆرە کارێک بۆ کەسێکی تر دەکات
definition: A person employed to do all kinds of work.
definitionEnglish: A person employed to do all kinds of work.
exampleEnglish: He is the manager's factotum, handling everything from schedules to coffee.
exampleKurdish: ئەو کارگوزاری بەڕێوەبەرەکەیە و هەموو شتێک ڕادەپەڕێنێت لە خشتەی کارەوە تا قاوە.

meaning: توانای مێشک یان جەستە، بەشێکی زانکۆ، مامۆستایانی زانکۆ
definition: An inherent mental or physical power.
definitionEnglish: An inherent mental or physical power.
exampleEnglish: He has a remarkable faculty for learning languages.
exampleKurdish: توانایەکی ناوازەی هەیە بۆ فێربوونی زمان.

meaning: هەڵە، چەواشەکار، شتێک کە لەسەر بنەمایەکی هەڵە دروستکراوە
definition: Based on a mistaken belief.
definitionEnglish: Based on a mistaken belief.
exampleEnglish: The argument is fallacious and misleading.

meaning: باوەڕی هەڵە، هەڵەی لۆژیکی
definition: A mistaken belief, especially one based on unsound argument.
definitionEnglish: A mistaken belief, especially one based on unsound argument.
exampleEnglish: It is a fallacy to think that more money always leads to more happiness.
exampleKurdish: باوەڕێکی هەڵەیە کە وابزانیت پارەی زیاتر هەمیشە دەبێتە هۆی خۆشی زیاتر.

meaning: هەڵەکار، کەسێک یان شتێک کە دەکرێت هەڵە بکات
definition: Capable of making mistakes or being erroneous.
definitionEnglish: Capable of making mistakes or being erroneous.
exampleEnglish: Human beings are fallible.

meaning: زەوی بێ کێڵ، زەوییەک کە بۆ ماوەیەک بەبێ چاندن جێهێڵراوە
definition: (Of farmland) plowed and harrowed but left unsown for a period in order to restore its fertility as part of a crop rotation or to avoid surplus production.
definitionEnglish: (Of farmland) plowed and harrowed but left unsown for a period in order to restore its fertility as part of a crop rotation or to avoid surplus production.
exampleEnglish: The field was left fallow for a year.
exampleKurdish: کێڵگەکە بۆ ماوەی ساڵێک بەبێ چاندن جێهێڵرا.

meaning: دوودڵ بوون، لەرزین، نەمانی هێز و متمانە لە کاتی قسەکردن یان ڕۆشتن
definition: Lose strength or momentum.
definitionEnglish: Lose strength or momentum.
exampleEnglish: His voice faltered as he spoke about his loss.
exampleKurdish: دەنگی لەرزی کاتێک باسی لەدەستدانی کەسە نزیکەکەی دەکرد.

meaning: توندڕەو، کەسێک کە زۆر پەرۆشی بیرۆکەیەکە بە شێوەیەکی نالۆژیکی
definition: A person filled with excessive and single-minded zeal, especially for an extreme religious or political cause.
definitionEnglish: A person filled with excessive and single-minded zeal, especially for an extreme religious or political cause.
exampleEnglish: He is a religious fanatic.

meaning: توندڕەوی، پەرۆشییەکی زۆر و نالۆژیکی
definition: The quality of being fanatical.
definitionEnglish: The quality of being fanatical.
exampleEnglish: His fanaticism led him to commit violent acts.
exampleKurdish: توندڕەوییەکەی وای لێکرد کارە توندوتیژەکان ئەنجام بدات.

meaning: خەیاڵی، شتێک کە لەسەر بنەمای خەیاڵە نەک ڕاستی
definition: (Of a person or their thoughts and ideas) over-imaginative and unrealistic.
definitionEnglish: (Of a person or their thoughts and ideas) over-imaginative and unrealistic.
exampleEnglish: He has some fanciful ideas about the future.
exampleKurdish: هەندێک بیرۆکەی خەیاڵی هەیە دەربارەی داهاتوو.

meaning: دەنگی شەیپوور، ئاهەنگ و دەنگەدەنگێکی زۆر بۆ ڕاگەیاندنی شتێک
definition: A short ceremonial tune or flourish played on brass instruments, typically to introduce something or someone important.
definitionEnglish: A short ceremonial tune or flourish played on brass instruments, typically to introduce something or someone important.
exampleEnglish: The new product was launched with great fanfare.
exampleKurdish: بەرهەمە نوێیەکە بە ئاهەنگ و دەنگەدەنگێکی زۆرەوە ڕاگەیەندرا.

meaning: پێکەنیناوی و بێ مانا، شتێک کە ئاوا خراپە دەبێتە هۆی پێکەنین
definition: Relating to or resembling farce, especially because of absurd or ridiculous aspects.
definitionEnglish: Relating to or resembling farce, especially because of absurd or ridiculous aspects.
exampleEnglish: The whole situation was farcical.
exampleKurdish: هەموو بارودۆخەکە بێ مانا و پێکەنیناوی بوو.

meaning: زۆر وردبین، کەسێک کە زۆر گرنگی بە وردەکاری و پاکوخاوێنی دەدات
definition: Very attentive to and concerned about accuracy and detail.
definitionEnglish: Very attentive to and concerned about accuracy and detail.
exampleEnglish: He is very fastidious about his appearance.
exampleKurdish: ئەو زۆر وردبین و گرنگیدەرە بە شێوەی دەرەوەی.

meaning: قەدەرگەرایی، باوەڕبوون بەوەی هەموو شتێک پێشوەختە بڕیاری لێدراوە و ناتوانرێت بگۆڕدرێت
definition: The belief that all events are predetermined and therefore inevitable.
definitionEnglish: The belief that all events are predetermined and therefore inevitable.
exampleEnglish: His fatalism made him feel that there was no point in trying to change things.
exampleKurdish: قەدەرگەراییەکەی وای لێکرد هەست بکات هیچ سوودێکی نییە هەوڵ بدات شتەکان بگۆڕێت.

meaning: تێگەیشتن، پێوانەکردنی قووڵی ئاو
definition: Understand (a difficult problem or an enigmatic person) after much thought.
definitionEnglish: Understand (a difficult problem or an enigmatic person) after much thought.
exampleEnglish: I can't fathom why he would do such a thing.
exampleKurdish: ناتوانم تێبگەم بۆچی کارێکی ئاوای کرد.

meaning: بێ بن، شتێک کە ئاوا قووڵە ناتوانرێت پێوانە بکرێت
definition: Unable to be measured or understood; extremely deep.
definitionEnglish: Unable to be measured or understood; extremely deep.
exampleEnglish: She looked into the fathomless depths of the ocean.
exampleKurdish: سەیری قووڵاییە بێ بنەکەی ئۆقیانووسەکەی کرد.

meaning: گەمژانە، بێ مانا و بێ عەقڵانە
definition: Silly and pointless.
definitionEnglish: Silly and pointless.
exampleEnglish: He made a fatuous remark about the weather.
exampleKurdish: وتەیەکی گەمژانە و بێ مانای دەربارەی کەشوهەوا گوت.

meaning: ئاژەڵانی ناوچەیەک یان سەردەمێکی دیاریکراو
definition: The animals of a particular region, habitat, or geological period.
definitionEnglish: The animals of a particular region, habitat, or geological period.
exampleEnglish: The island has a unique fauna.
exampleKurdish: دوورگەکە ئاژەڵانی تایبەت و بێ وێنەی هەیە.

meaning: ماستاوچی، نیشاندانی ڕێز و خۆشەویستی زۆر بۆ بەدەستهێنانی بەرژەوەندی
definition: Displaying exaggerated flattery or affection; obsequious.
definitionEnglish: Displaying exaggerated flattery or affection; obsequious.
exampleEnglish: She was surrounded by fawning admirers.
exampleKurdish: بە دەورەدراو بوو بە هەوادارە ماستاوچییەکانی.

meaning: گونجاو، شتێک کە دەکرێت ئەنجام بدرێت
definition: Possible to do easily or conveniently.
definitionEnglish: Possible to do easily or conveniently.
exampleEnglish: It is not feasible to complete the project in one week.
exampleKurdish: گونجاو نییە پڕۆژەکە لە ماوەی یەک هەفتەدا تەواو بکرێت.

meaning: گونجاوی، ئەگەری ئەنجامدانی کارێک
definition: The state or degree of being easily or conveniently done.
definitionEnglish: The state or degree of being easily or conveniently done.
exampleEnglish: We need to conduct a feasibility study before we start.
exampleKurdish: پێویستە لێکۆڵینەوەیەکی گونجاوی (feasibility study) ئەنجام بدەین پێش ئەوەی دەستپێبکەین.

meaning: کارێکی گەورە، دەستکەوتێکی گرنگ کە پێویستی بە ئازایەتی یان لێهاتووییە
definition: An achievement that requires great courage, skill, or strength.
definitionEnglish: An achievement that requires great courage, skill, or strength.
exampleEnglish: Climbing Mount Everest is a remarkable feat.

definitionEnglish: (Of a light or source of light) shine unsteadily; vary rapidly in brightness.

definitionEnglish: Having a red or flushed complexion.

meaning: ناجێگیر بوون، گۆڕانی بەردەوام لە نێوان دوو ئاستدا
definition: Rise and fall irregularly in number or amount.

exampleKurdish: نرخی نەوت ڕۆژانە دەگۆڕێت و ناجێگیرە.

definitionEnglish: (Of a person's face) become red and hot, typically as the result of illness or strong emotion.

definitionEnglish: Prevent (something considered wrong or undesirable) from succeeding.

exampleKurdish: چاوپێکەوتنەکە تەنها ڕێکارێکی فەرمی بوو (بڕیارەکە پێشوەختە درابوو).

definition: Agree to give up or do without (something).
definitionEnglish: Agree to give up or do without (something).

definitionEnglish: An alphabetical list of terms or words found in or relating to a specific subject, text, or dialect, with explanations; a brief dictionary.

exampleKurdish: سەیری فەرهەنگۆکەکە بکە بۆ زانینی مانای وشە تەکنیکییەکان.

meaning: بریقەدار، لووس و گەش
definition: Shiny and smooth.
definitionEnglish: Shiny and smooth.
exampleEnglish: The magazine has glossy pages.

meaning: سەیرکردنێکی توڕە و مۆن
definition: Have an angry or sullen look on one's face; scowl.
definitionEnglish: Have an angry or sullen look on one's face; scowl.
exampleEnglish: He glowered at me from across the room.
exampleKurdish: لەو سەری ژوورەکەوە بە توڕەیی سەیری کردم.

meaning: زۆری، بڕێکی زۆر لە شتێک کە لە پێداویستی زیاترە
definition: An excessively abundant supply of something.
definitionEnglish: An excessively abundant supply of something.
exampleEnglish: There is a glut of oil on the market.
exampleKurdish: بڕێکی زۆر لە نەوت لە بازاڕدا هەیە (زیاتر لەوەی پێویستە).

meaning: پێوەنووساو، وەک هەویر یان چەسپ
definition: Like glue in texture; sticky.
definitionEnglish: Like glue in texture; sticky.
exampleEnglish: The rice was glutinous and sticky.
exampleKurdish: برنجەکە وەک هەویر پێوەنووساو و چەسپاو بوو.

meaning: چڵێس، کەسێک کە زۆر دەخوات
definition: An excessively greedy eater.
definitionEnglish: An excessively greedy eater.
exampleEnglish: He is a glutton for punishment.
exampleKurdish: ئەو کەسێکە کە ئارەزووی لە ناخۆشی و سزایە (ئیدیۆمە).

meaning: چڵێسی، زیادەڕۆیی لە خواردندا
definition: Habitual greed or excess in eating.
definitionEnglish: Habitual greed or excess in eating.
exampleEnglish: Gluttony is considered a sin in many cultures.
exampleKurdish: چڵێسی لە زۆر کلتووردا بە گوناهـ دادەنرێت.

meaning: گرێ گرێ، شێواو و ڕەق (بەتایبەت بۆ دار یان دەستی مرۆڤ)
definition: Knotted, rough, and twisted, especially with age.
definitionEnglish: Knotted, rough, and twisted, especially with age.
exampleEnglish: The old oak tree had gnarled branches.
exampleKurdish: دارە بەڕووە کۆنەکە لقی گرێ گرێ و شێواوی هەبوو.

meaning: پەیکەری بچووکی ناو باخچە، بوونەوەرێکی ئەفسانەیی بچووک
definition: A legendary dwarfish creature supposed to guard the earth's treasures underground.
definitionEnglish: A legendary dwarfish creature supposed to guard the earth's treasures underground.
exampleEnglish: There were garden gnomes on the lawn.
exampleKurdish: پەیکەری بچووکی باخچە (gnomes) لەسەر چیمەنەکە هەبوون.

meaning: هاندان، بێزارکردنی کەسێک بۆ ئەوەی کارێک بکات
definition: Provoke or annoy (someone) so as to stimulate some action or reaction.
definitionEnglish: Provoke or annoy (someone) so as to stimulate some action or reaction.
exampleEnglish: He goaded his brother into a fight.
exampleKurdish: براکەی هان دا بۆ ئەوەی شەڕ بکات.

meaning: دۆڵێکی قووڵ و تەسک، زۆرخۆری بە شێوەیەکی چڵێسانە
definition: A narrow valley between hills or mountains, typically with steep rocky walls and a stream running through it.
definitionEnglish: A narrow valley between hills or mountains, typically with steep rocky walls and a stream running through it.
exampleEnglish: The river runs through a deep gorge.
exampleKurdish: ڕووبارەکە بە ناو دۆڵێکی قووڵ و تەسکدا تێدەپەڕێت.

meaning: زۆر جوان، سەرنجڕاکێش و نایاب
definition: Beautiful; very attractive.
definitionEnglish: Beautiful; very attractive.
exampleEnglish: She looked gorgeous in her new dress.
exampleKurdish: بە جلی نوێیەوە زۆر جوان دەهاتە بەرچاو.

meaning: خوێناوی، پڕ لە توندوتیژی و خوێنڕشتن
definition: Involving or showing violence and bloodshed.
definitionEnglish: Involving or showing violence and bloodshed.
exampleEnglish: The movie was too gory for my taste.
exampleKurdish: فیلمەکە زۆر خوێناوی بوو بۆ من (بە دڵم نەبوو).

meaning: زۆر تەنک و سووک (وەک تاری جاڵجاڵۆکە)
definition: A fine, filmy substance consisting of cobwebs spun by small spiders, which is seen especially in autumn.
definitionEnglish: A fine, filmy substance consisting of cobwebs spun by small spiders, which is seen especially in autumn.
exampleEnglish: The butterfly had gossamer wings.
exampleKurdish: پەپوولەکە باڵێکی زۆر تەنک و سووکی هەبوو.

meaning: کەندنی قوڵایی، زیادەڕۆیی لە نرخدا، بریندارکردنی چاو بە پەنجە
definition: Make a rough hole or indentation in (something), especially with a sharp tool or the thumb.
definitionEnglish: Make a rough hole or indentation in (something), especially with a sharp tool or the thumb.
exampleEnglish: He used a chisel to gouge a hole in the wood.
exampleKurdish: ئامرازێکی بەکارهێنا بۆ کەندنی کونی ناو دارەکە.

meaning: کەسێک کە زۆر حەزی لە خواردنە و زۆر دەخوات
definition: A person who enjoys eating and often eats too much.
definitionEnglish: A person who enjoys eating and often eats too much.
exampleEnglish: He is a bit of a gourmand.
exampleKurdish: ئەو کەمێک زۆرخۆر و حەز لە خواردنە.

meaning: کەسێک کە شارەزایە لە خواردنی باش و نایاب، خواردنی کوالێتی بەرز
definition: A connoisseur of good food; a person with a discerning palate.
definitionEnglish: A connoisseur of good food; a person with a discerning palate.
exampleEnglish: He is a gourmet chef.

meaning: پلەبەندی کراو، گۆڕانکاری وردە وردە لە ڕەنگ یان قەبارەدا
definition: Arranged in steps or degrees.
definitionEnglish: Arranged in steps or degrees.
exampleEnglish: The colors were gradated from light to dark.
exampleKurdish: ڕەنگەکان لە کاڵەوە بۆ تۆخ پلەبەندی کرابوون.

meaning: لێژی، ڕێژەی بەرزبوونەوە یان نزمبوونەوەی ڕێگەیەک
definition: An inclined part of a road or railway; a slope.
definitionEnglish: An inclined part of a road or railway; a slope.
exampleEnglish: The road has a steep gradient.

meaning: وردە وردە، شتێک کە بە هێواشی و بە قۆناغ ڕوودەدات
definition: Taking place or progressing slowly or by degrees.
definitionEnglish: Taking place or progressing slowly or by degrees.
exampleEnglish: There has been a gradual improvement in his health.
exampleKurdish: باشتربوونێکی وردە وردە لە تەندروستیدا هەبووە.

meaning: پێوەنکردنی ڕووەک، گواستنەوەی پێست، گەندەڵی و وەرگرتنی پارەی نایاسایی
definition: A shoot or twig inserted into a slit on the trunk or stem of a living plant, from which it receives sap.
definitionEnglish: A shoot or twig inserted into a slit on the trunk or stem of a living plant, from which it receives sap.
exampleEnglish: The surgeon performed a skin graft.
exampleKurdish: پزیشکەکە نەشتەرگەری گواستنەوەی پێستی (skin graft) ئەنجام دا.

meaning: گەورەیی، شکۆ، دیمەنێکی زۆر نایاب و سەرنجڕاکێش
definition: Splendor and impressiveness, especially of appearance or style.
definitionEnglish: Splendor and impressiveness, especially of appearance or style.
exampleEnglish: We were impressed by the grandeur of the mountains.
exampleKurdish: بە شکۆ و گەورەیی چیاکان سەرسام بووین.

meaning: قسەی زەبەلاح و پڕ لە وشەی قورس بۆ نیشاندانی خۆ، قسەی لووت بەرزانە
definition: Pompous or extravagant in language, style, or manner, especially in a way that is intended to impress.
definitionEnglish: Pompous or extravagant in language, style, or manner, especially in a way that is intended to impress.
exampleEnglish: He made a grandiloquent speech about his achievements.
exampleKurdish: وتارێکی پڕ لە وشەی قورس و خۆپەسندانەی دەربارەی دەستکەوتەکانی پێشکەش کرد.

meaning: زۆر گەورە و شکۆدار (زۆرجار بە شێوەیەکی زیادەڕۆ و ناپێویست)
definition: Impressive and imposing in appearance or style, especially pretentiously so.
definitionEnglish: Impressive and imposing in appearance or style, especially pretentiously so.
exampleEnglish: He has grandiose plans for the future.
exampleKurdish: پلانی زۆر گەورە و خەیاڵاوی بۆ داهاتوو هەیە.

meaning: کردن بە دەنکۆڵە، دروستکردنی شتێک بە شێوەی دەنکۆڵەی بچووک
definition: Form into grains or particles.
definitionEnglish: Form into grains or particles.
exampleEnglish: The sugar is granulated.

meaning: وێنەیی، ڕوون و ئاشکرا (بەتایبەت بۆ وەسفکردنی توندوتیژی)
definition: Relating to visual art, especially drawing, design, and lettering.
definitionEnglish: Relating to visual art, especially drawing, design, and lettering.
exampleEnglish: The report gave a graphic description of the accident.
exampleKurdish: ڕاپۆرتەکە وەسفێکی زۆر ڕوون و ئاشکرای ڕووداوەکەی کرد.

meaning: زۆرانبازی، هەوڵدان بۆ چارەسەرکردنی کێشەیەکی قورس
definition: Engage in a close fight or struggle without weapons; wrestle.
definitionEnglish: Engage in a close fight or struggle without weapons; wrestle.
exampleEnglish: The government is grappling with the problem of unemployment.
exampleKurdish: حکومەت خەریکی هەوڵدانە بۆ چارەسەرکردنی کێشەی بێکاری.

meaning: ڕنین (وەک ڕنینی پەنیر)، دەنگێکی ناخۆش و بێزارکەر، بێزارکردنی کەسێک
definition: Reduce (something, especially food) to small shreds by rubbing it on a grater.
definitionEnglish: Reduce (something, especially food) to small shreds by rubbing it on a grater.
exampleEnglish: His voice really grates on me.

meaning: خۆشحاڵکردن، تێرکردنی ئارەزوویەک یان پێداویستییەک
definition: Give (someone) pleasure or satisfaction.
definitionEnglish: Give (someone) pleasure or satisfaction.
exampleEnglish: It was gratifying to see the results of our hard work.
exampleKurdish: خۆشحاڵکەر بوو کە ئەنجامی کارە قورسەکەمان بینی.

meaning: بە خۆڕایی، بێ بەرامبەر
definition: Without charge; free.
definitionEnglish: Without charge; free.
exampleEnglish: The software is available gratis.

meaning: بێ هۆکار، ناپێویست (بەتایبەت بۆ شتی خراپ وەک توندوتیژی)
definition: Done without good reason; uncalled for.
definitionEnglish: Done without good reason; uncalled for.
exampleEnglish: The movie contained a lot of gratuitous violence.
exampleKurdish: فیلمەکە توندوتیژییەکی زۆری ناپێویست و بێ هۆکاری تێدا بوو.

meaning: بەخشیش، بڕە پارەیەک کە وەک سوپاسگوزاری دەدرێت
definition: A tip given to a waiter, taxi driver, etc.
definitionEnglish: A tip given to a waiter, taxi driver, etc.
exampleEnglish: The service charge includes a gratuity.

meaning: کێشکردن، جدییەت و گرنگی زۆر
definition: The force that attracts a body toward the center of the earth, or toward any other physical body having mass.
definitionEnglish: The force that attracts a body toward the center of the earth, or toward any other physical body having mass.
exampleEnglish: I don't think you realize the gravity of the situation.
exampleKurdish: پێموانییە لە جدییەت و مەترسی بارودۆخەکە تێگەیشتبیت.

meaning: لەوەڕاندنی ئاژەڵ، برینداربوونی پێست بە لێکخشاندن، دەستلێدانی سووک لە کاتی تێپەڕبووندا
definition: (Of cattle, sheep, etc.) eat grass in a field.
definitionEnglish: (Of cattle, sheep, etc.) eat grass in a field.
exampleEnglish: The cows were grazing in the meadow.

meaning: کۆمەڵایەتی، کەسێک کە حەزی لە تێکەڵبوونی خەڵکە
definition: (Of a person) fond of company; sociable.
definitionEnglish: (Of a person) fond of company; sociable.
exampleEnglish: She is a gregarious person who loves parties.
exampleKurdish: ئەو کەسێکی کۆمەڵایەتییە و حەزی لە ئاهەنگە.

meaning: سکاڵا، ناڕەزایەتی بەهۆی هەستکردن بە نادادپەروەری
definition: A real or imagined wrong or other cause for complaint or protest, especially unfair treatment.
definitionEnglish: A real or imagined wrong or other cause for complaint or protest, especially unfair treatment.
exampleEnglish: He has a grievance against his employer.

meaning: برژاندن، پرسیارکردنی زۆر و توند لە کەسێک بۆ زانینی ڕاستی
definition: A device on a cooker that radiates heat downward for cooking food.
definitionEnglish: A device on a cooker that radiates heat downward for cooking food.
exampleEnglish: The police grilled the suspect for hours.
exampleKurdish: پۆلیس بۆ ماوەی چەندین کاتژمێر پرسیاری توندیان لە تۆمەتبارەکە کرد.

meaning: گرژکردنی دەموچاو بەهۆی ئازار یان بێزارییەوە
definition: An ugly, twisted expression on a person's face, typically expressing disgust, pain, or wry amusement.
definitionEnglish: An ugly, twisted expression on a person's face, typically expressing disgust, pain, or wry amusement.
exampleEnglish: She made a grimace of pain.

meaning: پیسی و چەوری کۆنبوو لەسەر شتێک
definition: Dirt ingrained on the surface of something, especially clothing or a building.
definitionEnglish: Dirt ingrained on the surface of something, especially clothing or a building.
exampleEnglish: The windows were covered in grime.
exampleKurdish: پەنجەرەکان بە پیسی و چەوری داپۆشرابوون.

meaning: ترسناک و قێزەون (بەتایبەت بۆ ڕووداوی خوێناوی)
definition: Causing horror or disgust.
definitionEnglish: Causing horror or disgust.
exampleEnglish: The scene of the crime was grisly.
exampleKurdish: شوێنی تاوانەکە زۆر ترسناک و قێزەون بوو.

meaning: خۆڵ و وردە بەرد، ئازایەتی و خۆڕاگری لە کاتی ناخۆشیدا
definition: Small loose particles of stone or sand.
definitionEnglish: Small loose particles of stone or sand.
exampleEnglish: It takes a lot of grit to succeed in this business.
exampleKurdish: خۆڕاگرییەکی زۆری دەوێت بۆ سەرکەوتن لەم کارەدا.

meaning: سەیر و ترسناک، شێواو بە شێوەیەکی قێزەون
definition: Comically or repulsively ugly or distorted.
definitionEnglish: Comically or repulsively ugly or distorted.
exampleEnglish: The statue was a grotesque figure.
exampleKurdish: پەیکەرەکە شێوەیەکی سەیر و ترسناکی هەبوو.

meaning: ئەشکەوتی بچووک و جوان (زۆرجار دەستکرد)
definition: A small picturesque cave, especially an artificial one in a park or garden.
definitionEnglish: A small picturesque cave, especially an artificial one in a park or garden.
exampleEnglish: The garden has a small grotto.
exampleKurdish: باخچەکە ئەشکەوتێکی بچووک و جوانی تێدایە.

meaning: کەسێکی مۆن و ناڕازی، بۆڵەبۆڵکردن
definition: A habitually grumpy person.
definitionEnglish: A habitually grumpy person.
exampleEnglish: He is such a grouch in the mornings.
exampleKurdish: ئەو بەیانیان زۆر مۆن و بۆڵەبۆڵکەرە.

meaning: بۆڵەبۆڵکردن، سکاڵاکردن لەسەر شتی بچووک
definition: Complain pettily; grumble.
definitionEnglish: Complain pettily; grumble.
exampleEnglish: She is always grousing about the weather.

meaning: خۆبچووککردنەوە، پاڕانەوە بە شێوەیەکی نزم بۆ بەدەستهێنانی لێبوردن یان سوود
definition: Lie or move abjectly on the ground with one's face downward.
definitionEnglish: Lie or move abjectly on the ground with one's face downward.
exampleEnglish: I'm not going to grovel to him for a job.
exampleKurdish: من خۆم بۆ ئەو بچووک ناکەمەوە بۆ بەدەستهێنانی کارێک.

meaning: بە ناچاری، شتێک کە بە دڵخۆشییەوە ناکرێت
definition: Given, granted, or allowed only reluctantly or resentfully.
definitionEnglish: Given, granted, or allowed only reluctantly or resentfully.
exampleEnglish: He gave a grudging apology.

meaning: زۆر ماندووکەر و تاقەتپڕوکێن
definition: Extremely tiring and demanding.
definitionEnglish: Extremely tiring and demanding.
exampleEnglish: It was a grueling race.

meaning: ترسناک و قێزەون (بەتایبەت بۆ مردن یان برین)
definition: Causing repulsion or horror; grisly.
definitionEnglish: Causing repulsion or horror; grisly.
exampleEnglish: The police found gruesome evidence at the scene.
exampleKurdish: پۆلیس بەڵگەی ترسناک و قێزەونیان لە شوێنەکە دۆزییەوە.

meaning: دەنگێکی گڕ و نزم، مامەڵەیەکی سارد و کەمێک زبر
definition: (Of a voice) rough and low in pitch.
definitionEnglish: (Of a voice) rough and low in pitch.
exampleEnglish: He has a gruff voice.

meaning: پێکەنینێکی زۆر و بەدەنگ
definition: A loud and boisterous laugh.
definitionEnglish: A loud and boisterous laugh.
exampleEnglish: He let out a loud guffaw.
exampleKurdish: پێکەنینێکی زۆر و بەدەنگی لێوە هات.

meaning: فێڵ و تەڵەکە، زیرەکی لە فێڵکردندا بۆ بەدەستهێنانی شتێک
definition: Sly or cunning intelligence.
definitionEnglish: Sly or cunning intelligence.
exampleEnglish: He used his guile to get what he wanted.
exampleKurdish: فێڵ و تەڵەکەی بەکارهێنا بۆ بەدەستهێنانی ئەوەی دەیویست.

meaning: بێ فێڵ، ڕاستگۆ و سادە، کەسێک کە فێڵ نازانێت
definition: Devoid of guile; innocent and without deception.
definitionEnglish: Devoid of guile; innocent and without deception.
exampleEnglish: She has a guileless nature.
exampleKurdish: سروشتێکی بێ فێڵ و ڕاستگۆی هەیە.

meaning: شێوە، ڕواڵەت (بەتایبەت کاتێک شتێکی تر دەشارێتەوە)
definition: An external form, appearance, or manner of presentation, typically concealing the true nature of something.
definitionEnglish: An external form, appearance, or manner of presentation, typically concealing the true nature of something.
exampleEnglish: He visited the country in the guise of a tourist.
exampleKurdish: بە ڕواڵەتی گەشتیارێک سەردانی وڵاتەکەی کرد (بەڵام مەبەستێکی تری هەبوو).

meaning: زووباوەڕ، کەسێک کە زوو فێڵی لێ دەکرێت
definition: Easily persuaded to believe something; credulous.
definitionEnglish: Easily persuaded to believe something; credulous.
exampleEnglish: He is very gullible and will believe anything you tell him.
exampleKurdish: ئەو زۆر زووباوەڕە و هەرچییەکی پێ بڵێیت باوەڕ دەکات.

meaning: پەیوەندیدار بە هەستی چێژکردنەوە
definition: Concerned with the sense of taste.
definitionEnglish: Concerned with the sense of taste.
exampleEnglish: The meal was a gustatory delight.
exampleKurdish: ژەمە خواردنەکە چێژێکی زۆری هەبوو بۆ هەستی چێژکردن.

meaning: جۆش و خرۆش، چێژوەرگرتنی زۆر لە ئەنجامدانی کارێک
definition: Enjoyment or vigor in doing something; zest.
definitionEnglish: Enjoyment or vigor in doing something; zest.
exampleEnglish: They sang with great gusto.
exampleKurdish: بە جۆش و خرۆشێکی زۆرەوە گۆرانییان دەگوت.

meaning: بای بەهێز و پچڕپچڕ
definition: Characterized by or blowing in gusts.
definitionEnglish: Characterized by or blowing in gusts.
exampleEnglish: It was a cold, gusty day.
exampleKurdish: ڕۆژێکی سارد و پڕ لە بای بەهێز بوو.

meaning: ئامێرێک بۆ پاراستنی هاوسەنگی و ئاراستە
definition: A device consisting of a wheel or disk mounted so that it can spin rapidly about an axis which is itself free to alter in direction.
definitionEnglish: A device consisting of a wheel or disk mounted so that it can spin rapidly about an axis which is itself free to alter in direction.
exampleEnglish: The airplane uses a gyroscope for navigation.
exampleKurdish: فڕۆکەکە ئامێری (gyroscope) بەکاردەهێنێت بۆ دیاریکردنی ئاراستە.

meaning: ڕاهاتن، فێربوونی شتێک وەک خوو
definition: Make or become accustomed or used to something.
definitionEnglish: Make or become accustomed or used to something.
exampleEnglish: The animals have become habituated to humans.

meaning: دووبارە و بێزارکەر، وتەیەک کە ئاوا زۆر بەکارهێنراوە مانای نەماوە
definition: (Of a phrase or idea) lacking significance through having been overused; unoriginal and trite.
definitionEnglish: (Of a phrase or idea) lacking significance through having been overused; unoriginal and trite.
exampleEnglish: The plot of the movie was very hackneyed.
exampleKurdish: چیرۆکی فیلمەکە زۆر دووبارە و بێزارکەر بوو.

meaning: ماندوو و ڕەنگپەڕیو (بەهۆی خەم یان نەخۆشییەوە)
definition: Looking exhausted and unwell, especially from fatigue, worry, or suffering.
definitionEnglish: Looking exhausted and unwell, especially from fatigue, worry, or suffering.
