meaning: شەهید، کەسێک کە دەکوژرێت یان ئازار دەچێژێت بەهۆی بیروباوەڕی ئایینی یان سیاسییەوە
definition: A person who is killed because of their religious or other beliefs.
definitionEnglish: A person who is killed because of their religious or other beliefs.
exampleEnglish: He died as a martyr for the cause.
exampleKurdish: وەک شەهیدێک لە پێناو دۆزەکەدا گیانی سپارد.

meaning: کەسێک کە چێژ لە ئازارچێژان دەبینێت
definition: A person who derives gratification from their own pain or humiliation.
definitionEnglish: A person who derives gratification from their own pain or humiliation.
exampleEnglish: He is a bit of a masochist to work such long hours.
exampleKurdish: ئەو تۆزێک حەزی لە ئازارە (مازۆخییە) کە هێندە کاتژمێری زۆر کار دەکات.

meaning: جوون، جوینی خواردن بە ددان
definition: Chew (food).
definitionEnglish: Chew (food).
exampleEnglish: You should masticate your food thoroughly.

meaning: ماددەپەرستی، گرنگیدانی زۆر بە پارە و شتومەکی فیزیکی لە جیاتی ڕۆح و هەست
definition: A tendency to consider material possessions and physical comfort as more important than spiritual values.
definitionEnglish: A tendency to consider material possessions and physical comfort as more important than spiritual values.
exampleEnglish: The modern world is dominated by materialism.
exampleKurdish: جیهانی مۆدێرن لەلایەن ماددەپەرستییەوە کۆنترۆڵ کراوە.

meaning: دایکانە، پەیوەندیدار بە دایکەوە
definition: Relating to a mother, especially during pregnancy or shortly after childbirth.
definitionEnglish: Relating to a mother, especially during pregnancy or shortly after childbirth.
exampleEnglish: She has strong maternal instincts.

meaning: سەرۆکی ژن، ژنێکی بەتەمەن کە سەرۆکی خێزان یان هۆزێکە
definition: A woman who is the head of a family or tribe.
definitionEnglish: A woman who is the head of a family or tribe.
exampleEnglish: The grandmother was the matriarch of the family.

meaning: وەرگیران لە زانکۆ، ناونووسین بۆ خوێندن لە زانکۆ
definition: Be enrolled at a college or university.
definitionEnglish: Be enrolled at a college or university.
exampleEnglish: He matriculated at Oxford in 2020.
exampleKurdish: لە ساڵی ٢٠٢٠ لە زانکۆی ئۆکسفۆرد وەرگیرا.

meaning: قاڵب، چوارچێوەیەک کە شتێکی تێدا دروست دەبێت یان گەشە دەکات
definition: An environment or material in which something develops; a surrounding medium or structure.
definitionEnglish: An environment or material in which something develops; a surrounding medium or structure.
exampleEnglish: The social matrix of the 19th century.

meaning: خەمناکی زیادەڕۆ، کەسێک کە بە شێوەیەکی بێزارکەر هەستیار و خەمناکە (بەتایبەت کاتی سەرخۆشی)
definition: Self-pitying or tearfully sentimental, often through drunkenness.
definitionEnglish: Self-pitying or tearfully sentimental, often through drunkenness.
exampleEnglish: He became maudlin after a few drinks.
exampleKurdish: دوای چەند پەرداخێک خواردنەوە بوو بە کەسێکی خەمناکی زیادەڕۆ (دەستی کرد بە گریان).

meaning: پەلاماردانی توند، بریندارکردنی کەسێک بە شێوەیەکی دڕندانە (بەتایبەت لەلایەن ئاژەڵەوە)
definition: (Of an animal) wound (a person or animal) by scratching and tearing.
definitionEnglish: (Of an animal) wound (a person or animal) by scratching and tearing.
exampleEnglish: The tiger mauled the hunter.
exampleKurdish: پڵنگەکە پەلاماری ڕاوچییەکەی دا و بە توندی برینداری کرد.

meaning: مەزارگە، بینایەکی گەورە و شکۆدار بۆ گۆڕی کەسێکی گرنگ
definition: A stately or impressive building housing a tomb or group of tombs.
definitionEnglish: A stately or impressive building housing a tomb or group of tombs.
exampleEnglish: The Taj Mahal is a famous mausoleum.

meaning: ڕەنگی مۆرێکی کاڵ
definition: A pale purple color.
definitionEnglish: A pale purple color.
exampleEnglish: She wore a mauve dress.

meaning: سەربەخۆ و جیاواز، کەسێک کە بە شێوەیەکی جیاواز بیر دەکاتەوە و ناچێتە ژێر باری یاسا باوەکان
definition: An unorthodox or independent-minded person.
definitionEnglish: An unorthodox or independent-minded person.
exampleEnglish: He was a maverick in the world of business.
exampleKurdish: ئەو کەسێکی سەربەخۆ و جیاواز بوو لە جیهانی بزنسدا.

meaning: هەستیاری زیادەڕۆ و بێزارکەر، شتێک کە زۆر سۆزدارییە بە شێوەیەکی خراپ
definition: Sentimental in a feeble or sickly way.
definitionEnglish: Sentimental in a feeble or sickly way.
exampleEnglish: The movie was a bit mawkish.
exampleKurdish: فیلمەکە تۆزێک هەستیاری زیادەڕۆ و بێزارکەر بوو.

meaning: پەند، وتەیەکی کورت کە ڕاستییەکی گشتی یان ڕێسایەکی ڕەوشتی تێدایە
definition: A short, pithy statement expressing a general truth or rule of conduct.
definitionEnglish: A short, pithy statement expressing a general truth or rule of conduct.
exampleEnglish: Actions speak louder than words is a famous maxim.
exampleKurdish: کردار لە قسە بەهێزترە پەندێکی (وتەیەکی) بەناوبانگە.

meaning: ئاژاوە و پشێوی، بارودۆخێکی پڕ لە توندوتیژی و بێ سەروبەری
definition: Violent or damaging disorder; chaos.
definitionEnglish: Violent or damaging disorder; chaos.
exampleEnglish: The protest turned into complete mayhem.
exampleKurdish: خۆپیشاندانەکە گۆڕا بۆ ئاژاوە و پشێوییەکی تەواو.

meaning: کەم، لاواز، بڕێکی زۆر کەم کە بەشی پێداویستی ناکات
definition: (Of something provided or available) lacking in quantity or quality.
definitionEnglish: (Of something provided or available) lacking in quantity or quality.
exampleEnglish: They lived on a meager income.
exampleKurdish: بە داهاتێکی زۆر کەم و هەژارانە دەژیان.

meaning: پێچاوپێچ ڕۆیشتن، گەڕان بێ ئامانج، قسەکردن لەسەر چەند بابەتێکی جیاواز بێ مەبەست
definition: (Of a river or road) follow a winding course.
definitionEnglish: (Of a river or road) follow a winding course.
exampleEnglish: The river meanders through the valley.
exampleKurdish: ڕووبارەکە بە پێچاوپێچی بە ناو دۆڵەکەدا دەڕوات.

meaning: دەستوەردەر، کەسێک کە حەز دەکات خۆی تێبخاتە ناو کاری خەڵکەوە
definition: Fond of meddling; intrusive.
definitionEnglish: Fond of meddling; intrusive.
exampleEnglish: She is a meddlesome neighbor.
exampleKurdish: ئەو دراوسێیەکی دەستوەردەرە (خۆی تێدەخاتە ناو هەموو شتێک).

meaning: ناوبژیوانی کردن، هەوڵدان بۆ ڕێککەوتنی دوو لایەن
definition: Intervene between people in a dispute in order to bring about an agreement or reconciliation.
definitionEnglish: Intervene between people in a dispute in order to bring about an agreement or reconciliation.
exampleEnglish: The UN tried to mediate between the two countries.
exampleKurdish: نەتەوە یەکگرتووەکان هەوڵیان دا ناوبژیوانی لە نێوان هەردوو وڵاتەکەدا بکەن.

meaning: مامناوەند (بە مانایەکی خراپ)، شتێک کە نە زۆر باشە و نە زۆر خراپە بەڵام جێی ڕەزامەندی نییە
definition: Of only moderate quality; not very good.
definitionEnglish: Of only moderate quality; not very good.
exampleEnglish: The food was mediocre.
exampleKurdish: خواردنەکە مامناوەند و ئاسایی بوو (باش نەبوو).

meaning: ڕامان، تێڕامانێکی قووڵ و بێدەنگ بۆ ئارامی دەروونی یان ئایینی
definition: The action or practice of meditating.
definitionEnglish: The action or practice of meditating.
exampleEnglish: He practices meditation every morning.

meaning: تێکەڵە، کۆمەڵە شتێکی جیاواز کە بەیەکەوە دانراون (بەتایبەت مۆسیقا)
definition: A varied mixture of people or things; a miscellany.
definitionEnglish: A varied mixture of people or things; a miscellany.
exampleEnglish: The band played a medley of their greatest hits.
exampleKurdish: باندەکە تێکەڵەیەک لە گۆرانییە هەرە بەناوبانگەکانیان پێشکەش کرد.

meaning: نەرم و نیان، کەسێکی بێدەنگ و گوێڕایەڵ کە بە ئاسانی بەرگری لە خۆی ناکات
definition: Quiet, gentle, and easily imposed on; submissive.
definitionEnglish: Quiet, gentle, and easily imposed on; submissive.
exampleEnglish: She was a meek and gentle child.
exampleKurdish: منداڵێکی نەرم و نیان و بێدەنگ بوو.

meaning: خۆبەگەورەزانین، نەخۆشییەکی دەروونی کە کەسەکە وا دەزانێت زۆر بەهێز و گرنگە
definition: Obsession with the exercise of power, especially in the domination of others.
definitionEnglish: Obsession with the exercise of power, especially in the domination of others.
exampleEnglish: The dictator suffered from megalomania.

meaning: خەمۆکی، خەمێکی قووڵ و درێژخایەن بێ هۆکارێکی دیار
definition: A feeling of pensive sadness, typically with no obvious cause.
definitionEnglish: A feeling of pensive sadness, typically with no obvious cause.
exampleEnglish: A mood of melancholy descended on the room.
exampleKurdish: خەمۆکییەکی قووڵ باڵی بەسەر ژوورەکەدا کێشا.

meaning: شەڕەپشێوی، شەڕێکی تێکەڵ و ئاڵۆز لە ناو قەرەباڵغیدا
definition: A confused fight, skirmish, or scuffle.
definitionEnglish: A confused fight, skirmish, or scuffle.
exampleEnglish: Several people were injured in the melee.
exampleKurdish: چەندین کەس لەو شەڕەپشێوییەدا بریندار بوون.

meaning: خۆش ئاواز، دەنگێکی نەرم و خۆش کە وەک هەنگوین وایە
definition: (Of a voice or words) sweet or musical; pleasant to hear.
definitionEnglish: (Of a voice or words) sweet or musical; pleasant to hear.
exampleEnglish: She has a mellifluous voice.
exampleKurdish: دەنگێکی زۆر خۆش و ئاوازداری هەیە.

meaning: یادگاری، شتێک کە بۆ یادەوەری کەسێک یان شوێنێک دەپارێزرێت
definition: An object kept as a reminder or souvenir of a person or event.
definitionEnglish: An object kept as a reminder or souvenir of a person or event.
exampleEnglish: I kept the shell as a memento of our holiday.
exampleKurdish: گوێچکە ماسییەکەم وەک یادگارییەک لە پشووەکەمان پاراست.

meaning: بەرز ڕاگرتنی یادەوەری، دروستکردنی شتێک بۆ ئەوەی یادەوەری کەسێک بە زیندوویی بمێنێتەوە
definition: Preserve the memory of; commemorate.
definitionEnglish: Preserve the memory of; commemorate.
exampleEnglish: The statue was built to memorialize the fallen soldiers.
exampleKurdish: پەیکەرەکە دروست کرا بۆ بەرز ڕاگرتنی یادەوەری سەربازە شەهیدەکان.

meaning: درۆزن، کەسێک کە هەمیشە درۆ دەکات و ڕاستگۆ نییە
definition: Not telling the truth; lying.
definitionEnglish: Not telling the truth; lying.
exampleEnglish: The mendacious witness was caught.

meaning: گەدا، کەسێک کە بە سواڵکردن دەژی
definition: A beggar.
definitionEnglish: A beggar.
exampleEnglish: The mendicant stood on the street corner.

meaning: کارێکی نزم، کارێک کە پێویستی بە لێهاتوویی نییە و ڕێزی لێ ناگیرێت
definition: (Of work) not requiring much skill and lacking prestige.
definitionEnglish: (Of work) not requiring much skill and lacking prestige.
exampleEnglish: He had to do menial jobs to survive.
exampleKurdish: ناچار بوو کارە نزمەکان (بێ لێهاتووییەکان) بکات بۆ ئەوەی بژی.

meaning: ڕێپیشاندەر، کەسێکی بە ئەزموون کە یارمەتی و ئامۆژگاری کەسێکی کەم ئەزموون دەدات
definition: An experienced and trusted adviser.
definitionEnglish: An experienced and trusted adviser.
exampleEnglish: He was a mentor to many young artists.
exampleKurdish: ئەو ڕێپیشاندەر و مامۆستا بوو بۆ زۆرێک لە هونەرمەندە گەنجەکان.

meaning: بازرگانی، پەیوەندیدار بە کڕین و فرۆشتنەوە
definition: Relating to merchants or trading; commercial.
definitionEnglish: Relating to merchants or trading; commercial.
exampleEnglish: The city was a major mercantile center.

meaning: بەکرێگیراو، کەسێک کە تەنها بۆ پارە کار دەکات (بەتایبەت سەرباز)
definition: (Of a person or their behavior) primarily concerned with making money at the expense of ethics.
definitionEnglish: (Of a person or their behavior) primarily concerned with making money at the expense of ethics.
exampleEnglish: He has a mercenary attitude toward marriage.
exampleKurdish: ڕەفتارێکی بەکرێگیراوانەی (تەنها بۆ پارە) هەیە بەرامبەر هاوسەرگیری.

meaning: ناجێگیر، کەسێک کە مەزاجی زوو دەگۆڕێت و پێشبینی ناکرێت
definition: (Of a person) subject to sudden or unpredictable changes of mood or mind.
definitionEnglish: (Of a person) subject to sudden or unpredictable changes of mood or mind.
exampleEnglish: His mercurial temperament made him difficult to work with.
exampleKurdish: مەزاجە ناجێگیرەکەی وای لێکردبوو کارکردن لەگەڵیدا قورس بێت.

meaning: بریقەداری بێ نرخ، شتێک کە تەنها لە دەرەوە جوانە بەڵام هیچ بەهایەکی نییە
definition: Apparently attractive but having in reality no value or integrity.
definitionEnglish: Apparently attractive but having in reality no value or integrity.
exampleEnglish: The meretricious decorations of the room.

meaning: یەکگرتن، تێکەڵبوونی دوو کۆمپانیا یان ڕێکخراو بەیەکەوە
definition: A combination of two things, especially companies, into one.
definitionEnglish: A combination of two things, especially companies, into one.
exampleEnglish: The merger of the two airlines was announced today.
exampleKurdish: یەکگرتنی هەردوو هێڵە ئاسمانییەکە ئەمڕۆ ڕاگەیەندرا.

meaning: سەرسامکردن، ڕاکێشانی سەرنجی کەسێک بە تەواوی وەک ئەوەی جادووی لێ کرابێت
definition: Hold the attention of (someone) to the exclusion of all else or so as to transfix them.
definitionEnglish: Hold the attention of (someone) to the exclusion of all else or so as to transfix them.
exampleEnglish: I was mesmerized by her performance.
exampleKurdish: بە نواندنەکەی ئەو سەرسام بووم (سەرنجم بە تەواوی ڕاکێشرا).

meaning: پەیوەندیدار بە زانستی کانزاکانەوە
definition: Relating to metallurgy (the branch of science and technology concerned with the properties of metals and their production and purification).
definitionEnglish: Relating to metallurgy (the branch of science and technology concerned with the properties of metals and their production and purification).
exampleEnglish: He is a metallurgical engineer.

meaning: گۆڕانکاری تەواو، گۆڕانی شێوە یان سیفەتی شتێک بە تەواوی
definition: (In an insect or amphibian) the process of transformation from an immature form to an adult form in two or more distinct stages.
definitionEnglish: (In an insect or amphibian) the process of transformation from an immature form to an adult form in two or more distinct stages.
exampleEnglish: The metamorphosis of a caterpillar into a butterfly.

meaning: خوازە، بەکارهێنانی وشەیەک بۆ وەسفکردنی شتێک کە لە ڕاستیدا وەک ئەو نییە بەڵام لێی دەچێت
definition: A figure of speech in which a word or phrase is applied to an object or action to which it is not literally applicable.
definitionEnglish: A figure of speech in which a word or phrase is applied to an object or action to which it is not literally applicable.
exampleEnglish: The curtain of night is a metaphor.

meaning: مێتافیزیکی، پەیوەندیدار بەو شتانەی کە لە دەرەوەی جیهانی فیزیکین (وەک ڕۆح و خودا)
definition: Relating to metaphysics (the branch of philosophy that deals with the first principles of things, including abstract concepts such as being, knowing, substance, cause, identity, time, and space).
definitionEnglish: Relating to metaphysics (the branch of philosophy that deals with the first principles of things, including abstract concepts such as being, knowing, substance, cause, identity, time, and space).
exampleEnglish: The poem explores metaphysical themes.
exampleKurdish: شیعرەکە باس لە بابەتە مێتافیزیکییەکان دەکات.

meaning: دابەشکردن، پێدانی سزا یان پاداشت بە کەسێک
definition: Dispense or allot justice, a punishment, or harsh treatment.
definitionEnglish: Dispense or allot justice, a punishment, or harsh treatment.
exampleEnglish: The judge meted out a severe sentence.
exampleKurdish: دادوەرەکە سزایەکی توندی بەسەردا سەپاند (دابەشی کرد).

meaning: خێرا و درەوشاوە، سەرکەوتنێکی زۆر خێرا
definition: Relating to meteors; (of the development of something) very rapid.
definitionEnglish: Relating to meteors; (of the development of something) very rapid.
exampleEnglish: He had a meteoric rise to fame.
exampleKurdish: سەرکەوتنێکی زۆر خێرا و درەوشاوەی هەبوو بۆ ناوبانگ.

meaning: ڕێکوپێک، کارکردن بەپێی پلان و ڕێگایەکی دیاریکراو
definition: Done according to a systematic or established form of procedure.
definitionEnglish: Done according to a systematic or established form of procedure.
exampleEnglish: She is very methodical in her work.
exampleKurdish: ئەو لە کارەکەیدا زۆر ڕێکوپێک و خاوەن پلانە.

meaning: زۆر وردبین، کەسێک کە زۆر گرنگی بە وردەکارییە بچووکەکان دەدات
definition: Showing great attention to detail; very careful and precise.
definitionEnglish: Showing great attention to detail; very careful and precise.
exampleEnglish: He is meticulous about his appearance.
exampleKurdish: ئەو زۆر وردبینە سەبارەت بە دەرکەوتنی (شێوەی خۆی).

meaning: شارێکی گەورە و پڕ قەرەباڵغ، پایتەخت
definition: The capital or chief city of a country or region.
definitionEnglish: The capital or chief city of a country or region.
exampleEnglish: New York is a bustling metropolis.
exampleKurdish: نیویۆرک شارێکی گەورە و پڕ لە جەنجاڵییە.

meaning: ئازایەتی، توانای بەرگەگرتن لە بارودۆخی قورسدا
definition: A person's ability to cope well with difficulties or to face a demanding situation in a spirited and resilient way.
definitionEnglish: A person's ability to cope well with difficulties or to face a demanding situation in a spirited and resilient way.
exampleEnglish: The team showed their mettle in the final minutes.
exampleKurdish: تیمەکە ئازایەتی و توانای خۆیان نیشان دا لە خولەکە کۆتاییەکاندا.

meaning: بۆنێکی ناخۆش و زیانبەخش، کەشوهەوایەکی خراپ و ناخۆش
definition: A highly unpleasant or unhealthy smell or vapor.
definitionEnglish: A highly unpleasant or unhealthy smell or vapor.
exampleEnglish: A miasma of corruption surrounded the government.
exampleKurdish: کەشوهەوایەکی (بۆنێکی) خراپی گەندەڵی دەوری حوکمەتی دابوو.

meaning: زۆر بچووک، شتێک کە تەنها بە مایکرۆسکۆپ دەبینرێت
definition: So small as to be visible only with a microscope.
definitionEnglish: So small as to be visible only with a microscope.
exampleEnglish: Microscopic organisms live in the water.
exampleKurdish: زیندەوەرە زۆر بچووکەکان (مایکرۆسکۆپی) لە ناو ئاودا دەژین.

meaning: مامان، کەسێک کە یارمەتی ژنان دەدات لە کاتی منداڵبووندا
definition: A person (typically a woman) trained to assist women in childbirth.
definitionEnglish: A person (typically a woman) trained to assist women in childbirth.
exampleEnglish: The midwife delivered the baby safely.
exampleKurdish: مامانەکە منداڵەکەی بە سەلامەتی هێنایە دنیاوە.

meaning: ڕواڵەت، شێوەی ڕەفتار و دەربڕینی کەسێک کە نیشاندەری هەستیەتی
definition: A person's look or manner, especially one of a particular kind indicating their character or mood.
definitionEnglish: A person's look or manner, especially one of a particular kind indicating their character or mood.
exampleEnglish: He has a sorrowful mien.

meaning: شەقیقە، سەرئێشەیەکی زۆر توند و درێژخایەن
definition: A recurrent throbbing headache that typically affects one side of the head and is often accompanied by nausea and disturbed vision.
definitionEnglish: A recurrent throbbing headache that typically affects one side of the head and is often accompanied by nausea and disturbed vision.
exampleEnglish: She suffers from frequent migraines.

meaning: کەشوهەوا، ژینگەی کۆمەڵایەتی یان فەرهەنگی کە کەسێک تێیدا دەژی
definition: A person's social environment.
definitionEnglish: A person's social environment.
exampleEnglish: He grew up in a military milieu.

meaning: توندڕەو، کەسێک کە ئامادەیە توندوتیژی بەکاربهێنێت بۆ گەیشتن بە ئامانجە سیاسی یان ئایینییەکانی
definition: Combative and aggressive in support of a political or social cause, and typically favoring extreme, violent, or confrontational methods.
definitionEnglish: Combative and aggressive in support of a political or social cause, and typically favoring extreme, violent, or confrontational methods.
exampleEnglish: Militant groups are active in the region.

definitionEnglish: The action or art of imitating someone or something, typically in order to entertain or ridicule.

meaning: هەڕەشەئامێز، شتێک کە نیشانەی مەترسی یان هەڕەشەی تێدایە

meaning: نازدار و دەستکرد، ڕێکردن یان قسەکردن بە شێوەیەکی ناسک و نادروست بۆ سەرنجڕاکێشان
definition: (Of a person's manner of walking or speaking) affectedly dainty, nice, or elegant.
definitionEnglish: (Of a person's manner of walking or speaking) affectedly dainty, nice, or elegant.
exampleEnglish: He took small, mincing steps.

meaning: تێکەڵبوون، قسەکردن لەگەڵ خەڵک لە ناو قەرەباڵغیدا

exampleKurdish: میوانەکان لە باخچەکەدا تێکەڵ بوون (قسەیان لەگەڵ یەکتر دەکرد).

meaning: بچووککراوە، شێوەیەکی زۆر بچووکی شتێک

definitionEnglish: (Of a thing) of a much smaller size than normal; very small.

meaning: پاشکۆ، کەسێکی گوێڕایەڵ کە کار بۆ کەسێکی بەهێزتر دەکات و گرنگییەکی کەمی هەیە

meaning: زۆر بچووک، بڕێکی زۆر کەم
definition: Extremely small; tiny.
definitionEnglish: Extremely small; tiny.

exampleKurdish: هەلی سەرکەوتن زۆر بچووک و کەمە.

exampleKurdish: ئەو هۆگری وردەکارییە بچووک و کەم بایەخەکانی یاسایە.

exampleKurdish: کانییە ئاوەکە دەرکەوت کە تەنها سەرابێک بووە.

meaning: کەیف و خۆشی، پێکەنین و شادی

definitionEnglish: Amusement, especially as expressed in laughter.
exampleEnglish: His jokes caused great mirth among the guests.
exampleKurdish: نوکتەکانی بوونە هۆی کەیف و خۆشییەکی زۆر لە نێوان میوانەکاندا.

meaning: مرۆڤبێزار، کەسێک کە ڕقی لە مرۆڤایەتییە و خۆی لە خەڵک بەدوور دەگرێت

definition: A mistaken belief about or interpretation of something.
definitionEnglish: A mistaken belief about or interpretation of something.
exampleEnglish: She was under the misapprehension that the meeting was canceled.
exampleKurdish: لەژێر ئەو هەڵەتێگەیشتنەدا بوو کە کۆبوونەوەکە هەڵوەشاوەتەوە.

meaning: تێکەڵە، کۆمەڵە شتێکی جیاواز و جۆراوجۆر
definition: A group or collection of different items; a mixture.
definitionEnglish: A group or collection of different items; a mixture.
exampleEnglish: A miscellany of old toys.

meaning: بەدبەختی، ڕووداوێکی ناخۆش کە بەهۆی بەختەوە ڕوو دەدات
definition: Bad luck.
definitionEnglish: Bad luck.
exampleEnglish: By some mischance, the letter never arrived.
exampleKurdish: بەهۆی هەندێک بەدبەختییەوە، نامەکە هەرگیز نەگەیشت.

definitionEnglish: A view or opinion that is incorrect because based on faulty thinking or understanding.

exampleKurdish: ئەوە تێگەیشتنێکی هەڵەی باوە کە هەموو مارەکان ژەهراوین.

definitionEnglish: A person who behaves badly or in a way that breaks the law.

definitionEnglish: A feeling of doubt or apprehension about the outcome or consequences of something.

exampleKurdish: گومان و دڵەڕاوکێی جدیم هەیە سەبارەت بە پڕۆژە نوێیەکە.

exampleKurdish: گەشتەکە بەبێ هیچ ڕووداوێکی ناخۆش کۆتایی هات.

definition: Appease the anger or anxiety of (someone).

definition: Relating to monks, nuns, or others living under religious vows, or the buildings in which they live.
definitionEnglish: Relating to monks, nuns, or others living under religious vows, or the buildings in which they live.

meaning: دراوی، پەیوەندیدار بە پارە و سیستەمی دارایییەوە
definition: Relating to money or currency.

meaning: تاک ڕەنگ، شتێک کە تەنها یەک ڕەنگی هەیە یان تەنها ڕەش و سپییە
definition: Containing or using only one color.

exampleKurdish: تابلۆیەکی تاک ڕەنگ (تەنها یەک ڕەنگی تێدایە).

definitionEnglish: A long speech by one actor in a play or movie, or as part of a theatrical or broadcast program.

exampleKurdish: بێزاری و یەک جۆری ژیانی ڕۆژانە.

meaning: زۆر گەورە و گرنگ، شتێک کە شایەنی ئەوەیە وەک یادگاری بمێنێتەوە
definition: Great in importance, extent, or size.
definitionEnglish: Great in importance, extent, or size.
exampleEnglish: A monumental achievement.

meaning: مەزاجی، کەسێک کە زوو هەستەکانی دەگۆڕێت و زۆربەی کات خەمناک یان تورەیە
definition: (Of a person) given to unpredictable changes of mood, especially sudden bouts of gloominess or sullenness.
definitionEnglish: (Of a person) given to unpredictable changes of mood, especially sudden bouts of gloominess or sullenness.

definition: A temporary prohibition of an activity.
definitionEnglish: A temporary prohibition of an activity.
exampleEnglish: A moratorium on nuclear testing.

definition: Characterized by or appealing to an abnormal and unhealthy interest in disturbing and unpleasant subjects, especially death and disease.
definitionEnglish: Characterized by or appealing to an abnormal and unhealthy interest in disturbing and unpleasant subjects, especially death and disease.

exampleKurdish: ئارەزوویەکی ناتەندروستی (مۆربید) هەیە بۆ بکوژە زنجیرەییەکان.

definition: (Especially of humor) having or showing a sharp or critical quality; biting.
definitionEnglish: (Especially of humor) having or showing a sharp or critical quality; biting.
exampleEnglish: He has a mordant wit.

meaning: دابونەریت، ڕەوشت و یاسا کۆمەڵایەتییەکانی گروپێک
definition: The essential or characteristic customs and conventions of a community.
definitionEnglish: The essential or characteristic customs and conventions of a community.
exampleEnglish: The social mores of the time.

meaning: لە لێواری مردن، شتێک کە خەریکە لەناو دەچێت یان کۆتایی دێت
definition: (Of a person) at the point of death; (of a thing) in terminal decline; lacking vitality or vigor.
definitionEnglish: (Of a person) at the point of death; (of a thing) in terminal decline; lacking vitality or vigor.
exampleEnglish: The moribund economy.

meaning: گرژ و مۆن، کەسێک کە بێدەنگ و خەمناک و بێزارە
definition: Sullen and ill-tempered.
definitionEnglish: Sullen and ill-tempered.
exampleEnglish: He became morose after losing his job.
exampleKurdish: دوای لەدەستدانی کارەکەی بوو بە کەسێکی گرژ و مۆن.

meaning: مردوو شۆر، کەسێک کە ئامادەکاری بۆ گۆڕ و ناشتنی مردووەکان دەکات
definition: An undertaker.
definitionEnglish: An undertaker.
exampleEnglish: The mortician prepared the body for the funeral.
exampleKurdish: مردوو شۆرەکە تەرمەکەی بۆ پرسەکە ئامادە کرد.

meaning: شەرمەزارکردن، هەستکردن بە شەرمەزارییەکی زۆر
definition: Cause (someone) to feel embarrassed, ashamed, or humiliated.
definitionEnglish: Cause (someone) to feel embarrassed, ashamed, or humiliated.
exampleEnglish: She was mortified by her son's behavior.
exampleKurdish: بەهۆی ڕەفتاری کوڕەکەیەوە زۆر شەرمەزار بوو.

meaning: مۆزایک، تابلۆیەک کە لە پارچە بەرد یان شووشەی ڕەنگاوڕەنگ دروست کراوە
definition: A picture or pattern produced by arranging together small colored pieces of hard material, such as stone, tile, or glass.
definitionEnglish: A picture or pattern produced by arranging together small colored pieces of hard material, such as stone, tile, or glass.
exampleEnglish: The floor was covered with a beautiful mosaic.

meaning: تۆزقاڵ، پارچەیەکی زۆر بچووک لە شتێک (وەک تۆز)
definition: A tiny piece of a substance.
definitionEnglish: A tiny piece of a substance.
exampleEnglish: A mote of dust.

meaning: نەخش، بیرۆکە یان شێوازێکی دووبارەبووەوە لە هونەر یان ئەدەبدا
definition: A decorative design or pattern.
definitionEnglish: A decorative design or pattern.
exampleEnglish: The flower motif is repeated throughout the fabric.
exampleKurdish: نەخشی گوڵەکە لە هەموو قوماشەکەدا دووبارە بووەتەوە.

meaning: توانای جوڵەی خۆکار (بەتایبەت بۆ زیندەوەرە بچووکەکان)
definition: The ability of an organism to move independently, using metabolic energy.
definitionEnglish: The ability of an organism to move independently, using metabolic energy.
exampleEnglish: The motility of the bacteria.

meaning: تێکەڵە و جیاواز، کۆمەڵە شتێک یان خەڵکێک کە زۆر لە یەک ناچن
definition: Incongruously varied in appearance or character; disparate.
definitionEnglish: Incongruously varied in appearance or character; disparate.
exampleEnglish: A motley collection of old furniture.
exampleKurdish: کۆمەڵەیەکی تێکەڵە و جیاواز لە کەلوپەلی کۆن.

meaning: خاڵ خاڵ، شتێک کە پەڵەی ڕەنگی جیاوازی لەسەرە
definition: Marked with spots or smears of color.
definitionEnglish: Marked with spots or smears of color.
exampleEnglish: The bird has mottled feathers.
exampleKurdish: باڵندەکە پەڕی خاڵ خاڵی (پەڵە پەڵەی) هەیە.

meaning: دروشمی ژیان، وتەیەکی کورت کە ئامانج یان بیروباوەڕی کەسێک یان گروپێک دەردەبڕێت
definition: A short sentence or phrase chosen as encapsulating the beliefs or ideals guiding an individual, family, or institution.
definitionEnglish: A short sentence or phrase chosen as encapsulating the beliefs or ideals guiding an individual, family, or institution.
exampleEnglish: Be prepared is the motto of the scouts.

meaning: فێڵباز، کەسێک کە خەڵک هەڵدەخەڵەتێنێت (بەتایبەت بۆ فرۆشتنی دەرمانی درۆ)
definition: A person who deceives others, especially in order to trick them out of their money; a charlatan.
definitionEnglish: A person who deceives others, especially in order to trick them out of their money; a charlatan.
exampleEnglish: He was exposed as a mountebank.

meaning: ئاڵۆزی، شێواندن، بارودۆخێکی بێ سەروبەر
definition: Bring into a disordered or confusing state.
definitionEnglish: Bring into a disordered or confusing state.
exampleEnglish: The documents were in a complete muddle.
exampleKurdish: بەڵگەنامەکان لە ئاڵۆزییەکی تەواودا بوون (تێکەڵ و پێکەڵ ببوون).

meaning: کەشوهەوای گەرم و شێدار، شێداری بێزارکەر
definition: (Of the weather) unpleasantly warm and humid.
definitionEnglish: (Of the weather) unpleasantly warm and humid.
exampleEnglish: It was a hot, muggy afternoon.

meaning: سزادان بە پارە، فێڵکردن لە کەسێک بۆ بردنی پارەکەی
definition: Extract money from (someone) by fine or taxation.
definitionEnglish: Extract money from (someone) by fine or taxation.
exampleEnglish: They were mulcted of their savings.
exampleKurdish: بە فێڵ پارەی پاشەکەوتەکەیان لێ بردرا.

meaning: زۆر و جۆراوجۆر، شتێک کە چەندین بەش یان شێوەی جیاوازی هەیە
definition: Many and of various types.
definitionEnglish: Many and of various types.
exampleEnglish: The multifarious activities of the club.

meaning: چەند شێوەیی، شتێک کە دەتوانێت چەندین شێوەی جیاوازی هەبێت
definition: Existing in many forms or kinds.
definitionEnglish: Existing in many forms or kinds.
exampleEnglish: The multiform nature of the disease.

meaning: چەند زمانە، کەسێک کە دەتوانێت بە چەند زمانێک قسە بکات
definition: In or using several languages.
definitionEnglish: In or using several languages.
exampleEnglish: She is multilingual and speaks five languages.
exampleKurdish: ئەو چەند زمانەیە و بە پێنج زمان قسە دەکات.

meaning: زۆری، هەبوونی بڕێکی زۆر و جۆراوجۆر لە شتێک
definition: A large number or variety.
definitionEnglish: A large number or variety.
exampleEnglish: The multiplicity of options available.

meaning: سادە و بێزارکەر، شتێک کە پەیوەندیدارە بە ژیانی ڕۆژانە و هیچ سەرنجڕاکێشییەکی تێدا نییە
definition: Lacking interest or excitement; dull.
definitionEnglish: Lacking interest or excitement; dull.
exampleEnglish: The mundane tasks of everyday life.
exampleKurdish: کارە سادە و بێزارکەرەکانی ژیانی ڕۆژانە.

meaning: زۆر بەخشندە، کەسێک کە بڕێکی زۆر پارە یان دیاری دەبەخشێت
definition: (Of a gift or a sum of money) larger or more generous than is usual or necessary.
definitionEnglish: (Of a gift or a sum of money) larger or more generous than is usual or necessary.
exampleEnglish: A munificent donation to the charity.
exampleKurdish: بەخشینێکی زۆر گەورە و بەخشندانە بۆ ڕێکخراوە خێرخوازییەکە.

meaning: دیواربەند، تابلۆیەکی گەورە کە ڕاستەوخۆ لەسەر دیوار دەکێشرێت
definition: A painting or other work of art executed directly on a wall.
definitionEnglish: A painting or other work of art executed directly on a wall.
exampleEnglish: The walls were decorated with colorful murals.

meaning: تاریک و لێڵ، شتێک کە ڕوون نییە و گومانی تێدایە
definition: Dark and gloomy, especially due to thick mist.
definitionEnglish: Dark and gloomy, especially due to thick mist.
exampleEnglish: The murky waters of the lake.

meaning: چرپە، قسەکردنی زۆر بێدەنگ کە بە قورسی دەبیسترێت
definition: A soft, indistinct sound made by a person or group of people speaking quietly or at a distance.
definitionEnglish: A soft, indistinct sound made by a person or group of people speaking quietly or at a distance.
exampleEnglish: A murmur of agreement ran through the crowd.
exampleKurdish: چرپەیەکی (دەنگێکی بێدەنگی) ڕەزامەندی بە ناو قەرەباڵغییەکەدا بڵاوبووەوە.

meaning: تێڕامان، بیرکردنەوەی قووڵ و بێدەنگ، سەرچاوەی ئیلهام بۆ هونەرمەند
definition: Be absorbed in thought.
definitionEnglish: Be absorbed in thought.
exampleEnglish: He mused on the meaning of life.
exampleKurdish: بە قووڵی بیری لە مانای ژیان دەکردەوە.

meaning: گەشەکردنی خێرا، شتێک کە زۆر بە خێرایی زیاد دەکات
definition: Increase, spread, or develop rapidly.
definitionEnglish: Increase, spread, or develop rapidly.
exampleEnglish: The number of small businesses has mushroomed in the last few years.
exampleKurdish: ژمارەی بزنسە بچووکەکان لە چەند ساڵی ڕابردوودا زۆر بە خێرایی گەشەی کردووە.

meaning: بۆنی میسک، بۆنێکی بەهێز و خۆش
definition: Resembling or smelling of musk.
definitionEnglish: Resembling or smelling of musk.
exampleEnglish: A musky perfume.

meaning: کۆکردنەوە، ئامادەکردنی هێز یان ئازایەتی بۆ کارێک
definition: Assemble (troops), especially for inspection or in preparation for battle.
definitionEnglish: Assemble (troops), especially for inspection or in preparation for battle.
exampleEnglish: He finally mustered the courage to ask her out.
exampleKurdish: دواجار ئازایەتی خۆی کۆکردەوە بۆ ئەوەی داوای لێ بکات بچنە دەرەوە.

meaning: بۆنی کۆن و شێ، بۆنێکی ناخۆش کە لە شتی کۆن و داخراوەوە دێت
definition: Having a stale, moldy, or damp smell.
definitionEnglish: Having a stale, moldy, or damp smell.
exampleEnglish: The room smelled musty.
exampleKurdish: ژوورەکە بۆنی کۆن و شێی (مەستی) لێ دەهات.

meaning: گۆڕاویی، توانای گۆڕان یان گۆڕانکاری بەردەوام
definition: Liability or tendency to change.
definitionEnglish: Liability or tendency to change.
exampleEnglish: The mutability of fashion.

meaning: بێدەنگکراو، ڕەنگ یان دەنگێکی کاڵ و نەرم
definition: (Of a sound or color) quiet and soft.
definitionEnglish: (Of a sound or color) quiet and soft.
exampleEnglish: The room was decorated in muted tones.
exampleKurdish: ژوورەکە بە ڕەنگی کاڵ و نەرم ڕازێنرابووەوە.

meaning: شێواندن، بڕینی بەشێکی جەستە یان تێکدانی شتێک بە خراپی
definition: Inflict a violent and disfiguring injury on.
definitionEnglish: Inflict a violent and disfiguring injury on.
exampleEnglish: The body had been badly mutilated.

meaning: یاخی، کەسێک کە ئامادە نییە گوێڕایەڵی فەرمانەکان بێت (بەتایبەت لە سوپا)
definition: (Of a soldier or sailor) refusing to obey the orders of a person in authority.
definitionEnglish: (Of a soldier or sailor) refusing to obey the orders of a person in authority.
exampleEnglish: The mutinous crew took control of the ship.
exampleKurdish: تیمە یاخییەکە کۆنترۆڵی کەشتییەکەیان گرتە دەست.

meaning: بۆڵەبۆڵ، قسەکردنی بێدەنگ و ناڕازی لەبەر خۆتەوە
definition: Say something in a low or barely audible voice, especially in dissatisfaction or irritation.
definitionEnglish: Say something in a low or barely audible voice, especially in dissatisfaction or irritation.
exampleEnglish: He muttered something under his breath.

meaning: کورت بین، کەسێک کە تەنها بیر لە ئێستا دەکاتەوە و داهاتوو نابینێت
definition: Nearsighted; lacking imagination, foresight, or intellectual insight.
definitionEnglish: Nearsighted; lacking imagination, foresight, or intellectual insight.
exampleEnglish: The government has a myopic view of the economy.
exampleKurdish: حوکمەت تێڕوانینێکی کورت بینانەی (بێ داهاتووی) هەیە بۆ ئابووری.

meaning: بێشومار، بڕێکی زۆر و بێ کۆتایی لە شتێک
definition: A countless or extremely great number.
definitionEnglish: A countless or extremely great number.
exampleEnglish: The myriad stars in the sky.

meaning: سۆفی، کەسێک کە هەوڵ دەدات لە ڕێگەی ڕۆحییەوە بگاتە ڕاستییە خوداییەکان
definition: A person who seeks by contemplation and self-surrender to obtain unity with or absorption into the Deity or the absolute.
definitionEnglish: A person who seeks by contemplation and self-surrender to obtain unity with or absorption into the Deity or the absolute.
exampleEnglish: He was a famous mystic and poet.
exampleKurdish: ئەو سۆفی و شاعیرێکی بەناوبانگ بوو.

meaning: سەرسامکردن، شێواندنی مێشک بە شێوەیەک کە کەسەکە تێنەگات چی ڕوو دەدات
definition: Utterly bewilder or perplex (someone).
definitionEnglish: Utterly bewilder or perplex (someone).
exampleEnglish: I was mystified by his decision.
exampleKurdish: بە بڕیارەکەی ئەو زۆر سەرسام بووم (تێنەگەیشتم بۆچی وای کرد).

meaning: ئەفسانەیی، شتێک کە تەنها لە چیرۆکە کۆنەکاندایە و ڕاست نییە
definition: Occurring in or characteristic of myths or folk tales.
definitionEnglish: Occurring in or characteristic of myths or folk tales.
exampleEnglish: The dragon is a mythical creature.

meaning: نزمترین خاڵ، خراپترین کاتی بارودۆخێک
definition: The lowest point in the fortunes of a person or organization.
definitionEnglish: The lowest point in the fortunes of a person or organization.
exampleEnglish: The company reached its nadir last year.
exampleKurdish: کۆمپانیاکە ساڵی ڕابردوو گەیشتە نزمترین خاڵی خۆی (خراپترین بارودۆخ).

meaning: سادەیی، بێ ئەزموونی کە دەبێتە هۆی ئەوەی کەسەکە زوو باوەڕ بە خەڵک بکات
definition: Lack of experience, wisdom, or judgment.
definitionEnglish: Lack of experience, wisdom, or judgment.
exampleEnglish: His naivety led him to trust the wrong people.
exampleKurdish: سادەیی و بێ ئەزموونییەکەی وای لێکرد متمانە بە کەسانی هەڵە بکات.

meaning: خۆپەرست، کەسێک کە زۆر سەرسامە بە خۆی و تەنها گرنگی بە خۆی دەدات
definition: A person who has an excessive interest in or admiration of themselves.
definitionEnglish: A person who has an excessive interest in or admiration of themselves.
exampleEnglish: He is a complete narcissist.

meaning: گێڕانەوە، چیرۆک یان ڕوونکردنەوەی ڕووداوەکان
definition: A spoken or written account of connected events; a story.
definitionEnglish: A spoken or written account of connected events; a story.
exampleEnglish: The novel has a complex narrative structure.

meaning: تازە پێگەیشتوو، شتێک کە تازە دەستی پێکردووە و خەریکە گەشە دەکات
definition: (Especially of a process or organization) just coming into existence and beginning to display signs of future potential.
definitionEnglish: (Especially of a process or organization) just coming into existence and beginning to display signs of future potential.
exampleEnglish: The nascent space industry.

meaning: ڕێک و پێک، کەسێک کە زۆر بە جوانی و مۆدێرن جل دەپۆشێت
definition: (Of a person or an article of clothing) smart and fashionable.
definitionEnglish: (Of a person or an article of clothing) smart and fashionable.
exampleEnglish: He was wearing a natty blue suit.
exampleKurdish: قاتێکی شینی زۆر ڕێک و پێک و جوانی پۆشیبوو.

meaning: دڵ تێکەڵهاتن، هەستکردن بەوەی کە خەریکە دەڕشێیتەوە
definition: Make (someone) feel sick; affect with nausea.
definitionEnglish: Make (someone) feel sick; affect with nausea.
exampleEnglish: The smell of the garbage nauseated her.

meaning: دەریایی، پەیوەندیدار بە کەشتیوانی و دەریاوە
definition: Of or concerning sailors or navigation; maritime.
definitionEnglish: Of or concerning sailors or navigation; maritime.
exampleEnglish: Nautical charts are essential for sailors.

meaning: شیاوی کەشتیوانی، ڕووبار یان دەریایەک کە کەشتی دەتوانێت پێیدا بڕوات
definition: (Of a waterway or sea) able to be sailed on by ships or boats.
definitionEnglish: (Of a waterway or sea) able to be sailed on by ships or boats.
exampleEnglish: The river is navigable for small boats.
exampleKurdish: ڕووبارەکە شیاوی کەشتیوانییە بۆ بەلەمە بچووکەکان.

meaning: ناڕوون، تەمومژاوی، بیرۆکەیەک کە بە باشی دیار نییە
definition: (Of a concept or idea) unclear, vague, or ill-defined.
definitionEnglish: (Of a concept or idea) unclear, vague, or ill-defined.
exampleEnglish: He has some nebulous ideas about starting a business.
exampleKurdish: هەندێک بیرۆکەی ناڕوونی (تەمومژاوی) هەیە سەبارەت بە دەستپێکردنی بزنسێک.

meaning: جادووی ڕەش، پەیوەندیکردن لەگەڵ مردووەکان بۆ زانینی داهاتوو
definition: The supposed practice of communicating with the dead, especially in order to predict the future.
definitionEnglish: The supposed practice of communicating with the dead, especially in order to predict the future.
exampleEnglish: He was accused of practicing necromancy.
exampleKurdish: تۆمەتبار کرا بە ئەنجامدانی جادووی ڕەش (پەیوەندیکردن بە مردووەکان).

meaning: خراپەکار، کارێکی زۆر خراپ و نایاسایی
definition: (Typically of an action or activity) wicked or criminal.
definitionEnglish: (Typically of an action or activity) wicked or criminal.
exampleEnglish: The company was involved in nefarious activities.
exampleKurdish: کۆمپانیاکە تێوەگلابوو لە چالاکییە خراپەکارانە و نایاسایییەکاندا.

meaning: هەڵوەشاندنەوە، نەمانی کاریگەری شتێک، ڕەتکردنەوە
definition: Nullify; make ineffective.
definitionEnglish: Nullify; make ineffective.
exampleEnglish: The new evidence negates his alibi.
exampleKurdish: بەڵگە نوێیەکە بیانووەکەی ئەو (بۆ بێتاوانی) هەڵدەوەشێنێتەوە.

meaning: کەمتەرخەمی، ئەنجامنەدانی کارێک بەو شێوەیەی کە پێویستە
definition: Failure to take proper care in doing something.
definitionEnglish: Failure to take proper care in doing something.
exampleEnglish: The accident was caused by his negligence.

meaning: کەم و بێ بایەخ، بڕێک کە هێندە کەمە شایەنی باس نییە
definition: So small or unimportant as to be not worth considering; insignificant.
definitionEnglish: So small or unimportant as to be not worth considering; insignificant.
exampleEnglish: The cost was negligible.
exampleKurdish: تێچووەکە زۆر کەم و بێ بایەخ بوو.

meaning: دوژمنی سەرسەخت، کەسێک یان شتێک کە دەبێتە هۆی شکستی کەسێک
definition: The inescapable agent of someone's or something's downfall.
definitionEnglish: The inescapable agent of someone's or something's downfall.
exampleEnglish: He finally met his nemesis.
exampleKurdish: دواجار ڕووبەڕووی دوژمنە سەرسەختەکەی (هۆکاری شکستی) بووەوە.

meaning: وشەی نوێ، وشەیەکی تازە دروستکراو یان بەکارهێنانی وشەیەک بە مانایەکی نوێ
definition: A newly coined word or expression.
definitionEnglish: A newly coined word or expression.
exampleEnglish: The internet has created many neologisms.
exampleKurdish: ئینتەرنێت چەندین وشەی نوێی (نیۆلۆژیزمی) دروست کردووە.

meaning: تازەکار، کەسێک کە تازە دەستی بە کارێک یان ئایینێک کردووە
definition: A person who is new to a subject, skill, or belief.
definitionEnglish: A person who is new to a subject, skill, or belief.
exampleEnglish: A neophyte in the world of politics.

meaning: خزمخزمێنە، بەکارهێنانی دەسەڵات بۆ یارمەتیدانی خزم و هاوڕێکان
definition: The practice among those with power or influence of favoring relatives or friends, especially by giving them jobs.
definitionEnglish: The practice among those with power or influence of favoring relatives or friends, especially by giving them jobs.
exampleEnglish: He was accused of nepotism when he hired his nephew.
exampleKurdish: تۆمەتبار کرا بە خزمخزمێنە کاتێک برازاکەی خۆی دامەزراند.

meaning: خواروو، ژێرەوە، بەشی خوارەوەی شتێک
definition: Lower in position.
definitionEnglish: Lower in position.
exampleEnglish: The nether regions of the ocean.

meaning: بێزارکردن، تورەکردنی کەسێک بە شێوەیەکی بەردەوام
definition: Irritate or annoy (someone).
definitionEnglish: Irritate or annoy (someone).
exampleEnglish: His constant complaining nettled her.
exampleKurdish: بۆڵەبۆڵە بەردەوامەکانی ئەو بێزاری دەکرد (تورەی دەکرد).

meaning: پەیوەندی، خاڵی بەیەکگەیشتنی چەند شتێک
definition: A connection or series of connections linking two or more things.
definitionEnglish: A connection or series of connections linking two or more things.
exampleEnglish: The nexus between drugs and crime.
exampleKurdish: پەیوەندی (نێکسەس) نێوان ماددە بێهۆشکەرەکان و تاوان.

meaning: قەپ لێگرتن، خواردنی بڕێکی زۆر بچووک لە شتێک
definition: Take small bites out of.
definitionEnglish: Take small bites out of.
exampleEnglish: The mouse nibbled at the cheese.
exampleKurdish: مشکەکە قەپی بچووکی لە پەنیرەکە دەگرت.

meaning: وردەکاری، خاڵێکی زۆر ورد و گرنگ لە ڕەفتار یان قسەکردندا
definition: A fine detail or distinction, especially one regarded as intricate or fussy.
definitionEnglish: A fine detail or distinction, especially one regarded as intricate or fussy.
exampleEnglish: The legal niceties of the case.

meaning: ڕەزیل، کەسێک کە زۆر بە کەمی پارە خەرج دەکات یان دەبەخشێت
definition: Ungenerous with money but also time or effort; stingy.
definitionEnglish: Ungenerous with money but also time or effort; stingy.
exampleEnglish: A niggardly amount of food.
exampleKurdish: بڕێکی زۆر کەم و ڕەزیلانە لە خواردن.

meaning: بێزارکردن بە وردەکاری بێ بایەخ، ڕەخنەگرتنی زۆر لە شتی بچووک
definition: Cause slight but persistent annoyance, discomfort, or anxiety.

exampleKurdish: گومانێکی بچووک لە مێشکیدا بێزاری دەکرد (نێگڵی دەکرد).

meaning: هیچگەرایی، باوەڕبوون بەوەی کە ژیان هیچ مانا و ئامانجێکی نییە
definition: The rejection of all religious and moral principles, often in the belief that life is meaningless.
definitionEnglish: The rejection of all religious and moral principles, often in the belief that life is meaningless.
exampleEnglish: His philosophy was one of extreme nihilism.
exampleKurdish: فەلسەفەکەی یەکێک بوو لە هیچگەرایییەکی (نیهیلیزمی) توندڕەو.

meaning: چالاک، خێرا لە جوڵە یان لە بیرکردنەوەدا
definition: Quick and light in movement or action; agile.
definitionEnglish: Quick and light in movement or action; agile.
exampleEnglish: She has a nimble mind.

meaning: نیرڤانا، بارودۆخێکی ئارامی تەواو و بێ ئازار (لە ئایینی بودیزمدا)
definition: (In Buddhism) a transcendent state in which there is neither suffering, desire, nor sense of self.
definitionEnglish: (In Buddhism) a transcendent state in which there is neither suffering, desire, nor sense of self.
exampleEnglish: He was seeking spiritual nirvana.

meaning: شەوانە، زیندەوەرێک کە تەنها بە شەو چالاکە
definition: Done, occurring, or active at night.
definitionEnglish: Done, occurring, or active at night.
exampleEnglish: Owls are nocturnal birds.

meaning: بۆن ناخۆش، شتێک کە زیانبەخشە و بۆنێکی زۆر ناخۆشی هەیە
definition: Having an extremely offensive smell.
definitionEnglish: Having an extremely offensive smell.
exampleEnglish: Noisome vapors rose from the swamp.
exampleKurdish: هەڵمی بۆن ناخۆش و زیانبەخش لە زۆنگاوەکەوە بەرز دەبووەوە.

meaning: کۆچەری، کەسێک کە جێگای دیاریکراوی نییە و بەردەوام دەگوێزێتەوە
definition: Living the life of a nomad; wandering.
definitionEnglish: Living the life of a nomad; wandering.
exampleEnglish: The nomadic tribes of the desert.

meaning: زاراوەسازی، سیستەمی ناونانی شتەکان لە زانست یان هونەردا
definition: The devising or choosing of names for things, especially in a science or other discipline.
definitionEnglish: The devising or choosing of names for things, especially in a science or other discipline.
exampleEnglish: The nomenclature of chemical compounds.

meaning: ناوکی، تەنها بە ناو، بڕێکی زۆر کەم کە تەنها بۆ ناوە
definition: (Of a role or status) existing in name only.
definitionEnglish: (Of a role or status) existing in name only.
exampleEnglish: He is the nominal head of the company.
exampleKurdish: ئەو تەنها بە ناو (نۆمیناڵ) سەرۆکی کۆمپانیایە.

meaning: خەمسارد، کەسێک کە زۆر ئارامە و نیشانی نادات کە گرنگی دەدات یان نیگەرانە
definition: (Of a person or manner) feeling or appearing casually calm and relaxed; not displaying anxiety, interest, or enthusiasm.
definitionEnglish: (Of a person or manner) feeling or appearing casually calm and relaxed; not displaying anxiety, interest, or enthusiasm.
exampleEnglish: He gave a nonchalant shrug.
exampleKurdish: شانێکی خەمساردانەی هەڵتەکاند (وەک بڵێی گرنگ نییە).

meaning: بێ لایەن، کەسێک کە نایەوێت ڕای خۆی دەرببڕێت یان بەڵێن بدات
definition: Not displaying or pledging commitment to a particular view or course of action.
definitionEnglish: Not displaying or pledging commitment to a particular view or course of action.
exampleEnglish: Her answer was noncommittal.
exampleKurdish: وەڵامەکەی بێ لایەن بوو (نەیدەویست ڕای خۆی دەرببڕێت).

meaning: بێسەروبەری، نەبوونی دەسەڵات
definition: A state of disorder due to absence or non-recognition of authority.
definitionEnglish: A state of disorder due to absence or non-recognition of authority.
exampleEnglish: The country fell into anarchy after the government collapsed.
exampleKurdish: وڵات کەوتە ناو بێسەروبەرییەوە دوای ڕووخانی حکومەت.

meaning: شتێکی نەفرەتلێکراو یان زۆر ناخۆش
definition: Something or someone that one vehemently dislikes.
definitionEnglish: Something or someone that one vehemently dislikes.
exampleEnglish: Racial prejudice is anathema to her.
exampleKurdish: جیاکاری ڕەگەزی لای ئەو شتێکی نەفرەتلێکراوە.

meaning: یارمەتیدەر، لاوەکی
definition: Providing necessary support to the primary activities or operation of an organization, institution, or system.
definitionEnglish: Providing necessary support to the primary activities or operation of an organization, institution, or system.
exampleEnglish: Ancillary staff are vital to the hospital's functioning.
exampleKurdish: کارمەندانی یارمەتیدەر زۆر گرنگن بۆ کارکردنی نەخۆشخانەکە.

meaning: بەسەرهاتێکی کورت و خۆش
definition: A short amusing or interesting story about a real incident or person.
definitionEnglish: A short amusing or interesting story about a real incident or person.
exampleEnglish: He told us a funny anecdote about his school days.
exampleKurdish: بەسەرهاتێکی کورتی خۆشی بۆ گێڕاینەوە دەربارەی ڕۆژانی قوتابخانەی.

meaning: ئازارێکی زۆر (جەستەیی یان دەروونی)
definition: Severe mental or physical pain or suffering.
definitionEnglish: Severe mental or physical pain or suffering.
exampleEnglish: She was in deep anguish after the loss of her child.
exampleKurdish: لە ئازارێکی قووڵدا بوو دوای لەدەستدانی منداڵەکەی.

meaning: دوژمنایەتی، قین
definition: Strong hostility.
definitionEnglish: Strong hostility.
exampleEnglish: There is no personal animosity between the two leaders.
exampleKurdish: هیچ دوژمنایەتییەکی کەسی لە نێوان دوو سەرکردەکەدا نییە.

meaning: لکاندن، داگیرکردنی خاک
definition: Append or add as an extra or subordinate part, especially to a document; add (territory) to one's own territory by appropriation.
definitionEnglish: Append or add as an extra or subordinate part, especially to a document; add (territory) to one's own territory by appropriation.
exampleEnglish: The country planned to annex the neighboring island.
exampleKurdish: وڵاتەکە پلانی دانابوو دوورگەی دراوسێی بلکێنێت بە خۆیەوە.

meaning: لەناوبردن بە تەواوی، قڕکردن
definition: Destroy utterly; obliterate.
definitionEnglish: Destroy utterly; obliterate.
exampleEnglish: The nuclear explosion would annihilate the entire city.
exampleKurdish: تەقینەوە ئەتۆمییەکە هەموو شارەکە بە تەواوی لەناو دەبات.

meaning: نائاسایی، شتێک کە لە بارودۆخی ئاسایی لایداوە
definition: Something that deviates from what is standard, normal, or expected.
definitionEnglish: Something that deviates from what is standard, normal, or expected.
exampleEnglish: The test results were an anomaly.

meaning: دژایەتی، ململانێ
definition: Active hostility or opposition.
definitionEnglish: Active hostility or opposition.

exampleKurdish: دژایەتی نێوان دوو دراوسێکە ئاشکرا بوو.

meaning: پێشینە، شتێک کە پێش شتێکی تر دێت
definition: A thing or event that existed before or logically precedes another.
definitionEnglish: A thing or event that existed before or logically precedes another.
exampleEnglish: The historical antecedents of the conflict are complex.

meaning: زۆر کۆن، پێش زریان (بۆ گاڵتە بەکاردێت بۆ شتی مۆدێل کۆن)

definitionEnglish: Of or belonging to the time before the biblical Flood; ridiculously old-fashioned.

exampleKurdish: هەندێک بیرۆکەی زۆر کۆنیان هەیە دەربارەی پەروەردە.

meaning: بێزاری، ڕق لێ بوونەوەی سروشتی

definitionEnglish: A deep-seated feeling of dislike; aversion.

exampleKurdish: هەستی بە بێزارییەکی زۆر دەکرد بەرامبەر بەڕێوەبەرە نوێیەکە.

meaning: کۆن، لەکارکەوتوو

definitionEnglish: Old-fashioned or outdated.
exampleEnglish: The company's computer system is antiquated.
exampleKurdish: سیستەمی کۆمپیوتەری کۆمپانیاکە کۆن و لەکارکەوتووە.

meaning: دژ، پێچەوانەی تەواو
definition: A person or thing that is the direct opposite of someone or something else.
definitionEnglish: A person or thing that is the direct opposite of someone or something else.
exampleEnglish: Love is the antithesis of selfishness.

meaning: خەمساردی، بێباکی
definition: Lack of interest, enthusiasm, or concern.
definitionEnglish: Lack of interest, enthusiasm, or concern.

exampleKurdish: خەمساردییەکی بەرفراوان لە نێوان دەنگدەراندا هەیە.

exampleKurdish: لە تەمەنی ٤٠ ساڵیدا گەیشتە لووتکەی کارەکەی.

meaning: پەند، وتەی کورت و پڕ مانا
definition: A pithy observation that contains a general truth.
definitionEnglish: A pithy observation that contains a general truth.
exampleEnglish: The book is full of wise aphorisms.

meaning: متمانە بەخۆبوون، ئارامی لە کاتی قورسدا

definitionEnglish: Self-confidence or assurance, especially when in a demanding situation.

exampleKurdish: چاوپێکەوتنە قورسەکەی بە متمانە بەخۆبوونێکی زۆرەوە ئەنجامدا.

meaning: ڕازیکردن، هێورکردنەوە (بە پێدانی ئەوەی دەیانەوێت)
definition: Pacify or placate (someone) by acceding to their demands.
definitionEnglish: Pacify or placate (someone) by acceding to their demands.
exampleEnglish: The government tried to appease the protesters.

meaning: دڵەڕاوکێ، ترس لە داهاتوو؛ دەستگیرکردن

definitionEnglish: Anxiety or fear that something bad will happen; the action of arresting someone.

exampleKurdish: هەستی بە دڵەڕاوکێ دەکرد پێش تاقیکردنەوەکە.

meaning: پەسەندکردن، ستایش

definitionEnglish: Approval or praise.

meaning: گونجاو؛ (وەک کردار) داگیرکردن یان تەرخانکردن
definition: Suitable or proper in the circumstances; (verb) take (something) for one's own use, typically without the owner's permission.

definition: Based on random choice or personal whim, rather than any reason or system.
definitionEnglish: Based on random choice or personal whim, rather than any reason or system.

definitionEnglish: A very typical example of a certain person or thing.

meaning: بەجۆش و خرۆش، پڕ لە حەز

exampleKurdish: سەرکەوتن بەسەر چیاکەدا پڕ لە زەحمەت بوو.

exampleKurdish: ئەو قسەزانێکی لێهاتووە کە دەتوانێت بیرۆکە ئاڵۆزەکان بە ڕوونی ڕوون بکاتەوە.

definitionEnglish: Attribute something to (a cause).

exampleKurdish: سەرکەوتنی خۆی دەگەڕێنێتەوە بۆ کاری سەخت.

meaning: ناوزڕاندن، تانە و تەشەر
definition: An attack on the reputation or integrity of someone or something.
definitionEnglish: An attack on the reputation or integrity of someone or something.

exampleKurdish: تانە و تەشەری لە کەسایەتیم دا.

meaning: کۆششکەر، دڵسۆز لە کاردا
definition: Showing great care and perseverance.
definitionEnglish: Showing great care and perseverance.
exampleEnglish: She was assiduous in her duties.
exampleKurdish: لە ئەرکەکانیدا زۆر دڵسۆز و کۆششکەر بوو.

meaning: هێورکردنەوە، کەمکردنەوەی ئازار یان ترس
definition: Make (an unpleasant feeling) less intense.
definitionEnglish: Make (an unpleasant feeling) less intense.

exampleKurdish: دەرمانەکە یارمەتیدەر بوو بۆ کەمکردنەوەی ئازارەکەی.

definition: Having or showing an ability to accurately assess situations or people and turn this to one's advantage.
definitionEnglish: Having or showing an ability to accurately assess situations or people and turn this to one's advantage.

definition: (Of body tissue or an organ) waste away, especially as a result of the degeneration of cells, or become vestigial during evolution.
definitionEnglish: (Of body tissue or an organ) waste away, especially as a result of the degeneration of cells, or become vestigial during evolution.

meaning: لاوازکردن، کەمکردنەوەی هێز یان کاریگەری
definition: Reduce the force, effect, or value of.

exampleKurdish: دەرمانەکە بەکاردێت بۆ کەمکردنەوەی نیشانەکانی نەخۆشییەکە.

definition: Showing a willingness to take surprisingly bold risks.
definitionEnglish: Showing a willingness to take surprisingly bold risks.
exampleEnglish: It was an audacious plan to rob the bank.
exampleKurdish: پلانێکی ئازایانە (یان سەرەڕۆیانە) بوو بۆ دزینی بانکەکە.

meaning: زیادکردن، گەورەکردن
definition: Make (something) greater by adding to it; increase.
definitionEnglish: Make (something) greater by adding to it; increase.

exampleKurdish: ناچار بوو کارێکی دووەم بگرێت بۆ زیادکردنی داهاتەکەی.

meaning: نیشانەیەکە بۆ داهاتوو، پێشبینیکردن

exampleKurdish: سەرکەوتنی ئەم دوایییە نیشانەیەکی باشە بۆ داهاتووی کۆمپانیاکە.

meaning: بەختەوەر، نیشانەی سەرکەوتنی تێدایە
definition: Conducive to success; favorable.
definitionEnglish: Conducive to success; favorable.

meaning: سادە و بێ ڕازاوەیی، توند و جدی

definitionEnglish: Severe or strict in manner, attitude, or appearance.

exampleKurdish: ژوورەکە بە شێوازێکی زۆر سادە و بێ ڕازاوەیی ڕازاوەتەوە.

meaning: تاکڕەو، دیکتاتۆر
definition: Relating to a ruler who has absolute power.
definitionEnglish: Relating to a ruler who has absolute power.
exampleEnglish: The manager has an autocratic leadership style.

meaning: خۆبەڕێوەبەر، سەربەخۆ
definition: (Of a country or region) having the freedom to govern itself or control its own affairs.
definitionEnglish: (Of a country or region) having the freedom to govern itself or control its own affairs.
exampleEnglish: The region is an autonomous province.

meaning: چاوچنۆکی، حەزی زۆر بۆ پارە و سامان
definition: Extreme greed for wealth or material gain.
definitionEnglish: Extreme greed for wealth or material gain.
exampleEnglish: He was motivated by avarice rather than a desire to help.
exampleKurdish: ئەو زیاتر بەهۆی چاوچنۆکییەوە هاندرابوو نەک حەزی یارمەتیدان.

definition: State or assert to be the case.
definitionEnglish: State or assert to be the case.

exampleKurdish: بە توندی جەختی کردەوە کە ئەو بێتاوانە.

meaning: بێزاری، ڕق لێ بوونەوە
definition: A strong dislike or disinclination.
definitionEnglish: A strong dislike or disinclination.
exampleEnglish: He has a strong aversion to dogs.

meaning: بەجۆش و خرۆش، پڕ لە حەز
definition: Having or showing a keen interest in or enthusiasm for something.
definitionEnglish: Having or showing a keen interest in or enthusiasm for something.

exampleKurdish: ئەو خوێنەرێکی بەجۆش و خرۆشی چیرۆکە زانستییە خەیاڵییەکانە.

definition: Assert or confess openly.
definitionEnglish: Assert or confess openly.
exampleEnglish: He avowed his commitment to the cause.
exampleKurdish: پابەندبوونی خۆی بە ئامانجەکە بە ئاشکرا ڕاگەیاند.

meaning: وەک مام یان خاڵ، میهرەبان و دڵسۆز
definition: Relating to an uncle; kind and friendly towards a younger person.
definitionEnglish: Relating to an uncle; kind and friendly towards a younger person.
exampleEnglish: He gave me some avuncular advice.

meaning: خوار، تێکچوو، بە هەڵەدا چوو
definition: Away from the appropriate, planned, or expected course; amiss.
definitionEnglish: Away from the appropriate, planned, or expected course; amiss.
exampleEnglish: Our plans went awry due to the bad weather.

meaning: ڕاستییەکی سەلمێنراو، بنەما
definition: A statement or proposition which is regarded as being established, accepted, or self-evidently true.
definitionEnglish: A statement or proposition which is regarded as being established, accepted, or self-evidently true.
exampleEnglish: It is a political axiom that power corrupts.
exampleKurdish: ئەوە ڕاستییەکی سیاسییە کە دەسەڵات مرۆڤ تێکدەدات.

meaning: قسەی بێ مانا، زۆربڵێی
definition: Talk rapidly and continuously in a foolish, excited, or incomprehensible way.
definitionEnglish: Talk rapidly and continuously in a foolish, excited, or incomprehensible way.
exampleEnglish: The baby began to babble happily.
exampleKurdish: کۆرپەکە دەستی کرد بە قسەی بێ مانا بە دڵخۆشییەوە.

meaning: پڕ لە کەیف و سەفا و سەرخۆشی
definition: Characterized by or given to drunken revelry.
definitionEnglish: Characterized by or given to drunken revelry.
exampleEnglish: The party was a bacchanalian affair.
exampleKurdish: ئاهەنگەکە پڕ بوو لە کەیف و سەفا و سەرخۆشی.

meaning: بێزارکردن بە پرسیاری زۆر، پێداگری کردن
definition: Ask (someone) repeatedly and annoyingly for something; pester.
definitionEnglish: Ask (someone) repeatedly and annoyingly for something; pester.
exampleEnglish: The children badgered their parents for a new toy.
exampleKurdish: منداڵەکان دایبابانیان بێزار کرد بۆ کڕینی یارییەکی نوێ.

meaning: گاڵتەوگەپ، قسەی خۆش و سووک
definition: Humorous or witty conversation.
definitionEnglish: Humorous or witty conversation.
exampleEnglish: The two friends enjoyed a bit of playful badinage.
exampleKurdish: دوو هاوڕێکە چێژیان لە کەمێک گاڵتەوگەپ دەبینی.

meaning: سەرسامکردن، سەرلێشێواندن
definition: Totally bewilder or perplex.
definitionEnglish: Totally bewilder or perplex.
exampleEnglish: The mystery continues to baffle the police.

meaning: مەترسیدار، پڕ لە قین و هەڕەشە
definition: Threatening harm; menacing.
definitionEnglish: Threatening harm; menacing.
exampleEnglish: He gave me a baleful look.
exampleKurdish: نیگایەکی پڕ لە هەڕەشەی لێ کردم.

meaning: ڕەتکردنەوەی کارێک، دوودڵ بوون لە ئەنجامدانی
definition: Hesitate or be unwilling to accept an idea or undertaking.
definitionEnglish: Hesitate or be unwilling to accept an idea or undertaking.
exampleEnglish: He balked at the high price of the car.
exampleKurdish: دوودڵ بوو لە کڕینی ئۆتۆمبێلەکە بەهۆی نرخە بەرزەکەیەوە.

meaning: قورسایی بۆ هاوسەنگی (لە کەشتی یان باڵۆندا)
definition: Heavy material, such as gravel, sand, iron, or lead, placed low in a vessel to improve its stability.
definitionEnglish: Heavy material, such as gravel, sand, iron, or lead, placed low in a vessel to improve its stability.
exampleEnglish: The ship took on ballast to improve its stability.
exampleKurdish: کەشتییەکە قورسایی وەرگرت بۆ باشترکردنی هاوسەنگییەکەی.

meaning: مەرهەم، ئارامکەرەوە
definition: A fragrant ointment or preparation used to heal or soothe the skin.
definitionEnglish: A fragrant ointment or preparation used to heal or soothe the skin.
exampleEnglish: The music was a balm to his soul.
exampleKurdish: مۆسیقاکە ئارامکەرەوەیەک بوو بۆ ڕۆحی ئەو.

meaning: سادە و بێ مانا، دووبارە و بێزارکەر
definition: So lacking in originality as to be obvious and boring.
definitionEnglish: So lacking in originality as to be obvious and boring.
exampleEnglish: The movie had a banal plot.
exampleKurdish: فیلمەکە چیرۆکێکی سادە و بێزارکەری هەبوو.

meaning: بەڵا، هۆکاری ناخۆشی یان وێرانکاری
definition: A cause of great distress or annoyance.
definitionEnglish: A cause of great distress or annoyance.
exampleEnglish: The constant noise is the bane of my existence.

meaning: گاڵتەوگەپ، قسەی خۆش لە نێوان هاوڕێیاندا
definition: The playful and friendly exchange of teasing remarks.
definitionEnglish: The playful and friendly exchange of teasing remarks.
exampleEnglish: The two friends enjoyed a bit of friendly banter.
exampleKurdish: دوو هاوڕێکە چێژیان لە کەمێک گاڵتەوگەپی هاوڕێیانە دەبینی.

meaning: قسەی توند و ئازارەبەخش؛ دڕک یان سەرە تیژ
definition: A sharp projection near the end of an arrow, fishhook, or similar object, which is angled away from the main point so as to make extraction difficult; a deliberate insulting or cutting remark.
definitionEnglish: A sharp projection near the end of an arrow, fishhook, or similar object, which is angled away from the main point so as to make extraction difficult; a deliberate insulting or cutting remark.
exampleEnglish: His speech was full of barbs aimed at his opponent.
exampleKurdish: وتارەکەی پڕ بوو لە قسەی توند کە ئاراستەی ڕکابەرەکەی کرابوو.

meaning: شاعیر (بە تایبەت شاعیرە کۆنەکان)
definition: A poet, traditionally one reciting epics and associated with a particular oral tradition.
definitionEnglish: A poet, traditionally one reciting epics and associated with a particular oral tradition.
exampleEnglish: Shakespeare is often referred to as "the Bard".

meaning: پڕ لە ڕازاوەیی و وردەکاری (شێوازێکی هونەری)
definition: Relating to or denoting a style of European architecture, music, and art of the 17th and 18th centuries that is characterized by ornate detail.
definitionEnglish: Relating to or denoting a style of European architecture, music, and art of the 17th and 18th centuries that is characterized by ornate detail.
exampleEnglish: The church is decorated in a baroque style.
exampleKurdish: کەنیسەکە بە شێوازێکی بارۆک (پڕ لە وردەکاری) ڕازاوەتەوە.

meaning: کۆمەڵێکی زۆر لە شتێک (وەک پرسیار یان فیشەک)
definition: A concentrated outpouring, as of questions or blows.
definitionEnglish: A concentrated outpouring, as of questions or blows.
exampleEnglish: The minister faced a barrage of questions from reporters.
exampleKurdish: وەزیرەکە ڕووبەڕووی کۆمەڵێکی زۆر لە پرسیاری ڕۆژنامەنووسان بووەوە.

meaning: نەزۆک، وشک و بێ بەرهەم
definition: (Of land) too poor to produce much or any vegetation; (of a female animal) not producing offspring.
definitionEnglish: (Of land) too poor to produce much or any vegetation; (of a female animal) not producing offspring.
exampleEnglish: The land was barren and dry.
exampleKurdish: زەوییەکە وشک و بێ بەرهەم بوو.

meaning: ئاڵوگۆڕی کاڵا بە کاڵا (بێ پارە)
definition: Exchange (goods or services) for other goods or services without using money.
definitionEnglish: Exchange (goods or services) for other goods or services without using money.
exampleEnglish: They bartered their grain for salt.

meaning: چێژ وەرگرتن لە گەرمی یان خۆشی شتێک
definition: Lie exposed to warmth and light, typically from the sun, for relaxation and pleasure.
definitionEnglish: Lie exposed to warmth and light, typically from the sun, for relaxation and pleasure.
exampleEnglish: The cat liked to bask in the sun.
exampleKurdish: پشیلەکە حەزی دەکرد لەبەر خۆردا چێژ لە گەرمییەکە وەربگرێت.

meaning: قەڵا، پارێزەری بەهێزی بیرۆکەیەک یان شتێک
definition: An institution, place, or person strongly defending or upholding particular principles, attitudes, or activities.
definitionEnglish: An institution, place, or person strongly defending or upholding particular principles, attitudes, or activities.
exampleEnglish: The university is a bastion of free speech.

meaning: کەمکردنەوەی هێز یان خێرایی (زۆربەی کات لەگەڵ هەناسە بەکاردێت)
definition: Restrain or moderate (the force or intensity of something).
definitionEnglish: Restrain or moderate (the force or intensity of something).
exampleEnglish: We waited with bated breath for the results.
exampleKurdish: بە هەناسەبڕکێوە (بە پەرۆشەوە) چاوەڕێی ئەنجامەکانمان دەکرد.

meaning: شتێکی بێ نرخ و ڕازاوە
definition: A small, showy trinket or decoration.
definitionEnglish: A small, showy trinket or decoration.
exampleEnglish: The tree was decorated with shiny baubles.
exampleKurdish: دارەکە بە شتی ڕازاوەی بێ نرخ ڕازاوەتەوە.

meaning: قسەی ناشرین یان سێکسی بەڵام بە گاڵتەجاڕی
definition: Dealing with sexual matters in a comical way; humorously indecent.
definitionEnglish: Dealing with sexual matters in a comical way; humorously indecent.
exampleEnglish: The play was full of bawdy humor.
exampleKurdish: شانۆگەرییەکە پڕ بوو لە گاڵتەی ناشرین و سێکسی.

meaning: پڕ لە خۆشی و ئارامی (وەک فریشتە)
definition: Blissfully happy.
definitionEnglish: Blissfully happy.
exampleEnglish: She had a beatific smile on her face.
exampleKurdish: زەردەخەنەیەکی پڕ لە ئارامی و خۆشی لەسەر ڕووخساری بوو.

meaning: ڕازاندنەوە بە شێوەیەکی زۆر و ناشرین
definition: Dress up or decorate gaudily.
definitionEnglish: Dress up or decorate gaudily.
exampleEnglish: She was bedizened with cheap jewelry.
exampleKurdish: بە زێڕ و زیوی هەرزان و ناشرین خۆی ڕازاندبووەوە.

meaning: تەڕ و پیس بوون (بە قوڕ یان باران)
definition: Make (something) untidy and dirty by dragging it through mud or water.
definitionEnglish: Make (something) untidy and dirty by dragging it through mud or water.
exampleEnglish: The children came home bedraggled after playing in the rain.
exampleKurdish: منداڵەکان بە تەڕ و پیسی گەڕانەوە ماڵەوە دوای یاریکردن لەبەر باراندا.

meaning: سەرلێشێواندن، گێژکردن
definition: Make (someone) unable to think clearly.
definitionEnglish: Make (someone) unable to think clearly.
exampleEnglish: The complex instructions befuddled him.

meaning: دروستکردن، بوونە هۆی (زۆربەی کات بۆ منداڵ بوون)
definition: (Especially of a male parent) bring (a child) into existence by the process of reproduction; give rise to; bring about.
definitionEnglish: (Especially of a male parent) bring (a child) into existence by the process of reproduction; give rise to; bring about.
exampleEnglish: Violence begets violence.

meaning: بە چاوپیسییەوە سەیرکردن، حەسوودی بردن بە شتێکی کەسێک
definition: Envy (someone) the possession or enjoyment of (something).
definitionEnglish: Envy (someone) the possession or enjoyment of (something).
exampleEnglish: I don't begrudge him his success.

meaning: هەڵخەڵەتاندن بە جوانی یان قسەی خۆش
definition: Charm or enchant (someone), sometimes in a deceptive way.
definitionEnglish: Charm or enchant (someone), sometimes in a deceptive way.
exampleEnglish: He was beguiled by her beauty.

meaning: شتێکی زۆر زەبەلاح و گەورە
definition: A huge or monstrous creature; something enormous, especially a big and powerful organization.
definitionEnglish: A huge or monstrous creature; something enormous, especially a big and powerful organization.
exampleEnglish: The new corporation is a global behemoth.

meaning: قەرزاربار، سوپاسگوزار (بەهۆی یارمەتییەکەوە)
definition: Owing thanks or having a duty to someone in return for help or a service.
definitionEnglish: Owing thanks or having a duty to someone in return for help or a service.
exampleEnglish: I don't want to be beholden to anyone.

meaning: پێویستە، شیاوە بۆ کەسێک
definition: It is a duty or responsibility for someone to do something; it is incumbent on.
definitionEnglish: It is a duty or responsibility for someone to do something; it is incumbent on.
exampleEnglish: It behooves us to think carefully before we act.
exampleKurdish: پێویستە لەسەرمان بە وردی بیر بکەینەوە پێش ئەوەی کار بکەین.

meaning: درێژەدان بە باسێک بە شێوەیەکی بێزارکەر
definition: Argue or elaborate (a subject) in excessive detail.
definitionEnglish: Argue or elaborate (a subject) in excessive detail.
exampleEnglish: There is no need to belabor the point.
exampleKurdish: پێویست ناکات زیاتر درێژە بەم باسە بدەیت.

meaning: گەمارۆدان، خستنە ناو کێشەی زۆرەوە
definition: Besiege; beset with difficulties.
definitionEnglish: Besiege; beset with difficulties.
exampleEnglish: The beleaguered city finally surrendered.

meaning: نیشاندانی شتێک بە پێچەوانەی ڕاستییەکەی، شاردنەوە
definition: (Of an appearance) fail to give a true notion or impression of (something); disguise or contradict.
definitionEnglish: (Of an appearance) fail to give a true notion or impression of (something); disguise or contradict.
exampleEnglish: His calm face belied his inner nervousness.

meaning: بچووککردنەوە، سووکایەتی پێکردن
definition: Make (someone or something) seem unimportant.
definitionEnglish: Make (someone) seem unimportant.
exampleEnglish: He tends to belittle her achievements.
exampleKurdish: ئەو مەیلی هەیە دەستکەوتەکانی ئەو بە بچووک نیشان بدات.

meaning: شەڕخواز، حەز بە شەڕ کەر
definition: Demonstrating aggression and willingness to fight.
definitionEnglish: Demonstrating aggression and willingness to fight.
exampleEnglish: The country adopted a bellicose foreign policy.

meaning: شەڕکەر، دوژمنکارانە
definition: Hostile and aggressive.
definitionEnglish: Hostile and aggressive.
exampleEnglish: He became belligerent after drinking too much.
exampleKurdish: دوای خواردنەوەی زۆر بوو بە شەڕکەر و دوژمنکار.

meaning: ناڵاندن، خەم خواردن بۆ شتێک
definition: Express discontent or sorrow over (something).
definitionEnglish: Express discontent or sorrow over (something).
exampleEnglish: They bemoaned the loss of their traditional way of life.
exampleKurdish: خەمیان دەخوارد بۆ لەدەستدانی شێوازی ژیانی نەریتییان.

meaning: سەرسام، کەیفخۆش
definition: Finding something funny or entertaining.
definitionEnglish: Finding something funny or entertaining.
exampleEnglish: She looked amused by his story.
exampleKurdish: وا دیار بوو بە چیرۆکەکەی ئەو کەیفخۆش بووە.

meaning: دوعای خێر، پیرۆزبایی
definition: The utterance or bestowing of a blessing, especially at the end of a religious service.
definitionEnglish: The utterance or bestowing of a blessing, especially at the end of a religious service.
exampleEnglish: The priest gave the final benediction.

meaning: خێرخواز، یارمەتیدەر (بە تایبەت بە پارە)
definition: A person who gives money or other help to a person or cause.
definitionEnglish: A person who gives money or other help to a person or cause.
exampleEnglish: The library was built with money from a wealthy benefactor.
exampleKurdish: کتێبخانەکە بە پارەی خێرخوازێکی دەوڵەمەند دروستکرا.

meaning: چاکەکار، بەسوود
definition: (Of a person) generous or doing good.
definitionEnglish: (Of a person) generous or doing good.
exampleEnglish: The king was a beneficent ruler.

meaning: میهرەبان، خێرخواز
definition: Well meaning and kindly.
definitionEnglish: Well meaning and kindly.
exampleEnglish: He was a benevolent old man.

meaning: بێ زیان، میهرەبان، بێ مەترسی (بۆ نەخۆشی)
definition: Gentle and kindly; (of a disease) not harmful in effect.
definitionEnglish: Gentle and kindly; (of a disease) not harmful in effect.
exampleEnglish: The tumor was benign.

meaning: خوار؛ حەز و ئارەزووی سروشتی بۆ شتێک
definition: Sharply curved or having an angle; a natural talent or inclination.
definitionEnglish: Sharply curved or having an angle; a natural talent or inclination.
exampleEnglish: She has a natural bent for music.
exampleKurdish: ئەو حەز و بەهرەیەکی سروشتی بۆ مۆسیقا هەیە.

meaning: وەسیەتکردن، جێهێشتنی سامان بۆ کەسێک
definition: Leave (a property) to a person or other beneficiary by a will.
definitionEnglish: Leave (a property) to a person or other beneficiary by a will.
exampleEnglish: He bequeathed his entire fortune to charity.
exampleKurdish: هەموو سامانەکەی بۆ کاری خێرخوازی وەسیەت کرد.

meaning: سەرزەنشتکردنی توند
definition: Scold or criticize (someone) angrily.
definitionEnglish: Scold or criticize (someone) angrily.
exampleEnglish: She berated him for his carelessness.
exampleKurdish: بە توندی سەرزەنشتی کرد بەهۆی خەمساردییەکەیەوە.

meaning: خەمی لەدەستدانی کەسێکی نزیک (مردن)
definition: The action or condition of being bereaved; the period of grief and mourning after a death.
definitionEnglish: The action or condition of being bereaved; the period of grief and mourning after a death.
exampleEnglish: The family is suffering from a recent bereavement.
exampleKurdish: خێزانەکە بەدەست خەمی کۆچی دوایی کەسێکی نزیکیانەوە دەناڵێنن.

meaning: بێبەش، بێ شتێک (زۆربەی کات بۆ هەست یان هیوا)
definition: Deprived of or lacking (something).
definitionEnglish: Deprived of or lacking (something).
exampleEnglish: The accident left him bereft of hope.

meaning: شێتگیر، زۆر تووڕە و بێ کۆنترۆڵ
definition: Out of control with anger or excitement; wild or frenzied.
definitionEnglish: Out of control with anger or excitement; wild or frenzied.
exampleEnglish: He went berserk when he heard the news.
exampleKurdish: کە هەواڵەکەی بیست شێتگیر بوو (لە تووڕەییدا).

meaning: پاڕانەوە، داواکردن بە پەرۆشەوە
definition: Ask (someone) urgently and fervently to do something; implore; entreat.
definitionEnglish: Ask (someone) urgently and fervently to do something; implore; entreat.
exampleEnglish: I beseech you to reconsider your decision.
exampleKurdish: لێت دەپاڕێمەوە پێداچوونەوە بە بڕیارەکەتدا بکەیت.

meaning: گەمارۆدراو، پڕ لە کێشە و ناخۆشی
definition: (Of a problem or difficulty) trouble or threaten persistently.
definitionEnglish: (Of a problem or difficulty) trouble or threaten persistently.
exampleEnglish: The project was beset with difficulties from the start.
exampleKurdish: پڕۆژەکە لە سەرەتاوە پڕ بوو لە کێشە و زەحمەتی.

meaning: گەمارۆدان (بۆ شار یان کەسێک بە داواکاری زۆر)
definition: Surround (a place) with armed forces in order to capture it or force its surrender; be overwhelmed by too many people or things for one to deal with.
definitionEnglish: Surround (a place) with armed forces in order to capture it or force its surrender; be overwhelmed by too many people or things for one to deal with.
exampleEnglish: The army besieged the city for months.
exampleKurdish: سوپاکە بۆ ماوەی چەندین مانگ شارەکەی گەمارۆ دا.

meaning: ناوزڕاندن، پیسکردنی ناوبانگ
definition: Damage the reputation of (someone or something) in the opinion of others.
definitionEnglish: Damage the reputation of (someone or something) in the opinion of others.
exampleEnglish: He tried to besmirch my reputation with lies.
exampleKurdish: هەوڵیدا ناوبانگی من بە درۆ بڕوشێنێت.

meaning: وەک ئاژەڵ، دڕندانە
definition: Of or like an animal or animals; savagely cruel and depraved.
definitionEnglish: Of or like an animal or animals; savagely cruel and depraved.
exampleEnglish: The crime was committed with bestial cruelty.

meaning: بەخشین، پێدانی خەڵات یان ڕێزلێنان
definition: Confer or present (an honor, right, or gift).
definitionEnglish: Confer or present (an honor, right, or gift).
exampleEnglish: The title was bestowed upon him by the king.

meaning: نیشانەیەکە بۆ، ئاماژەدان بە
definition: Be a sign of; indicate.
definitionEnglish: Be a sign of; indicate.
exampleEnglish: The dark clouds betoken a storm.

meaning: خیانەتکردن؛ ئاشکراکردنی نهێنی بە هەڵە
definition: Expose (one's country, a group, or a person) to danger by treacherously giving information to an enemy; unintentionally reveal.
definitionEnglish: Expose (one's country, a group, or a person) to danger by treacherously giving information to an enemy; unintentionally reveal.
exampleEnglish: He felt that his friends had betrayed him.

meaning: سەرلێشێواندن، گێژکردن
definition: Cause (someone) to become perplexed and confused.
definitionEnglish: Cause (someone) to become perplexed and confused.
exampleEnglish: The complex instructions bewildered the students.

meaning: لایەنگری، پێشوەختە بڕیاردان
definition: Prejudice in favor of or against one thing, person, or group compared with another, usually in a way considered to be unfair.
definitionEnglish: Prejudice in favor of or against one thing, person, or group compared with another, usually in a way considered to be unfair.
exampleEnglish: The judge was accused of bias.

meaning: دەماقاڵێ لەسەر شتی بچووک
definition: Argue about petty and trivial matters.
definitionEnglish: Argue about petty and trivial matters.
exampleEnglish: The couple bickered all day long.
exampleKurdish: هاوسەرەکان هەموو ڕۆژەکە دەماقاڵێیان بوو لەسەر شتی بچووک.

meaning: دوو ساڵ جارێک ڕوودەدات
definition: Taking place every other year.
definitionEnglish: Taking place every other year.
exampleEnglish: The festival is a biennial event.

meaning: دوو لک، دابەشبوو بۆ دوو بەش
definition: Divided into two branches or forks.
definitionEnglish: Divided into two branches or forks.
exampleEnglish: The road bifurcated into two paths.

meaning: دەمارگیری، ڕق لە بیروبۆچوونی جیاواز
definition: Intolerance towards those who hold different opinions from oneself.
definitionEnglish: Intolerance towards those who hold different opinions from oneself.
exampleEnglish: We must fight against all forms of bigotry.
exampleKurdish: دەبێت دژی هەموو جۆرە دەمارگیرییەک بجەنگین.

meaning: پێست زەرد و ناخۆش؛ تووڕە و بێزارکەر
definition: Affected by or associated with nausea or vomiting; spiteful; bad-tempered.
definitionEnglish: Affected by or associated with nausea or vomiting; spiteful; bad-tempered.
exampleEnglish: He had a bilious expression on his face.
