meaning: کەسێک کە زوو ڕازی دەبێت و دەیەوێت خەڵک دڵخۆش بکات
definition: Willing to please others; obliging; agreeable.
definitionEnglish: Willing to please others; obliging; agreeable.
exampleEnglish: He was too complaisant to say no.
exampleKurdish: ئەو زۆر حەزی دەکرد خەڵک ڕازی بکات بۆیە نەیدەتوانی بڵێت نەخێر.

meaning: تەواوکەر، شتێک کە شتێکی دی تەواو دەکات
definition: A thing that completes or brings to perfection.
definitionEnglish: A thing that completes or brings to perfection.
exampleEnglish: The red wine is a perfect complement to the steak.
exampleKurdish: شەرابە سوورەکە تەواوکەرێکی نایابە بۆ گۆشتەکە.

meaning: پابەندبوون، جێبەجێکردنی فەرمان یان یاسا
definition: The action or fact of complying with a wish or command.
definitionEnglish: The action or fact of complying with a wish or command.
exampleEnglish: The company is in compliance with all safety regulations.
exampleKurdish: کۆمپانیاکە پابەندە بە هەموو ڕێنمایییەکانی سەلامەتی.

meaning: پابەند، کەسێک کە زوو فەرمان جێبەجێ دەکات
definition: Inclined to agree with others or obey rules, especially to an excessive degree; acquiescent.
definitionEnglish: Inclined to agree with others or obey rules, especially to an excessive degree; acquiescent.
exampleEnglish: The patient was very compliant with the doctor's instructions.
exampleKurdish: نەخۆشەکە زۆر پابەند بوو بە ڕێنمایییەکانی پزیشکەکەوە.

meaning: بەشداری لە تاوان یان کارێکی خراپ
definition: The state of being involved with others in an illegal activity or wrongdoing.
definitionEnglish: The state of being involved with others in an illegal activity or wrongdoing.
exampleEnglish: He was accused of complicity in the robbery.
exampleKurdish: تۆمەتبار کرا بە بەشداری لە دزییەکەدا.

meaning: بەش، پێکهاتە
definition: A part or element of a larger whole.
definitionEnglish: A part or element of a larger whole.
exampleEnglish: Trust is a vital component of a relationship.

meaning: ڕەفتارکردن (بە شێوەیەکی دیاریکراو)
definition: Conduct oneself; behave.
definitionEnglish: Conduct oneself; behave.
exampleEnglish: He comported himself with great dignity.

meaning: هێمنی، کۆنترۆڵکردنی هەستەکان
definition: The state or feeling of being calm and in control of oneself.
definitionEnglish: The state or feeling of being calm and in control of oneself.
exampleEnglish: She managed to keep her composure during the interview.
exampleKurdish: توانی هێمنی خۆی بپارێزێت لە کاتی چاوپێکەوتنەکەدا.

meaning: تێکەڵە؛ (وەک کردار) خراپترکردنی کێشەیەک
definition: A thing that is composed of two or more separate elements; a mixture; (verb) make (a hole or difficult situation) worse by adding to it.
definitionEnglish: A thing that is composed of two or more separate elements; a mixture; (verb) make (a hole or difficult situation) worse by adding to it.
exampleEnglish: The problem was compounded by a lack of communication.
exampleKurdish: کێشەکە خراپتر بوو بەهۆی نەبوونی پەیوەندییەوە.

meaning: گشتگیر، تێروتەسەل، هەموو شتێک دەگرێتەوە
definition: Complete; including all or nearly all elements or aspects of something.
definitionEnglish: Complete; including all or nearly all elements or aspects of something.
exampleEnglish: The report provides a comprehensive overview of the situation.
exampleKurdish: ڕاپۆرتەکە تێڕوانینێکی گشتگیر دەربارەی بارودۆخەکە پێشکەش دەکات.

meaning: پەستان، کەمکردنەوەی قەبارە
definition: Flatten by pressure; squeeze or press.
definitionEnglish: Flatten by pressure; squeeze or press.
exampleEnglish: The machine compresses the garbage into small blocks.
exampleKurdish: ئامێرەکە زبڵەکە دەپەستێنێت بۆ پارچەی بچووک.

meaning: پێکهاتن لە، گرتنەخۆ
definition: Consist of; be made up of.
definitionEnglish: Consist of; be made up of.
exampleEnglish: The team comprises ten members.

meaning: ڕێککەوتن بە دەستبەرداربوون لە هەندێک داواکاری؛ خستنە مەترسی
definition: An agreement or a settlement of a dispute that is reached by each side making concessions; (verb) settle a dispute by mutual concession; expediently accept standards that are lower than is desirable.
definitionEnglish: An agreement or a settlement of a dispute that is reached by each side making concessions; (verb) settle a dispute by mutual concession; expediently accept standards that are lower than is desirable.
exampleEnglish: We need to find a compromise.
exampleKurdish: دەبێت بگەینە ڕێککەوتنێک (کە هەردوولا ڕازی بن).

meaning: هەستکردن بە تاوان، پەشیمانی
definition: A feeling of guilt or moral scruple that prevents or follows the doing of something bad.
definitionEnglish: A feeling of guilt or moral scruple that prevents or follows the doing of something bad.
exampleEnglish: He showed no compunction for his crimes.
exampleKurdish: هیچ هەستێکی پەشیمانی بۆ تاوانەکانی نیشان نەدا.

meaning: هەژمارکردن، بەکارهێنانی ماتماتیک بۆ دۆزینەوەی ئەنجام
definition: Calculate or reckon (a figure or amount).
definitionEnglish: Calculate or reckon (a figure or amount).
exampleEnglish: The computer can compute millions of operations per second.
exampleKurdish: کۆمپیوتەرەکە دەتوانێت ملیۆنان کردار لە چرکەیەکدا هەژمار بکات.

meaning: قوپاو، ناوخوار (وەک ناوەوەی کەوچک)
definition: Having an outline or surface that curves inward like the interior of a circle or sphere.
definitionEnglish: Having an outline or surface that curves inward like the interior of a circle or sphere.
exampleEnglish: A concave lens spreads out light rays.
exampleKurdish: هاوێنەیەکی قوپاو تیشکەکانی ڕووناکی بڵاو دەکاتەوە.

meaning: قبوڵکردنی شکست یان ڕاستی شتێک (بە ناچاری)
definition: Admit that something is true or valid after first denying or resisting it; surrender or yield (something that one possesses).
definitionEnglish: Admit that something is true or valid after first denying or resisting it; surrender or yield (something that one possesses).
exampleEnglish: He finally conceded that he was wrong.
exampleKurdish: دواجار دانی بەوەدا نا کە هەڵە بووە.

meaning: خۆبەگەورەزانین، فیز؛ بیرۆکەیەکی خەیاڵی
definition: Excessive pride in oneself; a fanciful expression in writing or speech; an elaborate metaphor.
definitionEnglish: Excessive pride in oneself; a fanciful expression in writing or speech; an elaborate metaphor.
exampleEnglish: He was full of conceit.
exampleKurdish: پڕ بوو لە فیز و خۆبەگەورەزانین.

meaning: هاوچەق، بازنەیەک لە ناو بازنەیەکی دی
definition: Of or denoting circles, arcs, or other shapes which share the same center, the larger often completely surrounding the smaller.
definitionEnglish: Of or denoting circles, arcs, or other shapes which share the same center, the larger often completely surrounding the smaller.
exampleEnglish: The target has several concentric circles.

meaning: تێگەیشتن، بیرۆکە؛ دروستبوونی کۆرپەلە
definition: The action of conceiving a child or of a child being conceived; the forming or devising of a plan or idea.
definitionEnglish: The action of conceiving a child or of a child being conceived; the forming or devising of a plan or idea.
exampleEnglish: The plan was brilliant in its conception.
exampleKurdish: پلانەکە لە بیرۆکەکەیدا زۆر نایاب بوو.

meaning: هاوبەش، کارێک کە بە هاوکاری چەند کەسێک دەکرێت
definition: Jointly arranged, planned, or carried out; coordinated.
definitionEnglish: Jointly arranged, planned, or carried out; coordinated.
exampleEnglish: We need to make a concerted effort to solve the problem.
exampleKurdish: پێویستمان بە هەوڵێکی هاوبەشە بۆ چارەسەرکردنی کێشەکە.

meaning: سازش، دەستبەرداربوون لە شتێک بۆ گەیشتن بە ڕێککەوتن
definition: A thing that is granted, especially in response to demands; a compromise.
definitionEnglish: A thing that is granted, especially in response to demands; a compromise.
exampleEnglish: The government made several concessions to the protesters.
exampleKurdish: حکومەت چەند سازشێکی بۆ خۆپیشاندەران کرد.

meaning: ئاشتکەرەوە، هەوڵدان بۆ نەهێشتنی تووڕەیی
definition: Intended or likely to placate or pacify.
definitionEnglish: Intended or likely to placate or pacify.
exampleEnglish: He made a conciliatory gesture to his opponent.

meaning: کورت و پوخت، بێ قسەی زیادە
definition: Giving a lot of information clearly and in a few words; brief but comprehensive.
definitionEnglish: Giving a lot of information clearly and in a few words; brief but comprehensive.
exampleEnglish: The report was concise and easy to read.
exampleKurdish: ڕاپۆرتەکە کورت و پوخت بوو و خوێندنەوەی ئاسان بوو.

meaning: کۆبوونەوەیەکی نهێنی
definition: A private meeting.
definitionEnglish: A private meeting.
exampleEnglish: The cardinals met in a secret conclave to elect the new pope.
exampleKurdish: کاردیناڵەکان لە کۆبوونەوەیەکی نهێنیدا یەکتریان بینی بۆ هەڵبژاردنی پاپای نوێ.

meaning: یەکلاکەرەوە، بێ گومان
definition: (Of evidence or an argument) serving to settle an issue; convincing.
definitionEnglish: (Of evidence or an argument) serving to settle an issue; convincing.
exampleEnglish: The DNA test provided conclusive evidence of his guilt.
exampleKurdish: پشکنینی دی ئێن ئەی بەڵگەی یەکلاکەرەوەی بۆ تاوانباری ئەو پێشکەش کرد.

meaning: دروستکردنی شتێک (وەک خواردن یان درۆ) بە تێکەڵکردنی چەند شتێک
definition: Create or devise (especially a story or plan); make (a dish or meal) by combining various ingredients.
definitionEnglish: Create or devise (especially a story or plan); make (a dish or meal) by combining various ingredients.
exampleEnglish: He concocted a story to explain his absence.
exampleKurdish: چیرۆکێکی دروست کرد بۆ ڕوونکردنەوەی ئامادەنەبوونی.

meaning: هاوڕێ، شتێک کە لەگەڵ شتێکی دی ڕوودەدات
definition: Naturally accompanying or associated.
definitionEnglish: Naturally accompanying or associated.
exampleEnglish: Loss of memory is a concomitant of old age.

meaning: ڕێککەوتن، ئاشتی و تەبایی
definition: Agreement or harmony between people or groups.
definitionEnglish: Agreement or harmony between people or groups.
exampleEnglish: The two nations lived in concord for many years.
exampleKurdish: هەردوو نەتەوەکە بۆ چەندین ساڵ لە تەباییدا ژیان.

meaning: هاوڕایی؛ پێڕستی وشەکانی کتێبێک
definition: An alphabetical list of the words (especially the important ones) present in a text, usually with citations of the passages concerned; agreement; consistency.
definitionEnglish: An alphabetical list of the words (especially the important ones) present in a text, usually with citations of the passages concerned; agreement; consistency.
exampleEnglish: There is a concordance between the two reports.
exampleKurdish: هاوڕایی و گونجان لە نێوان هەردوو ڕاپۆرتەکەدا هەیە.

meaning: هاوڕا بوون، ڕازی بوون لەگەڵ کەسێکی دی
definition: Be of the same opinion; agree; happen or occur at the same time; coincide.
definitionEnglish: Be of the same opinion; agree; happen or occur at the same time; coincide.
exampleEnglish: I concur with your assessment of the situation.
exampleKurdish: من هاوڕام لەگەڵ هەڵسەنگاندنی تۆ بۆ بارودۆخەکە.

meaning: هاوکات، ڕوودانی چەند شتێک پێکەوە
definition: Existing, happening, or done at the same time.
definitionEnglish: Existing, happening, or done at the same time.
exampleEnglish: The two events were concurrent.

meaning: خۆبەگەورەزانین بەرامبەر کەسێک؛ قبوڵکردنی شتێک کە بە کەم دەیزانیت
definition: Show feelings of superiority; be patronizing; do something in a haughty way, as though it is below one's dignity or level of importance.
definitionEnglish: Show feelings of superiority; be patronizing; do something in a haughty way, as though it is below one's dignity or level of importance.
exampleEnglish: Don't condescend to me!
exampleKurdish: خۆت بەسەر مندا بە گەورە مەزانە!

meaning: بەهارات یان سۆس بۆ خۆشکردنی تامی خواردن
definition: A substance such as salt or ketchup that is used to add flavor to food.
definitionEnglish: A substance such as salt or ketchup that is used to add flavor to food.
exampleEnglish: Salt and pepper are common condiments.

meaning: هاوخەمی دەربڕین (بەتایبەت بۆ مردن)
definition: Express sympathy for (someone); grieve with.
definitionEnglish: Express sympathy for (someone); grieve with.
exampleEnglish: We went to condole with the family.
exampleKurdish: چووین بۆ ئەوەی هاوخەمی خۆمان بۆ خێزانەکە دەرببڕین.

meaning: چاوپۆشیکردن لە هەڵەیەک، قبوڵکردنی کارێکی خراپ
definition: Accept and allow (behavior that is considered morally wrong or offensive) to continue.
definitionEnglish: Accept and allow (behavior that is considered morally wrong or offensive) to continue.
exampleEnglish: The government does not condone violence.

meaning: یارمەتیدەر، شتێک کە دەبێتە هۆی ڕوودانی شتێکی باش
definition: Making a certain situation or outcome likely or possible.
definitionEnglish: Making a certain situation or outcome likely or possible.
exampleEnglish: The quiet atmosphere is conducive to study.

meaning: بۆری ئاو یان کارەبا؛ ڕێگەی گواستنەوەی زانیاری
definition: A channel for conveying water or other fluid; a tube or trough for protecting electric wiring; a person or organization that acts as a channel for the transmission of something.
definitionEnglish: A channel for conveying water or other fluid; a tube or trough for protecting electric wiring; a person or organization that acts as a channel for the transmission of something.
exampleEnglish: The internet is a conduit for information.

meaning: هاوڕێی نزیک و جێی متمانە (کە نهێنی پێ دەوترێت)
definition: A person with whom one shares a secret or private matter, trusting them not to tell others.
definitionEnglish: A person with whom one shares a secret or private matter, trusting them not to tell others.
exampleEnglish: He is my closest friend and confidant.
exampleKurdish: ئەو نزیکترین هاوڕێ و جێی متمانەی منە.

meaning: سنووردارکردن، بەندکردن لە شوێنێکدا
definition: Keep or restrict someone or something within certain limits of (space, scope, quantity, or time).
definitionEnglish: Keep or restrict someone or something within certain limits of (space, scope, quantity, or time).
exampleEnglish: The prisoner was confined to his cell.

meaning: دەستبەسەرداگرتن (بە فەرمی)
definition: Take or seize (someone's property) with authority.
definitionEnglish: Take or seize (someone's property) with authority.
exampleEnglish: The police confiscated the illegal drugs.
exampleKurdish: پۆلیس دەستی بەسەر ماددە بێهۆشکەرە نایاسایییەکاندا گرت.

meaning: ئاگرکەوتنەوەیەکی گەورە و وێرانکەر
definition: An extensive fire which destroys a great deal of land or property.
definitionEnglish: An extensive fire which destroys a great deal of land or property.
exampleEnglish: The conflagration destroyed the entire forest.
exampleKurdish: ئاگرکەوتنەوە گەورەکە هەموو دارستانەکەی وێران کرد.

meaning: شوێنی یەکگرتنی دوو ڕووبار؛ یەکگرتنی چەند شتێک
definition: The junction of two rivers, especially rivers of approximately equal width; an act or process of merging.
definitionEnglish: The junction of two rivers, especially rivers of approximately equal width; an act or process of merging.
exampleEnglish: The city was built at the confluence of two rivers.
exampleKurdish: شارەکە لە شوێنی یەکگرتنی دوو ڕووبار دروست کراوە.

meaning: پابەندبوون بە یاسا یان نەریت؛ هاوشێوەیی
definition: Compliance with standards, rules, or laws; behavior in accordance with socially accepted conventions or standards.
definitionEnglish: Compliance with standards, rules, or laws; behavior in accordance with socially accepted conventions or standards.
exampleEnglish: There is a need for conformity to the rules.
exampleKurdish: پێویستی بە پابەندبوون بە یاساکان هەیە.

meaning: سەرلێشێواندن، گێژکردن؛ تێکەڵکردنی دوو شت
definition: Cause surprise or confusion in (someone), especially by acting against their expectations; mix up (something) with something else so that the individual elements become difficult to distinguish.
definitionEnglish: Cause surprise or confusion in (someone), especially by acting against their expectations; mix up (something) with something else so that the individual elements become difficult to distinguish.
exampleEnglish: The rise in prices confounded the experts.

meaning: بەستن یان مەیین (بۆ شلە کاتێک سارد دەبێتەوە)
definition: Solidify or coagulate, especially by cooling.
definitionEnglish: Solidify or coagulate, especially by cooling.
exampleEnglish: The blood had congealed around the wound.

meaning: هاوشێوە لە حەز و ڕەفتاردا؛ ئاسوودە و خۆش
definition: (Of a person) pleasant because of a personality, qualities, or interests that are similar to one's own; (of a thing) pleasant or agreeable because suited to one's taste or inclination.
definitionEnglish: (Of a person) pleasant because of a personality, qualities, or interests that are similar to one's own; (of a thing) pleasant or agreeable because suited to one's taste or inclination.
exampleEnglish: He found a congenial atmosphere in the library.
exampleKurdish: کەشوهەوایەکی ئاسوودە و گونجاوی لە کتێبخانەکەدا دۆزییەوە.

meaning: زگماک، شتێک کە لە کاتی لەدایکبوونەوە هەیە
definition: (Of a disease or physical abnormality) present from birth; (of a person) having a particular trait from birth or by firmly established habit.
definitionEnglish: (Of a disease or physical abnormality) present from birth; (of a person) having a particular trait from birth or by firmly established habit.
exampleEnglish: The child has a congenital heart defect.

meaning: کۆمەڵە شتێکی جیاواز کە پێکەوە کۆکراونەتەوە
definition: A number of different things, parts or items that are grouped together; a mixture.
definitionEnglish: A number of different things, parts or items that are grouped together; a mixture.
exampleEnglish: The city is a conglomeration of different cultures.

meaning: هاوشێوە، گونجاو لەگەڵ یەکتر (لە ماتماتیک و ژیاندا)
definition: In agreement or harmony; (of geometric figures) identical in form; coinciding exactly when superimposed.
definitionEnglish: In agreement or harmony; (of geometric figures) identical in form; coinciding exactly when superimposed.
exampleEnglish: Their goals are congruent with the company's mission.
exampleKurdish: ئامانجەکانی ئەوان گونجاوە لەگەڵ پەیامی کۆمپانیاکە.

meaning: داری سنەوبەر (ئەو دارانەی گۆچکەیان هەیە)
definition: A tree that bears cones and needle-like or scale-like leaves that are typically evergreen.
definitionEnglish: A tree that bears cones and needle-like or scale-like leaves that are typically evergreen.
exampleEnglish: Pines and firs are examples of conifers.
exampleKurdish: سنەوبەر و چنار نموونەی دارە گۆچکەدارەکانن.

meaning: پێشبینی، بڕیاردان بێ بەڵگەی تەواو
definition: An opinion or conclusion formed on the basis of incomplete information.
definitionEnglish: An opinion or conclusion formed on the basis of incomplete information.
exampleEnglish: The cause of the fire is still a matter of conjecture.
exampleKurdish: هۆکاری ئاگرکەوتنەوەکە هێشتا جێگەی پێشبینییە (بەڵگەی تەواو نییە).

meaning: هاوسەری، پەیوەست بە هاوسەرگیری
definition: Relating to marriage or the relationship between a married couple.
definitionEnglish: Relating to marriage or the relationship between a married couple.
exampleEnglish: The prisoner was granted a conjugal visit.
exampleKurdish: زیندانییەکە ڕێگەی پێدرا سەردانی هاوسەریی بکات.

meaning: دروستکردنی شتێک بە جادوو؛ هێنانەوەی وێنەیەک بۆ ناو مێشک
definition: Make (something) appear unexpectedly or seemingly from nowhere as if by magic; call upon (a spirit or ghost) to appear, by means of a magic ritual.
definitionEnglish: Make (something) appear unexpectedly or seemingly from nowhere as if by magic; call upon (a spirit or ghost) to appear, by means of a magic ritual.
exampleEnglish: The music conjured up memories of her childhood.
exampleKurdish: مۆسیقاکە یادەوەرییەکانی منداڵی هێنایەوە ناو مێشکی.

meaning: چاوپۆشیکردن لە کارێکی خراپ (بە نهێنی)
definition: Willingness to allow or be secretly involved in an immoral or illegal act.
definitionEnglish: Willingness to allow or be secretly involved in an immoral or illegal act.
exampleEnglish: The crime was committed with the connivance of the police.
exampleKurdish: تاوانەکە بە چاوپۆشی نهێنی پۆلیس ئەنجامدرا.

meaning: شارەزا، کەسێک کە تام و چێژی زۆر باشی هەیە (لە هونەر یان خواردن)
definition: An expert judge in matters of taste.
definitionEnglish: An expert judge in matters of taste.
exampleEnglish: He is a connoisseur of fine wines.

meaning: مانای ناڕاستەوخۆ، هەستێک کە وشەیەک دروستی دەکات
definition: An idea or feeling that a word invokes in addition to its literal or primary meaning.
definitionEnglish: An idea or feeling that a word invokes in addition to its literal or primary meaning.
exampleEnglish: The word "home" has positive connotations.

meaning: هاوسەری، پەیوەست بە ژیانی هاوسەری
definition: Relating to marriage or the relationship of a married couple; conjugal.
definitionEnglish: Relating to marriage or the relationship of a married couple; conjugal.
exampleEnglish: They lived in connubial bliss.

meaning: خزمایەتی خوێن، پەیوەندی خێزانی
definition: The fact of being descended from the same ancestor.
definitionEnglish: The fact of being descended from the same ancestor.
exampleEnglish: The two families were linked by consanguinity.
exampleKurdish: هەردوو خێزانەکە بە خزمایەتی خوێن پێکەوە بەسترابوون.

meaning: ویژدان زیندوو، کەسێک کە کارەکانی بە وردی دەکات
definition: (Of a person) wishing to do what is right, especially to do one's work or duty well and thoroughly.
definitionEnglish: (Of a person) wishing to do what is right, especially to do one's work or duty well and thoroughly.
exampleEnglish: She is a very conscientious student.
exampleKurdish: ئەو قوتابییەکی زۆر ویژدان زیندوو و وردە.

meaning: سەربازی زۆرەملێ
definition: Enlist (someone) compulsorily, typically into the armed services.
definitionEnglish: Enlist (someone) compulsorily, typically into the armed services.
exampleEnglish: He was conscripted into the army at the age of 18.
exampleKurdish: لە تەمەنی ١٨ ساڵیدا بە زۆر کرا بە سەرباز.

meaning: پیرۆزکردن، تەرخانکردن بۆ مەبەستێکی ئایینی
definition: Make or declare (something, typically a church) sacred; dedicate formally to a religious or divine purpose.
definitionEnglish: Make or declare (something, typically a church) sacred; dedicate formally to a religious or divine purpose.

exampleKurdish: سەگەکە لە سووچەکەدا لەبەر ترس کز ببوو.

meaning: خەمبار، نائومێد (بەتایبەت دوای سەرنەکەوتن)

definitionEnglish: Showing fearlessness and determination.
exampleEnglish: He was a dauntless explorer.

meaning: خاو کارکردن، کات بە فیڕۆدان
definition: Waste time; be slow.
definitionEnglish: Waste time; be slow.
exampleEnglish: Stop dawdling and finish your homework.
exampleKurdish: واز لە خاو کارکردن بهێنە و ئەرکەکانت تەواو بکە.

meaning: بنەبەست، بارودۆخێک کە هیچ لایەک ناتوانێت بڕیار بدات
definition: A situation, typically one involving opposing parties, in which no progress can be made.
definitionEnglish: A situation, typically one involving opposing parties, in which no progress can be made.
exampleEnglish: The negotiations reached a deadlock.

meaning: بێ هەست، ڕووخسارێک کە هیچ هەستێکی تێدا دەرناکەوێت (بەتایبەت بۆ گاڵتە)
definition: Impassive or expressionless.
definitionEnglish: Impassive or expressionless.
exampleEnglish: He delivered the joke in a deadpan voice.
exampleKurdish: بە دەنگێکی بێ هەست گاڵتەکەی گێڕایەوە.

meaning: کەمی، نەبوونی شتێکی پێویست
definition: A scarcity or lack of something.
definitionEnglish: A scarcity or lack of something.
exampleEnglish: There is a dearth of evidence in this case.

meaning: شکستێکی گەورە و شەرمەزارکەر
definition: A sudden and ignominious failure; a fiasco.
definitionEnglish: A sudden and ignominious failure; a fiasco.
exampleEnglish: The economic debacle led to many job losses.
exampleKurdish: شکستە ئابوورییە گەورەکە بووە هۆی لەدەستدانی زۆر هەلی کار.

meaning: دابەزاندنی نرخ یان بەهای شتێک
definition: Reduce (something) in quality or value; degrade.
definitionEnglish: Reduce (something) in quality or value; degrade.
exampleEnglish: The currency was debased by inflation.

meaning: خراپکردنی ڕەوشتی کەسێک؛ بەڕەڵایی
definition: Destroy or corrupt the chastity or virtue of (someone); seduce.
definitionEnglish: Destroy or corrupt the chastity or virtue of (someone); seduce.
exampleEnglish: The youth was debauched by bad company.
exampleKurdish: گەنجەکە بەهۆی هاوڕێی خراپەوە ڕەوشتی تێکچوو.

meaning: بێهێزکردن، لاوازکردنی جەستە یان توانای کەسێک
definition: Make (someone) very weak and infirm.
definitionEnglish: Make (someone) very weak and infirm.
exampleEnglish: The disease debilitated him.

meaning: دڵگیر، ڕێک و پێک و متمانەبەخۆ (بۆ پیاو)
definition: (Of a man) confident, stylish, and charming.
definitionEnglish: (Of a man) confident, stylish, and charming.
exampleEnglish: He was a debonair young man.

meaning: پاشماوە، پارچە شکاوەکانی شتێک
definition: Scattered fragments, typically of something wrecked or destroyed.
definitionEnglish: Scattered fragments, typically of something wrecked or destroyed.
exampleEnglish: The street was covered with debris after the explosion.
exampleKurdish: شەقامەکە پڕ ببوو لە پاشماوە دوای تەقینەوەکە.

meaning: بە درۆ خستنەوە، ئاشکراکردنی ناڕاستی بیرۆکەیەک
definition: Expose the falseness or hollowness of (a myth, idea, or belief).
definitionEnglish: Expose the falseness or hollowness of (a myth, idea, or belief).
exampleEnglish: The scientist debunked the myth.

meaning: کچێکی گەنج کە بۆ یەکەمجار لە کۆمەڵگەیەکی باڵادا دەردەکەوێت
definition: An upper-class young woman making her first appearance in fashionable society.
definitionEnglish: An upper-class young woman making her first appearance in fashionable society.
exampleEnglish: She was the most beautiful debutante of the season.
exampleKurdish: جوانترین کچی گەنج بوو کە لەو وەرزەدا ناسێندرا.

meaning: داڕمانی ڕەوشتی، تێکچوونی بەهاکان بەهۆی خۆشگوزەرانی زۆرەوە
definition: Moral or cultural decline as characterized by excessive indulgence in pleasure or luxury.
definitionEnglish: Moral or cultural decline as characterized by excessive indulgence in pleasure or luxury.
exampleEnglish: The decadence of the Roman Empire.
exampleKurdish: داڕمانی ڕەوشتی و کولتووری ئیمپراتۆریەتی ڕۆمانی.

meaning: ڕشتنی شلە لە قاپێکەوە بۆ یەکێکی دی (بۆ جیاکردنەوەی پاشماوە)
definition: Gradually pour (liquid, typically wine or a solution) from one container into another, typically in order to separate out sediment.
definitionEnglish: Gradually pour (liquid, typically wine or a solution) from one container into another, typically in order to separate out sediment.
exampleEnglish: He decanted the wine into a crystal bottle.

meaning: سەربڕین، جیاکردنەوەی سەر لە جەستە
definition: Cut off the head of (a person or animal).
definitionEnglish: Cut off the head of (a person or animal).
exampleEnglish: The statue was decapitated by vandals.
exampleKurdish: پەیکەرەکە لە لایەن تێکدەرانەوە سەری لێکرایەوە.

meaning: خاوکردنەوە، کەمکردنەوەی خێرایی
definition: Reduce the speed of; lose speed.
definitionEnglish: Reduce the speed of; lose speed.
exampleEnglish: The car began to decelerate as it approached the turn.
exampleKurdish: ئۆتۆمبێلەکە دەستی کرد بە خاوکردنەوە کاتێک لە سووڕانەوەکە نزیک بووەوە.

meaning: وەریو، دارێک کە گەڵاکانی لە پاییزدا دەوەرێت
definition: (Of a tree or shrub) shedding its leaves annually.
definitionEnglish: (Of a tree or shrub) shedding its leaves annually.
exampleEnglish: Oak is a deciduous tree.

meaning: لەناوبردنی بەشێکی گەورە لە شتێک
definition: Kill, destroy, or remove a large percentage or part of.
definitionEnglish: Kill, destroy, or remove a large percentage or part of.
exampleEnglish: The population was decimated by the plague.

meaning: خوێندنەوەی کۆد یان نووسینێکی زەحمەت
definition: Convert (a text written in code, or a coded signal) into normal language.
definitionEnglish: Convert (a text written in code, or a coded signal) into normal language.
exampleEnglish: I couldn't decipher his handwriting.

meaning: لێژی، شوێنێکی نزم و لێژ
definition: A downward slope.
definitionEnglish: A downward slope.
exampleEnglish: The house was built on a steep declivity.
exampleKurdish: خانووەکە لەسەر لێژییەکی توند دروست کرابوو.

meaning: جلوبەرگێک کە مل و بەشی سەرەوەی سنگی دیارە
definition: (Of a woman's dress) having a low neckline.
definitionEnglish: (Of a woman's dress) having a low neckline.
exampleEnglish: She wore a decollete evening gown.
exampleKurdish: کراسێکی ئێوارانی لەبەر کردبوو کە ملی دیار بوو.

meaning: پوکانەوە، گەنین، تێکچوونی ماددە
definition: The state or process of rotting; decay.
definitionEnglish: The state or process of rotting; decay.
exampleEnglish: The decomposition of organic matter.

meaning: بەڕێز، ڕێک و پێک، کەسێک کە ڕەفتاری جوانە
definition: In keeping with good taste and propriety; polite and restrained.
definitionEnglish: In keeping with good taste and propriety; polite and restrained.
exampleEnglish: They maintained a decorous silence.

meaning: ڕەوشت بەرزی، ڕەفتاری شایستە و بەڕێز
definition: Behavior in keeping with good taste and propriety.
definitionEnglish: Behavior in keeping with good taste and propriety.
exampleEnglish: He exhibited high standards of decorum.

meaning: تەڵە، شتێک بۆ هەڵخەڵەتاندن و ڕاکێشانی کەسێک یان ئاژەڵێک
definition: A bird or mammal, or an imitation of one, used by hunters to attract other birds or mammals; a person or thing used to mislead or lure an animal or person into a trap.
definitionEnglish: A bird or mammal, or an imitation of one, used by hunters to attract other birds or mammals; a person or thing used to mislead or lure an animal or person into a trap.
exampleEnglish: The police used a decoy to catch the thief.
exampleKurdish: پۆلیس تەڵەیەکیان بەکارهێنا بۆ گرتنی دزەکە.

meaning: پەککەوتە، زۆر کۆن و تێکچوو (بۆ کەس یان شت)
definition: (Of a person) elderly and infirm; worn out or ruined because of age or neglect.
definitionEnglish: (Of a person) elderly and infirm; worn out or ruined because of age or neglect.
exampleEnglish: The building was in a decrepit state.
exampleKurdish: باڵەخانەکە لە بارودۆخێکی زۆر کۆن و تێکچوودا بوو.

meaning: سەرکۆنەکردن، ڕەخنەگرتنی توند لە شتێک بە ئاشکرا
definition: Publicly denounce.
definitionEnglish: Publicly denounce.
exampleEnglish: They decried the government's decision.

meaning: ئەنجامگیری، گەیشتن بە ئەنجامێک لە ڕێگەی بەڵگەوە
definition: Arrive at (a fact or a conclusion) by reasoning; draw as a logical conclusion.
definitionEnglish: Arrive at (a fact or a conclusion) by reasoning; draw as a logical conclusion.
exampleEnglish: From the evidence, we can deduce that he is innocent.
exampleKurdish: لە بەڵگەکانەوە دەتوانین ئەوە هەڵبهێنجێنین کە ئەو بێتاوانە.

meaning: دزینی پارە (بەتایبەت پارەی گشتی یان کۆمپانیا)
definition: Embezzle (funds with which one has been entrusted).
definitionEnglish: Embezzle (funds with which one has been entrusted).
exampleEnglish: The official was accused of defalcating public funds.
exampleKurdish: بەرپرسەکە تۆمەتبار کرا بە دزینی پارەی گشتی.

meaning: ناوزڕاندن، تێکدانی ناوبانگی کەسێک بە ناڕاستی
definition: The action of damaging the good reputation of someone; slander or libel.
definitionEnglish: The action of damaging the good reputation of someone; slander or libel.
exampleEnglish: He sued the newspaper for defamation.
exampleKurdish: داوای یاسایی لەسەر ڕۆژنامەکە تۆمار کرد بەهۆی ناوزڕاندنەوە.

meaning: نەدانەوەی قەرز؛ باری بنەڕەتی؛ ئامادەنەبوون لە کاتی دیاریکراودا
definition: Failure to fulfill an obligation, especially to repay a loan or appear in a court of law; a preselected option adopted by a computer program or other mechanism when no alternative is specified by the user or programmer.
definitionEnglish: Failure to fulfill an obligation, especially to repay a loan or appear in a court of law; a preselected option adopted by a computer program or other mechanism when no alternative is specified by the user or programmer.
exampleEnglish: The company is in default on its loan payments.

meaning: کەسێک کە زوو بێ ئومێد دەبێت و پێی وایە هەر دەدۆڕێت
definition: A person who expects or is excessively ready to accept failure.
definitionEnglish: A person who expects or is excessively ready to accept failure.
exampleEnglish: He has a defeatist attitude.

meaning: کەموکوڕی؛ (وەک کردار) جێهێشتنی وڵات یان حیزب بۆ لایەکی دی
definition: A shortcoming, imperfection, or lack; (verb) abandon one's country or cause in favor of an opposing one.
definitionEnglish: A shortcoming, imperfection, or lack; (verb) abandon one's country or cause in favor of an opposing one.
exampleEnglish: The product has a serious defect.

meaning: ڕێزگرتن، ملدان بۆ بڕیاری کەسێکی دی لەبەر ڕێز
definition: Humble submission and respect.
definitionEnglish: Humble submission and respect.
exampleEnglish: He addressed her with great deference.
exampleKurdish: بە ڕێزێکی زۆرەوە قسەی لەگەڵ کرد.

meaning: پیسکردن، تێکدانی پیرۆزی شتێک
definition: Sully, mar, or spoil; desecrate or profane (something sacred).
definitionEnglish: Sully, mar, or spoil; desecrate or profane (something sacred).
exampleEnglish: The temple was defiled by the invaders.
exampleKurdish: پەرستگاکە لە لایەن داگیرکەرانەوە بێ ڕێزی پێکرا و پیسکرا.

meaning: کۆتایی، یەکلاکەرەوە، باشترین نموونە
definition: (Of a conclusion or agreement) done or reached decisively and with authority; (of a book or other text) the most authoritative of its kind.
definitionEnglish: (Of a conclusion or agreement) done or reached decisively and with authority; (of a book or other text) the most authoritative of its kind.
exampleEnglish: This is the definitive study on the subject.
exampleKurdish: ئەمە باشترین و جێ متمانەترین لێکۆڵینەوەیە لەسەر ئەم بابەتە.

meaning: لادان، گۆڕینی ئاراستەی شتێک
definition: Cause (something) to change direction by interposing something; turn aside from a straight course.
definitionEnglish: Cause (something) to change direction by interposing something; turn aside from a straight course.
exampleEnglish: The bullet was deflected by his armor.

meaning: وەراندنی گەڵای دار (بەتایبەت بە ماددەی کیمیایی)
definition: Remove leaves from (a tree, plant, or area of land), for agricultural purposes or as a military tactic.
definitionEnglish: Remove leaves from (a tree, plant, or area of land), for agricultural purposes or as a military tactic.
exampleEnglish: The trees were defoliated by the chemical spray.
exampleKurdish: دارەکان گەڵاکانیان وەری بەهۆی ڕشتنی ماددە کیمیایییەکەوە.

meaning: دابینکردنی تێچووی شتێک، پارەدان بۆ خەرجییەکان
definition: Provide money to pay (a cost or expense).
definitionEnglish: Provide money to pay (a cost or expense).
exampleEnglish: The grant will help defray the costs of the research.
exampleKurdish: بەخشینەکە یارمەتیدەر دەبێت بۆ دابینکردنی تێچووی توێژینەوەکە.

meaning: شارەزا، چالاک و خێرا (بەتایبەت بۆ دەست)
definition: Neatly skillful and quick in one's movements.
definitionEnglish: Neatly skillful and quick in one's movements.
exampleEnglish: He made a deft move to avoid the punch.
exampleKurdish: جوڵەیەکی خێرا و شارەزایانەی کرد بۆ دوورکەوتنەوە لە لێدانەکە.

meaning: نەماو، لەکارکەوتوو، شتێک کە چیتر بوونی نییە
definition: No longer existing or functioning.
definitionEnglish: No longer existing or functioning.
exampleEnglish: The company is now defunct.

meaning: داڕمان، تێکچوونی بارودۆخ یان ڕەوشت
definition: Having lost the physical, mental, or moral qualities considered normal and desirable; showing evidence of decline.
definitionEnglish: Having lost the physical, mental, or moral qualities considered normal and desirable; showing evidence of decline.
exampleEnglish: The debate degenerated into a shouting match.
exampleKurdish: گفتوگۆکە تێکچوو و بوو بە هاوارەهاوار.

meaning: سووکایەتی پێکردن؛ دابەزاندنی نرخ یان پلە
definition: Treat or regard (someone) with contempt or disrespect; lower the character or quality of.
definitionEnglish: Treat or regard (someone) with contempt or disrespect; lower the character or quality of.
exampleEnglish: Don't degrade yourself by lying.

meaning: وشککردنەوە، لەدەستدانی ئاوی جەستە
definition: Cause (a person or their body) to lose a large amount of water; remove water from (food) in order to preserve it.
definitionEnglish: Cause (a person or their body) to lose a large amount of water; remove water from (food) in order to preserve it.
exampleEnglish: Running in the heat can dehydrate you.
exampleKurdish: ڕاکردن لە گەرمادا دەبێتە هۆی وشکبوونەوەی جەستەت.

meaning: پەرستن، کردنی کەسێک بە خودا یان زۆر گەورەکردنی
definition: Worship, regard, or treat (someone or something) as a god.
definitionEnglish: Worship, regard, or treat (someone or something) as a god.
exampleEnglish: The ancient Egyptians deified the sun.

meaning: خۆ بە گەورە زانین بۆ ئەنجامدانی کارێک
definition: Do something that one considers to be beneath one's dignity.
definitionEnglish: Do something that one considers to be beneath one's dignity.
exampleEnglish: She did not deign to answer the question.
exampleKurdish: ئەوەندە خۆی بە گەورە دەزانی کە وەڵامی پرسیارەکەی نەدایەوە.

meaning: خۆش، بەتام (بۆ خواردن)؛ سەرنجڕاکێش
definition: (Of food or drink) delicious; extremely attractive.
definitionEnglish: (Of food or drink) delicious; extremely attractive.
exampleEnglish: The cake was delectable.

meaning: نوێنەر؛ (وەک کردار) سپاردنی کارێک بە کەسێکی دی
definition: A person sent or authorized to represent others, in particular an elected representative sent to a conference; (verb) entrust (a task or responsibility) to another person, typically one who is less senior than oneself.
definitionEnglish: A person sent or authorized to represent others, in particular an elected representative sent to a conference; (verb) entrust (a task or responsibility) to another person, typically one who is less senior than oneself.
exampleEnglish: The manager delegated the task to his assistant.

meaning: زیانبەخش، خراپ بۆ تەندروستی یان کارێک
definition: Causing harm or damage.
definitionEnglish: Causing harm or damage.
exampleEnglish: Smoking has a deleterious effect on health.
exampleKurdish: جگەرەکێشان کاریگەرییەکی زیانبەخشی هەیە لەسەر تەندروستی.

meaning: بە ئەنقەست؛ (وەک کردار) بیرکردنەوەی قووڵ پێش بڕیاردان
definition: Done consciously and intentionally; (verb) engage in long and careful consideration.
definitionEnglish: Done consciously and intentionally; (verb) engage in long and careful consideration.
exampleEnglish: It was a deliberate attempt to mislead us.
exampleKurdish: هەوڵێکی بە ئەنقەست بوو بۆ هەڵخەڵەتاندنی ئێمە.

meaning: وەسفکردن یان کێشانی سنوور بە وردی
definition: Describe or portray (something) precisely; indicate the exact position of (a border or boundary).
definitionEnglish: Describe or portray (something) precisely; indicate the exact position of (a border or boundary).
exampleEnglish: The law clearly delineates the powers of the president.
exampleKurdish: یاساکە بە وردی دەسەڵاتەکانی سەرۆک دیاری دەکات.

meaning: سەرسامی یان شێواوی مێشک (بەهۆی نەخۆشی یان دڵخۆشی زۆرەوە)
definition: An acutely disturbed state of mind that occurs in fever, intoxication, and other disorders and is characterized by restlessness, illusions, and incoherence of thought and speech.
definitionEnglish: An acutely disturbed state of mind that occurs in fever, intoxication, and other disorders and is characterized by restlessness, illusions, and incoherence of thought and speech.
exampleEnglish: He was in a state of delirium due to the high fever.
exampleKurdish: لە دۆخێکی شێواوی مێشکدا بوو بەهۆی تایەکی بەرزەوە.

meaning: دەلتا (شوێنی یەکگرتنی ڕووبار و دەریا)
definition: A triangular tract of sediment deposited at the mouth of a river, typically where it diverges into several outlets.
definitionEnglish: A triangular tract of sediment deposited at the mouth of a river, typically where it diverges into several outlets.
exampleEnglish: The Nile Delta is very fertile.

meaning: هەڵخەڵەتاندن، وادەکات کەسێک بڕوا بە شتێکی ناڕاست بکات
definition: Impose a misleading belief upon (someone); deceive; fool.
definitionEnglish: Impose a misleading belief upon (someone); deceive; fool.
exampleEnglish: Don't delude yourself into thinking he loves you.
exampleKurdish: خۆت هەڵمەخەڵەتێنە بەوەی کە ئەو تۆی خۆشدەوێت.

meaning: لافاو؛ کۆمەڵێکی زۆر لە شتێک (وەک نامە)
definition: A severe flood; a great quantity of something arriving at the same time.
definitionEnglish: A severe flood; a great quantity of something arriving at the same time.
exampleEnglish: The office received a deluge of complaints.
exampleKurdish: ئۆفیسەکە لافاوێک (کۆمەڵێکی زۆر) لە سکاڵای پێگەیشت.

meaning: وەهم، بڕواکردن بە شتێکی ناڕاست سەرەڕای بەڵگەکان
definition: An idiosyncratic belief or impression that is firmly maintained despite being contradicted by what is generally accepted as reality or rational argument, typically a symptom of mental disorder.
definitionEnglish: An idiosyncratic belief or impression that is firmly maintained despite being contradicted by what is generally accepted as reality or rational argument, typically a symptom of mental disorder.
exampleEnglish: He is under the delusion that he is a king.
exampleKurdish: لەژێر ئەو وەهمەدایە کە ئەو پاشایە.

meaning: کۆڵینەوە، گەڕان بەدوای زانیاری ورددا
definition: Reach inside a receptacle and search for something; investigate or research something in order to find out more information.
definitionEnglish: Reach inside a receptacle and search for something; investigate or research something in order to find out more information.
exampleEnglish: We need to delve deeper into the problem.

meaning: سیاسییەک کە هەستی خەڵک دەجوڵێنێت بۆ بەرژەوەندی خۆی
definition: A political leader who seeks support by appealing to the desires and prejudices of ordinary people rather than by using rational argument.
definitionEnglish: A political leader who seeks support by appealing to the desires and prejudices of ordinary people rather than by using rational argument.
exampleEnglish: He was accused of being a demagogue.
exampleKurdish: تۆمەتبار کرا بەوەی کە سیاسییەکی هەستبزوێنە (بۆ بەرژەوەندی خۆی).

meaning: سووکایەتی پێکردن، دابەزاندنی شکۆی کەسێک
definition: Cause a severe loss in the dignity of and respect for (someone or something).
definitionEnglish: Cause a severe loss in the dignity of and respect for (someone or something).
exampleEnglish: I wouldn't demean myself by asking for his help.
exampleKurdish: خۆم سووک ناکەم بە داواکردنی یارمەتی لەو.

meaning: ڕەفتار، شێوازی هەڵسوکەوتی کەسێک
definition: Outward behavior or bearing.
definitionEnglish: Outward behavior or bearing.
exampleEnglish: He has a professional demeanor.

meaning: شێت، کەسێک کە عەقڵی لەدەستداوە یان زۆر تووڕەیە
definition: Suffering from dementia; driven to behave irrationally due to anger, distress, or excitement.
definitionEnglish: Suffering from dementia; driven to behave irrationally due to anger, distress, or excitement.
exampleEnglish: She was demented with worry.
exampleKurdish: لەبەر خەمباری خەریک بوو شێت بێت.

meaning: خاڵی نەرێنی، کەموکوڕی؛ سزای قوتابی
definition: A feature or fact deserving censure; a fault or defect; a mark awarded against someone for a fault or offense.
definitionEnglish: A feature or fact deserving censure; a fault or defect; a mark awarded against someone for a fault or offense.
exampleEnglish: The plan has both merits and demerits.
exampleKurdish: پلانەکە هەم خاڵی ئەرێنی و هەم نەرێنی هەیە.

meaning: مردن؛ کۆتایی هاتنی شتێک (وەک کۆمپانیا یان دەسەڵات)
definition: A person's death; the end or failure of an enterprise or institution.
definitionEnglish: A person's death; the end or failure of an enterprise or institution.
exampleEnglish: The demise of the company was unexpected.

meaning: ڕووخاندن (بۆ باڵەخانە)
definition: The action or process of demolishing or being demolished.

definitionEnglish: Trembling or tottering, typically because of old age.
exampleEnglish: A doddering old man crossed the street.
exampleKurdish: پیاوێکی پیر و لەرزۆک بە جادەکەدا پەڕییەوە.

meaning: داکەندن (بەتایبەت کڵاو وەک ڕێز)

definitionEnglish: Remove (an item of clothing), typically as a greeting or sign of respect.
exampleEnglish: He doffed his hat to the lady.
exampleKurdish: کڵاوەکەی داکەند وەک ڕێزێک بۆ خانمەکە.

meaning: پێداگر، کەسێک کە واز لە ئامانجەکەی ناهێنێت
definition: Having or showing tenacity and grim persistence.
definitionEnglish: Having or showing tenacity and grim persistence.
exampleEnglish: His dogged determination led to success.

meaning: شیعری بێ نرخ و ناڕێک

definitionEnglish: Comic verse composed in irregular rhythm.
exampleEnglish: The book was full of bad doggerel.
exampleKurdish: کتێبەکە پڕ بوو لە شیعری بێ نرخ و ناڕێک.

meaning: سەرسەخت، کەسێک کە بڕوای وایە تەنها خۆی ڕاستە و گوێ لە کەس ناگرێت
definition: Inclined to lay down principles as incontrovertibly true.
definitionEnglish: Inclined to lay down principles as incontrovertibly true.
exampleEnglish: He is very dogmatic about his political views.
exampleKurdish: ئەو زۆر سەرسەختە لەسەر بۆچوونە سیاسییەکانی.

meaning: بێزاری، بارودۆخێکی بێ جوڵە و بێ ئومێدی
definition: A state or period of inactivity, stagnation, or depression.
definitionEnglish: A state or period of inactivity, stagnation, or depression.
exampleEnglish: The economy is in the doldrums.
exampleKurdish: ئابووری لە دۆخێکی بێ جوڵە و سستیدایە.

meaning: خەمناک، پڕ لە پەژارە
definition: Expressing sorrow; mournful.
definitionEnglish: Expressing sorrow; mournful.
exampleEnglish: He had a doleful expression on his face.

meaning: خەمناک، پڕ لە ئازار و خەم
definition: Feeling or expressing great sorrow or distress.
definitionEnglish: Feeling or expressing great sorrow or distress.

meaning: گەمژە، کەسێکی تێنەگەیشتوو
definition: A stupid person.

exampleEnglish: He felt like a dolt for making such a simple mistake.
exampleKurdish: هەستی بە گەمژەیی کرد کە هەڵەیەکی ئاوا سادەی کرد.

definition: The country that a person treats as their permanent home, or lives in and has a substantial connection with.
definitionEnglish: The country that a person treats as their permanent home, or lives in and has a substantial connection with.

exampleKurdish: شوێنی نیشتەجێبوونی فەرمی ئەو لە لەندەنە.

meaning: باڵادەست، بەهێزترین و گرنگترین
definition: Most important, powerful, or influential.
definitionEnglish: Most important, powerful, or influential.
exampleEnglish: The dominant theme of the book is love.
exampleKurdish: بابەتی باڵادەست و سەرەکی کتێبەکە خۆشەویستییە.

definition: Have a commanding influence on; exercise control over.
definitionEnglish: Have a commanding influence on; exercise control over.
exampleEnglish: The company dominates the market.

meaning: خۆسەپاندن، ڕەفتارکردن بە شێوەیەکی توند و کۆنترۆڵکەر

definitionEnglish: Assert one's will over another in an arrogant way.
exampleEnglish: He tried to domineer over his younger siblings.
exampleKurdish: هەوڵیدا خۆی بەسەر خوشک و برا بچووکەکانیدا بسەپێنێت.

meaning: لەبەرکردن (بۆ جل)؛ مامۆستای زانکۆ (بەتایبەت لە ئۆکسفۆرد یان کامبریج)
definition: Put on (an item of clothing); (noun) a university teacher, especially a senior member of a college at Oxford or Cambridge.
definitionEnglish: Put on (an item of clothing); (noun) a university teacher, especially a senior member of a college at Oxford or Cambridge.
exampleEnglish: He donned his coat and left.

meaning: خەوتوو، بێ جوڵە (بۆ ماوەیەکی کاتی)

definitionEnglish: (Of an animal) having normal physical functions suspended or slowed down for a period of time; in or as if in a deep sleep; (of a volcano) temporarily inactive.

exampleKurdish: بورکانەکە بۆ سەدان ساڵە بێ جوڵە و خەوتووە.

meaning: بەشە ناوخۆیی، ژووری خەوتنی بەکۆمەڵ
definition: A large bedroom for a number of people in a school or institution.
definitionEnglish: A large bedroom for a number of people in a school or institution.
exampleEnglish: He lives in a university dormitory.

meaning: پشتی، پەیوەست بە پشتی ئاژەڵ یان مرۆڤ
definition: Of, on, or relating to the upper side or back of an animal, plant, or organ.
definitionEnglish: Of, on, or relating to the upper side or back of an animal, plant, or organ.
exampleEnglish: The shark has a large dorsal fin.

meaning: دۆسیە، کۆمەڵە بەڵگەنامەیەک دەربارەی کەسێک یان بابەتێک

definitionEnglish: A collection of documents about a particular person, event, or subject.

meaning: پیری و پەککەوتەیی مێشک
definition: The period of life in which a person is old and weak.
definitionEnglish: The period of life in which a person is old and weak.
exampleEnglish: He is in his dotage now.
exampleKurdish: ئێستا لە تەمەنی پیری و پەککەوتەییدایە.

meaning: خۆشویستنی زۆر و نازی پێدان (بەتایبەت بۆ منداڵ)
definition: Be extremely and uncritically fond of.
definitionEnglish: Be extremely and uncritically fond of.
exampleEnglish: She dotes on her grandchildren.
exampleKurdish: زۆر نازی نەوەکانی دەگرێت و خۆشی دەوێن.

meaning: سەرسەخت، تووڕە و بێ خەندە
definition: Relentlessly severe, stern, or gloomy in manner or appearance.
definitionEnglish: Relentlessly severe, stern, or gloomy in manner or appearance.
exampleEnglish: He had a dour expression on his face.
exampleKurdish: دەربڕینێکی تووڕە و بێ خەندەی لەسەر ڕووخساری هەبوو.

meaning: تەڕکردن بە ئاو؛ کوژاندنەوەی ئاگر

definitionEnglish: Pour a liquid over; drench; extinguish (a fire or light).

exampleKurdish: کراسێکی کۆن و بێ مۆدێلی لەبەر کردبوو.

definitionEnglish: (Of a person) feeling despondent; (of a person's eyes) looking downwards.

exampleKurdish: دوای هەواڵەکە خەمبار و بێ ئومێد بوو.

meaning: کەوتن، لەدەستدانی دەسەڵات یان ناوبانگ

definitionEnglish: Make (something) appear less important than it really is.

exampleKurdish: حکومەت هەوڵیدا گرنگی قەیرانەکە بە کەم نیشان بدات.

meaning: تەواو، بە ڕەهایی (بۆ شتێکی خراپ)

exampleKurdish: ئەوە درۆیەکی ڕەها و تەواو بوو.

meaning: بچووککردنەوەی کۆمپانیا بە دەرکردنی کارمەندەکان

definitionEnglish: Make (a company or organization) smaller by eliminating staff positions.

exampleKurdish: کۆمپانیاکە پلانی هەیە بۆ بچووککردنەوە و دەرکردنی کارمەند.

meaning: بێ ڕەنگ و بێ تام، شتێکی ناخۆش و بێ جوانی

definitionEnglish: Lacking brightness or interest; drearily dull.
exampleEnglish: The room was painted in a drab gray.
exampleKurdish: ژوورەکە بە ڕەنگێکی خۆڵەمێشی بێ تام و ناخۆش بۆیە کرابوو.

meaning: توند و بێبەزەیی (بۆ یاسا و سزا)

exampleKurdish: ڕێکارە نوێیەکان زۆر توند و بێبەزەییانەن.

meaning: ڕەشنووس؛ (وەک کردار) نووسینی سەرەتایی شتێک

definitionEnglish: A preliminary version of a piece of writing; (verb) prepare a preliminary version of (a text).

meaning: بەتاڵکردنەوەی ئاو؛ ماندووکردنی زۆر؛ (وەک ناو) مەجاری

definitionEnglish: Cause the water or other liquid in (something) to run out, leaving it empty, dry, or relatively dry; deprive of strength or resources.

definitionEnglish: (Of an event or circumstance) sudden and striking.

exampleKurdish: زیادبوونێکی کتوپڕ و گەورە لە نرخەکاندا هەبووە.

meaning: توند، گۆڕانکارییەکی زۆر گەورە و کاریگەر

definitionEnglish: Likely to have a strong or far-reaching effect; radical and extreme.

exampleKurdish: پێویستە ڕێکاری توند و کاریگەر بگرینە بەر.

definitionEnglish: The remnants of a liquid left in a container, together with any sediment or grounds; the most worthless part or parts of something.

meaning: تەڕکردنی زۆر، شتێک کە تەواو تەڕ بووە

definitionEnglish: Wet thoroughly; soak.

meaning: قسەی بێ مانا و بێ نرخ

meaning: نمە نمە باران، بارانێکی زۆر کەم

definitionEnglish: Light rain falling in very fine drops.

exampleKurdish: بەیانییەکی سارد و نمە نمە باران بوو.

exampleKurdish: هەستێکی پێکەنیناوی سەیر و جیاوازی هەیە.

definitionEnglish: A low continuous humming sound; a remote-controlled pilotless aircraft or missile; a person who does no useful work and lives off others.
exampleEnglish: The drone of the engine.

meaning: داکەوتن، شۆڕبوونەوەی شتێک بەهۆی ماندوویی یان بێهێزییەوە
definition: Bend or hang downwards limply.
definitionEnglish: Bend or hang downwards limply.
exampleEnglish: The flowers were starting to droop.
exampleKurdish: گوڵەکان دەستیان کردبوو بە شۆڕبوونەوە و داکەوتن.

meaning: پاشەڕۆ، شتێکی بێ نرخ و بێ سوود

definitionEnglish: Something regarded as worthless; rubbish.

definitionEnglish: Hard menial or dull work.

definitionEnglish: (Of a metal) able to be drawn out into a thin wire; able to be deformed without losing toughness; pliable, not brittle.

exampleKurdish: زێڕ کانزایەکی زۆر نەرم و کێشکرایە.

meaning: تووڕەیی، هەستکردن بە سووکایەتی پێکردن
definition: A feeling of offense or deep resentment.
definitionEnglish: A feeling of offense or deep resentment.

meaning: خۆش و نەرم (بۆ دەنگ)

definitionEnglish: (Especially of sound) sweet and soothing (often used ironically).

meaning: کەسێکی تێنەگەیشتوو و بێزارکەر
definition: A slow or stupid person.

meaning: سەرسامکردن، واکردنی کەسێک کە لە سەرسامیدا قسەی بۆ نەکرێت
definition: Greatly astonish or amaze.

exampleKurdish: هەواڵەکە سەرسامی کردم (وای لێکردم قسەم بۆ نەکرێت).

definition: Deceive; trick; (noun) a victim of deception.
definitionEnglish: Deceive; trick; (noun) a victim of deception.

exampleKurdish: فێڵیان لێکرا بۆ کڕینی تابلۆیەکی ساختە.

meaning: دووڕوویی، فێڵبازی و ناڕاستگۆیی
definition: Deceitfulness; double-dealing.
definitionEnglish: Deceitfulness; double-dealing.

exampleKurdish: تۆمەتبار کرا بە دووڕوویی و فێڵبازی.

meaning: بەهێز و خۆڕاگر، شتێک کە بۆ ماوەیەکی زۆر دەمێنێتەوە
definition: Able to withstand wear, pressure, or damage; hard-wearing.
definitionEnglish: Able to withstand wear, pressure, or damage; hard-wearing.

exampleKurdish: دانپێدانانەکەی لەژێر زۆرەملێ و هەڕەشەدا واژۆ کرد.

definition: Conscientiously or obediently fulfilling one's duty.
definitionEnglish: Conscientiously or obediently fulfilling one's duty.
exampleEnglish: A dutiful son.

meaning: کورتەباڵا؛ (وەک کردار) بچووک نیشاندانی شتێک بەراورد بە شتێکی گەورەتر
definition: A person who is of unusually small stature; (verb) cause to seem small or insignificant in comparison.
definitionEnglish: A person who is of unusually small stature; (verb) cause to seem small or insignificant in comparison.

exampleKurdish: هەورەبڕە نوێیەکە باڵەخانەکانی دەوروبەری بە بچووک نیشان دەدات.

meaning: نیشتەجێ بوون؛ (dwell on) زۆر بیرکردنەوە لە شتێکی ناخۆش
definition: Live in or at a specified place; (dwell on) think or speak at length about (a particular subject, especially one that is a source of unhappiness).
definitionEnglish: Live in or at a specified place; (dwell on) think or speak at length about (a particular subject, especially one that is a source of unhappiness).

exampleKurdish: زۆر بیر لە هەڵەکانت مەکەرەوە (و خۆتی پێوە سەرقاڵ مەکە).

meaning: کەمبوونەوە، بەرەبەرە کەمبوون و نەمان
definition: Diminish gradually in size, amount, or strength.
definitionEnglish: Diminish gradually in size, amount, or strength.
exampleEnglish: Supplies are beginning to dwindle.

meaning: چالاک، پڕ لە وزە و گۆڕانکاری
definition: (Of a process or system) characterized by constant change, activity, or progress; (of a person) positive in attitude and full of energy and new ideas.
definitionEnglish: (Of a process or system) characterized by constant change, activity, or progress; (of a person) positive in attitude and full of energy and new ideas.
exampleEnglish: She is a dynamic leader.
exampleKurdish: ئەو سەرکردەیەکی چالاک و پڕ لە وزەیە.

meaning: خاوەن هەرسێکی خراپ؛ کەسێکی تووڕە و بێزار
definition: Of or having indigestion or consequent irritability or depression.
definitionEnglish: Of or having indigestion or consequent irritability or depression.

exampleKurdish: لە مەزاجێکی تووڕە و بێزاردا بوو.

meaning: جدی، دڵسۆز و ڕاستگۆ لە کارەکەیدا
definition: Resulting from or showing sincere and intense conviction.
definitionEnglish: Resulting from or showing sincere and intense conviction.
exampleEnglish: He is an earnest young man.

meaning: خاکی، سادە و ڕاستەوخۆ؛ پەیوەست بە زەوی
definition: Resembling or suggestive of earth or soil; (of a person) direct and uninhibited.
definitionEnglish: Resembling or suggestive of earth or soil; (of a person) direct and uninhibited.
exampleEnglish: He has an earthy sense of humor.
exampleKurdish: هەستێکی پێکەنیناوی سادە و ڕاستەوخۆی هەیە.

meaning: کشانەوەی ئاوی دەریا؛ کەمبوونەوە و لاوازبوون
definition: (Of tidewater) move away from the coast; recede; gradually lessen or reduce.
definitionEnglish: (Of tidewater) move away from the coast; recede; gradually lessen or reduce.
exampleEnglish: His confidence began to ebb.

meaning: پڕ لە وزە و دڵخۆشی، کەسێک کە زۆر بە جۆش و خرۆشە
definition: Cheerful and full of energy.

meaning: بەخشین، پارەیەک کە بۆ دامەزراوەیەک تەرخان دەکرێت؛ بەهرە
definition: An income or form of property given or bequeathed to someone or an institution; a quality or ability possessed or inherited by someone.
definitionEnglish: An income or form of property given or bequeathed to someone or an institution; a quality or ability possessed or inherited by someone.
exampleEnglish: The university has a large endowment.
exampleKurdish: زانکۆکە بەخشین و سەرمایەیەکی زۆری هەیە.

meaning: پێدان، بەخشینی سیفەت یان دەسەڵات بە کەسێک
definition: Endow or provide with a quality or ability.
definitionEnglish: Endow or provide with a quality or ability.
exampleEnglish: He was endued with great wisdom.

meaning: بەرگەگرتن، توانای خۆڕاگری لە کاتی ناڕەحەتیدا
definition: The fact or power of enduring an unpleasant or difficult process or situation without giving way.
definitionEnglish: The fact or power of enduring an unpleasant or difficult process or situation without giving way.
exampleEnglish: The race is a test of endurance.

meaning: بەرگەگرتن، مانەوە لە دۆخێکی ناخۆشدا؛ بەردەوام بوون
definition: Suffer (something painful or difficult) patiently; remain in existence; last.
definitionEnglish: Suffer (something painful or difficult) patiently; remain in existence; last.
exampleEnglish: She had to endure many hardships.

meaning: پێدانی وزە، چالاککردنی کەسێک یان سیستمێک
definition: Give vitality and enthusiasm to.
definitionEnglish: Give vitality and enthusiasm to.
exampleEnglish: The news energized the campaign.

meaning: بێهێزکردن، ماندووکردنی زۆری کەسێک
definition: Cause (someone) to feel drained of energy or vitality; weaken.
definitionEnglish: Cause (someone) to feel drained of energy or vitality; weaken.
exampleEnglish: The hot weather enervated us.

meaning: پێدانی مافی دەنگدان؛ ئازادکردن
definition: Give the right to vote to.
definitionEnglish: Give the right to vote to.

exampleKurdish: لە ساڵی ١٩٢٠ مافی دەنگدان بە ئافرەتان درا.

meaning: سەرقاڵکردن؛ بەشداری پێکردن؛ مارەکردن؛ (وەک کردار) شەڕکردن
definition: Occupy, attract, or involve (someone's interest or attention); participate or become involved in; establish a meaningful contact or connection with.
definitionEnglish: Occupy, attract, or involve (someone's interest or attention); participate or become involved in; establish a meaningful contact or connection with.
exampleEnglish: He tried to engage her in conversation.

meaning: سەرنجڕاکێش، کەسێک کە زۆر دڵگیر و خۆشە
definition: Charming and attractive.
definitionEnglish: Charming and attractive.
exampleEnglish: He has an engaging personality.

meaning: دروستکردن، بوونە هۆی پەیدابوونی هەست یان بارودۆخێک
definition: Cause or give rise to (a feeling, situation, or condition).
definitionEnglish: Cause or give rise to (a feeling, situation, or condition).

exampleKurdish: بابەتەکە بووە هۆی دروستبوونی مشتومڕێکی زۆر.

meaning: سەرقاڵکردنی تەواو، واکردنی کەسێک کە هەموو سەرنجی لای شتێک بێت
definition: Absorb all the attention or interest of.
definitionEnglish: Absorb all the attention or interest of.
exampleEnglish: He was engrossed in his book.
exampleKurdish: تەواو سەرقاڵی کتێبەکەی ببوو (هەموو سەرنجی لای ئەو بوو).

meaning: قووتدان، داپۆشینی شتێک بە تەواوی (وەک ئاو یان ئاگر)
definition: (Of a natural force) sweep over (something) so as to surround or cover it completely.
definitionEnglish: (Of a natural force) sweep over (something) so as to surround or cover it completely.
exampleEnglish: The flames engulfed the building.

meaning: باشترکردن، زیادکردنی کوالێتی یان جوانی شتێک
definition: Intensify, increase, or further improve the quality, value, or extent of.
definitionEnglish: Intensify, increase, or further improve the quality, value, or extent of.
exampleEnglish: The new lighting will enhance the room.
exampleKurdish: ڕووناکی نوێیەکان ژوورەکە جوانتر و باشتر دەکەن.

meaning: مەتەڵ، شتێک یان کەسێک کە تێگەیشتنی زۆر زەحمەتە
definition: A person or thing that is mysterious, puzzling, or difficult to understand.
definitionEnglish: A person or thing that is mysterious, puzzling, or difficult to understand.
exampleEnglish: His disappearance remains an enigma.
exampleKurdish: ونبوونی ئەو وەک مەتەڵێک و ناڕوونییەک ماوەتەوە.

meaning: ناڕوون، مەتەڵ ئاسا
definition: Difficult to interpret or understand; mysterious.
definitionEnglish: Difficult to interpret or understand; mysterious.
exampleEnglish: He gave an enigmatic smile.
exampleKurdish: زەردەخەنەیەکی ناڕوون و مەتەڵ ئاسای کرد.

meaning: فەرمانکردن؛ ڕێگری لێکردن (بە فەرمانی دادگا)
definition: Instruct or urge (someone) to do something; (law) prohibit someone from performing (a particular action) by issuing an injunction.
definitionEnglish: Instruct or urge (someone) to do something; (law) prohibit someone from performing (a particular action) by issuing an injunction.

exampleKurdish: دادوەرەکە ڕێگری لێکردن لە فرۆشتنی موڵکەکە.

meaning: ڕۆشنبیرکردن، پێدانی زانیاری و تێگەیشتنی زیاتر بە کەسێک
definition: Give (someone) greater knowledge and understanding about a subject or situation.
definitionEnglish: Give (someone) greater knowledge and understanding about a subject or situation.
exampleEnglish: Could you enlighten me on the current situation?
exampleKurdish: دەتوانی زانیاریم پێ بدەیت دەربارەی بارودۆخی ئێستا؟

meaning: ناونووسین (لە سوپا)؛ بەدەستهێنانی یارمەتی کەسێک
definition: Enrol or be enrolled in the armed services; engage (a person or their help or support).
definitionEnglish: Enrol or be enrolled in the armed services; engage (a person or their help or support).

exampleKurdish: بڕیاریدا لە سوپادا ناوی خۆی بنووسێت.

meaning: جۆش و خرۆش پێدان، خۆشکردنی دۆخێک
definition: Make (something) more entertaining, interesting, or appealing.
definitionEnglish: Make (something) more entertaining, interesting, or appealing.
exampleEnglish: The music helped to enliven the party.
exampleKurdish: مۆسیقاکە یارمەتیدەر بوو بۆ خۆشکردنی ئاهەنگەکە.

meaning: تێوەگلان، گیرخواردن لە ناو کێشەیەکدا
definition: Involve (someone) in a difficult or complicated situation from which it is hard to escape.
definitionEnglish: Involve (someone) in a difficult or complicated situation from which it is hard to escape.

exampleKurdish: لە ناو تۆڕێک لە درۆدا گیرسابوو.

meaning: دوژمنایەتی، ڕق و کینەیەکی زۆر

definitionEnglish: The state or feeling of being actively opposed or hostile to someone or something.
exampleEnglish: There is a long history of enmity between the two families.
exampleKurdish: مێژوویەکی درێژی دوژمنایەتی لە نێوان هەردوو خێزانەکەدا هەیە.

meaning: بێزاری، هەستکردن بە بێ تامی ژیان بەهۆی نەبوونی کار و سەرنج
definition: A feeling of listlessness and dissatisfaction arising from a lack of occupation or excitement.
definitionEnglish: A feeling of listlessness and dissatisfaction arising from a lack of occupation or excitement.
exampleEnglish: He suffered from a sense of ennui.
exampleKurdish: بەدەست هەستێکی بێزاری و بێ تامی ژیانەوە دەیناڵاند.

meaning: گەورەیی و ترسناکی (بۆ تاوان یان کارەسات)؛ قەبارەیەکی زۆر گەورە
definition: The great or extreme scale, seriousness, or extent of something perceived as bad or morally wrong; a grave crime or sin.
definitionEnglish: The great or extreme scale, seriousness, or extent of something perceived as bad or morally wrong; a grave crime or sin.

exampleKurdish: گەورەیی و ترسناکی تاوانەکە نەتەوەکەی هەژاند.

meaning: زۆر گەورە، یەکجار زۆر
definition: Very large in size, quantity, or extent.
definitionEnglish: Very large in size, quantity, or extent.

exampleKurdish: بڕی ئەو پارەیەی تێدابوو یەکجار زۆر بوو.

meaning: سەرسامکردن و دڵخۆشکردنی زۆر
definition: Give intense pleasure or joy to.
definitionEnglish: Give intense pleasure or joy to.

exampleKurdish: جەماوەرەکە بە گۆرانییەکەی ئەو سەرسام و دڵخۆش بوون.

meaning: دەوڵەمەندکردن؛ باشترکردنی کوالێتی شتێک

exampleKurdish: ئەزموونەکە ژیانی ئەوی دەوڵەمەندتر و باشتر کرد.

definitionEnglish: Officially register as a member of an institution or a student on a course.

exampleKurdish: بڕیاریدا لە پۆلێکی چێشتلێنان ناوی خۆی بنووسێت.

meaning: جێگیربوون لە شوێنێکی ئارام و پارێزراو

definitionEnglish: Establish or settle (someone) in a comfortable, safe, or secret place.

exampleKurdish: لە سەر کورسییەکی ئارام و دەستەداردا جێگیر ببوو.

meaning: کۆمەڵە، گروپێکی مۆسیقا یان نواندن؛ کۆمەڵە جلوبەرگێک کە پێکەوە دەگونجێن
definition: A group of musicians, actors, or dancers who perform together; a group of items viewed as a whole rather than individually; a coordinated outfit.
definitionEnglish: A group of musicians, actors, or dancers who perform together; a group of items viewed as a whole rather than individually; a coordinated outfit.
exampleEnglish: The string ensemble played beautifully.
exampleKurdish: گروپە مۆسیقا ژێدارەکە بە جوانی ژەنییان.

meaning: پاراستن و ڕێزگرتن وەک شتێکی پیرۆز (بەتایبەت لە یاسادا)
definition: Place (a revered or precious object) in an appropriate receptacle; preserve (a right, tradition, or idea) in a form that ensures it will be protected and respected.
definitionEnglish: Place (a revered or precious object) in an appropriate receptacle; preserve (a right, tradition, or idea) in a form that ensures it will be protected and respected.

exampleKurdish: مافی ئازادی ڕادەربڕین لە دەستووردا پارێزراوە و جێگیر کراوە.

meaning: داپۆشین، شاردنەوەی شتێک بە تەواوی (وەک تەم)

definitionEnglish: Envelop in a shroud; hide from view.

definitionEnglish: Make (someone) a slave.

definitionEnglish: Catch in or as if in a trap.

meaning: دوای ئەوە ڕوودان، ئەنجامێک کە بەدوای شتێکدا دێت

exampleKurdish: قاچەکانی باڵندەکە لە ناو تۆڕەکەدا ئاڵۆز ببوو و گیرسابوو.

definitionEnglish: A project or undertaking, typically one that is difficult or requires effort; a business or company; initiative and resourcefulness.

definition: Having or showing initiative and resourcefulness.

exampleEnglish: The audience was enthralled by the performance.

definition: Attract or tempt by offering pleasure or advantage.
definitionEnglish: Attract or tempt by offering pleasure or advantage.

meaning: تەواوی، هەموو بەشەکانی شتێک
definition: The whole of something.
definitionEnglish: The whole of something.
exampleEnglish: The project was completed in its entirety.
exampleKurdish: پڕۆژەکە بە تەواوی و بە هەموو بەشەکانییەوە تەواو کرا.

definition: A thing with distinct and independent existence.
definitionEnglish: A thing with distinct and independent existence.
exampleEnglish: The two companies are separate legal entities.
exampleKurdish: هەردوو کۆمپانیاکە دوو بوونی یاسایی جیاوازن.

meaning: ناشتن، خستنە ناو گۆڕ یان شوێنێکی داخراو
definition: Place (a dead body) in a tomb; bury or trap in or under something.
definitionEnglish: Place (a dead body) in a tomb; bury or trap in or under something.
exampleEnglish: The miners were entombed underground.
exampleKurdish: کانگاکەرەکان لەژێر زەویدا گیرسابوون و وەک ئەوەی نێژرابن وابوون.

meaning: مێرووناسی، زانستی لێکۆڵینەوە لە مێرووەکان
definition: The branch of zoology concerned with the study of insects.
definitionEnglish: The branch of zoology concerned with the study of insects.
exampleEnglish: He is an expert in entomology.

meaning: یاوەران، کۆمەڵە کەسێک کە لەگەڵ کەسایەتییەکی گرنگ دەڕۆن
definition: A group of people attending or surrounding an important person.
definitionEnglish: A group of people attending or surrounding an important person.
exampleEnglish: The president arrived with a large entourage.

meaning: دەروازە؛ (وەک کردار - /ɪnˈtrɑːns/) سەرسامکردن و ڕاکێشانی سەرنج
definition: An opening, such as a door, passage, or gate, that allows access to a place; (verb) fill (someone) with wonder and delight, holding their entire attention.
definitionEnglish: An opening, such as a door, passage, or gate, that allows access to a place; (verb) fill (someone) with wonder and delight, holding their entire attention.

meaning: خستنە داوەوە، فێڵ لێکردن بۆ ئەنجامدانی کارێکی خراپ
definition: Catch in or as if in a trap; trick (someone) into committing a crime in order to secure their prosecution.
definitionEnglish: Catch in or as if in a trap; trick (someone) into committing a crime in order to secure their prosecution.

definition: Ask someone earnestly or anxiously to do something.

exampleKurdish: لێت دەپاڕێمەوە کە دووبارە بیر لە بڕیارەکەت بکەیتەوە.

definition: An earnest or humble request.
definitionEnglish: An earnest or humble request.
exampleEnglish: She ignored his entreaties.

meaning: سپاردن، پێدانی بەرپرسیارێتی یان شتێکی گرنگ بە کەسێک
definition: Assign the responsibility for doing something to (someone); put (something) into someone's care or protection.
definitionEnglish: Assign the responsibility for doing something to (someone); put (something) into someone's care or protection.
exampleEnglish: I entrusted him with the keys to the house.

meaning: ژماردن، یەک یەک ناوبردنی شتەکان لە لیستێکدا
definition: Mention (a number of things) one by one.
definitionEnglish: Mention (a number of things) one by one.
exampleEnglish: He enumerated the benefits of the new system.
exampleKurdish: سوودەکانی سیستمە نوێیەکەی یەک یەک ژمارد.

meaning: دەربڕین بە ڕوونی؛ ڕاگەیاندنی بیرۆکەیەک بە فەرمی
definition: Say or pronounce clearly; state clearly and unusedly.
definitionEnglish: Say or pronounce clearly; state clearly and unusedly.
exampleEnglish: She enunciated each word carefully.
exampleKurdish: هەموو وشەکانی بە وریایی و ڕوونی دەربڕی.

meaning: داپۆشین، دەورەدانی شتێک بە تەواوی
definition: Wrap up, cover, or surround completely.
definitionEnglish: Wrap up, cover, or surround completely.
exampleEnglish: The house was enveloped in flames.

meaning: ژەهراویکردن؛ تێکدانی پەیوەندی بە ڕق و کینە

exampleKurdish: کێشەکە پەیوەندییەکەیانی ژەهراوی و تاڵ کرد.

meaning: جێگەی ئیرەیی، شتێک کە زۆر باشە و خەڵک حەزی پێ دەکەن
definition: Likely to excite envy.
definitionEnglish: Likely to excite envy.
exampleEnglish: He is in an enviable position.
exampleKurdish: لە پێگەیەکی باشدایە کە جێگەی ئیرەیی خەڵکە.

meaning: ئیرەیی بەر، کەسێک کە حەز بە سەرکەوتنی خەڵک ناکات
definition: Feeling or showing envy.
definitionEnglish: Feeling or showing envy.
exampleEnglish: She was envious of her friend's success.

meaning: دەورەدان، گەمارۆدان
definition: Surround; enclose.
definitionEnglish: Surround; enclose.

exampleKurdish: قەڵاکە بە خەندەقێکی قووڵ دەورە دراوە.

meaning: وێناکردن، بیرکردنەوە لە شتێک وەک ئەگەرێک بۆ داهاتوو
definition: Imagine as a future possibility; visualize.

exampleKurdish: وێنای داهاتوویەکی دەکرد کە هەمووان تێیدا یەکسان بن.

definition: A messenger or representative, especially one on a diplomatic mission.
definitionEnglish: A messenger or representative, especially one on a diplomatic mission.

exampleKurdish: نێردراوی نەتەوە یەکگرتووەکان گەیشت بۆ گفتوگۆکردن لەسەر پلانی ئاشتی.

meaning: سەردەمێکی زۆر درێژ، کاتێکی بێ کۆتایی
definition: An indefinite and very long period of time.

exampleEnglish: Women were excluded from the club.

meaning: دوورخستنەوە، کرداری بێبەشکردنی کەسێک
definition: The process or state of excluding or being excluded.
definitionEnglish: The process or state of excluding or being excluded.
exampleEnglish: The exclusion of certain groups from the study.
exampleKurdish: دوورخستنەوەی هەندێک گروپی دیاریکراو لە توێژینەوەکە.

meaning: تایبەت، شتێک کە تەنها بۆ کۆمەڵەیەکی دیاریکراوە؛ گشتگیر نییە
definition: Excluding or not admitting other things; restricted or limited to the person, group, or area concerned.
definitionEnglish: Excluding or not admitting other things; restricted or limited to the person, group, or area concerned.
exampleEnglish: An exclusive interview.
exampleKurdish: چاوپێکەوتنێکی تایبەت (کە تەنها یەک لایەن هەیەتی).

meaning: دەرکردن لە ئایین، بێبەشکردن لە ئەندامێتی کەنیسە
definition: Officially exclude (someone) from participation in the sacraments and services of the Christian Church.
definitionEnglish: Officially exclude (someone) from participation in the sacraments and services of the Christian Church.
exampleEnglish: He was excommunicated for his beliefs.

meaning: ڕەخنەی توند گرتن؛ پێست لێکردنەوە
definition: Censure or criticize severely; damage or remove part of the surface of (the skin).
definitionEnglish: Censure or criticize severely; damage or remove part of the surface of (the skin).
exampleEnglish: The papers excoriated the government for its failure.
exampleKurdish: ڕۆژنامەکان ڕەخنەی توندیان لە حکومەت گرت بۆ شکستەکەی.

meaning: پاشەڕۆ، پیسایی مرۆڤ یان ئاژەڵ
definition: Waste matter discharged from the body, especially feces.
definitionEnglish: Waste matter discharged from the body, especially feces.
exampleEnglish: Animal excrement.

meaning: زیادە، شتێک کە بە شێوەیەکی نائاسایی لەسەر شتێک دەڕوێت
definition: A distinct outgrowth on a human or animal body or on a plant, especially one that is the result of disease or abnormality.
definitionEnglish: A distinct outgrowth on a human or animal body or on a plant, especially one that is the result of disease or abnormality.
exampleEnglish: The building is an ugly excrescence on the landscape.
exampleKurdish: باڵەخانەکە زیادەیەکی ناشرینە لەسەر دیمەنی سروشتەکە.

meaning: پاشەڕۆ، هەموو ئەو شتانەی لە جەستە دەردەچن (وەک ئارەق و پیسایی)
definition: Waste matter discharged from the body, especially feces and urine.
definitionEnglish: Waste matter discharged from the body, especially feces and urine.
exampleEnglish: The proper disposal of excreta.

meaning: دەرکردنی پاشەڕۆ لە جەستە
definition: (Of a living organism or cell) separate and expel as waste (a substance, especially a product of metabolism).
definitionEnglish: (Of a living organism or cell) separate and expel as waste (a substance, especially a product of metabolism).
exampleEnglish: The kidneys excrete waste products.

meaning: پاشەڕۆ فڕێدان، کرداری دەرکردنی پاشەڕۆ لە جەستە
definition: The process of eliminating or expelling waste matter.
definitionEnglish: The process of eliminating or expelling waste matter.
exampleEnglish: The excretion of toxins.

meaning: بێتاوانکردن، سەلماندنی ئەوەی کە کەسێک تاوانبار نییە
definition: Show or declare that (someone) is not guilty of wrongdoing.
definitionEnglish: Show or declare that (someone) is not guilty of wrongdoing.
exampleEnglish: New evidence exculpated him.

meaning: گەشتێکی کورت بۆ خۆشی؛ لادان لە بابەتێکی سەرەکی
definition: A short journey or trip, especially one engaged in as a leisure activity; a deviation from a regular pattern, path, or level of operation.
definitionEnglish: A short journey or trip, especially one engaged in as a leisure activity; a deviation from a regular pattern, path, or level of operation.
exampleEnglish: A day excursion to the seaside.

meaning: شایەنی لێخۆشبوون، هەڵەیەک کە دەکرێت چاوپۆشی لێ بکرێت
definition: Able to be justified or forgiven; pardonable.
definitionEnglish: Able to be justified or forgiven; pardonable.
exampleEnglish: An excusable mistake.

meaning: زۆر خراپ، شتێک کە جێگەی قێزەونە
definition: Extremely bad or unpleasant.
definitionEnglish: Extremely bad or unpleasant.
exampleEnglish: Execrable weather.

meaning: نەفرەت لێکردن، دەربڕینی ڕقێکی زۆر بۆ شتێک
definition: Feel or express great loathing for.
definitionEnglish: Feel or express great loathing for.
exampleEnglish: They were execrated as traitors.

meaning: جێبەجێکردن؛ لەسێدارەدان
definition: Carry out or put into effect (a plan, order, or course of action); carry out a sentence of death on (a legally condemned person).
definitionEnglish: Carry out or put into effect (a plan, order, or course of action); carry out a sentence of death on (a legally condemned person).
exampleEnglish: The plan was executed perfectly.

meaning: جێبەجێکردن؛ لەسێدارەدان؛ شێوازی ئەنجامدانی کارێک
definition: The carrying out or putting into effect of a plan, order, or course of action; the carrying out of a sentence of death on a condemned person.
definitionEnglish: The carrying out or putting into effect of a plan, order, or course of action; the carrying out of a sentence of death on a condemned person.
exampleEnglish: The execution of the project.

meaning: بەڕێوەبەر، کەسێک کە دەسەڵاتی بڕیاردانی هەیە؛ دەسەڵاتی جێبەجێکردن
definition: A person with senior managerial responsibility in a business organization; relating to the power of putting plans, actions, or laws into effect.
definitionEnglish: A person with senior managerial responsibility in a business organization; relating to the power of putting plans, actions, or laws into effect.
exampleEnglish: A chief executive officer.

meaning: وەسیەت جێبەجێکار، کەسێک کە بەرپرسە لە جێبەجێکردنی وەسیەتی مردوو
definition: A person or institution appointed by a testator to carry out the terms of their will.
definitionEnglish: A person or institution appointed by a testator to carry out the terms of their will.
exampleEnglish: She was named as the executor of his estate.
exampleKurdish: وەک جێبەجێکاری وەسیەتی موڵک و ماڵەکەی ئەو دیاری کرا.

meaning: نموونە، شتێک کە وەک باشترین نموونە بۆ چاولێکەری دادەنرێت
definition: A person or thing serving as a typical example or excellent model.
definitionEnglish: A person or thing serving as a typical example or excellent model.
exampleEnglish: He is an exemplar of courage.

meaning: نموونەیی، زۆر باش کە شایەنی ئەوەیە خەڵک چاوی لێ بکەن
definition: Serving as a desirable model; representing the best of its kind.
definitionEnglish: Serving as a desirable model; representing the best of its kind.
exampleEnglish: His behavior was exemplary.

meaning: نیشاندان بە نموونە، بەرجەستەکردنی سیفەتێک
definition: Be a typical example of.
definitionEnglish: Be a typical example of.
exampleEnglish: This painting exemplifies the artist's style.
exampleKurdish: ئەم تابلۆیە شێوازی هونەرمەندەکە نیشان دەدات.

meaning: بەدەرکراو، کەسێک کە ناچار نییە کارێک بکات یان باج بدات
definition: Free from an obligation or liability imposed on others.
definitionEnglish: Free from an obligation or liability imposed on others.
exampleEnglish: Small businesses are exempt from the tax.

meaning: بەدەرکردن، مافی ئەنجامنەدانی کارێک یان نەدانی باج
definition: The process of freeing or state of being free from an obligation or liability imposed on others.
definitionEnglish: The process of freeing or state of being free from an obligation or liability imposed on others.
exampleEnglish: Tax exemption.

meaning: وەرزش؛ بەکارهێنانی دەسەڵات یان ماف؛ ڕاهێنان
definition: Activity requiring physical effort, carried out to sustain or improve health and fitness; use or apply (a faculty, right, or process).
definitionEnglish: Activity requiring physical effort, carried out to sustain or improve health and fitness; use or apply (a faculty, right, or process).
exampleEnglish: He exercises every morning.

meaning: بەکارهێنان (بۆ هێز یان کاریگەری)؛ ماندووکردنی خۆی بۆ کارێک
definition: Apply or bring to bear (a force, influence, or quality); make a physical or mental effort.
definitionEnglish: Apply or bring to bear (a force, influence, or quality); make a physical or mental effort.
exampleEnglish: He exerted all his influence to get the job.
exampleKurdish: هەموو کاریگەری خۆی بەکارهێنا بۆ بەدەستهێنانی کارەکە.

meaning: هەوڵدان، بەکارهێنانی هێزی جەستەیی یان مێشکی
definition: Physical or mental effort.
definitionEnglish: Physical or mental effort.
exampleEnglish: The exertion of climbing the mountain.

meaning: هەناسەدانەوە، دەرکردنی هەوا لە سییەکانەوە
definition: Breathe out in a deliberate manner.
definitionEnglish: Breathe out in a deliberate manner.
exampleEnglish: He exhaled a cloud of smoke.

meaning: ماندووکردنی زۆر؛ تەواوکردنی هەموو بڕێک؛ دووکەڵی ئۆتۆمبێل
definition: Drain (someone) of their physical or mental resources; use up (resources or reserves) completely; waste gases expelled from an engine.
definitionEnglish: Drain (someone) of their physical or mental resources; use up (resources or reserves) completely; waste gases expelled from an engine.
exampleEnglish: The long journey exhausted her.
exampleKurdish: گەشتە درێژەکە ئەوی زۆر ماندوو کرد.

meaning: ماندووبوونی زۆر، نەمانی وزە بە تەواوی
definition: A state of extreme physical or mental fatigue.
definitionEnglish: A state of extreme physical or mental fatigue.
