definitionEnglish: Examining, including, or considering all elements or aspects; fully comprehensive.
exampleEnglish: An exhaustive search of the building.
exampleKurdish: گەڕانێکی ورد و گشتگیر لە باڵەخانەکەدا.

meaning: نیشاندان، خستنەڕووی شتێک لە مۆزەخانە یان پێشانگا
definition: Publicly display (a work of art or item of interest) in an art gallery or museum or at a trade fair.
definitionEnglish: Publicly display (a work of art or item of interest) in an art gallery or museum or at a trade fair.

meaning: پێشانگا، نیشاندانی گشتی شتەکان
definition: A public display of works of art or items of help, held in an art gallery or museum or at a trade fair.
definitionEnglish: A public display of works of art or items of help, held in an art gallery or museum or at a trade fair.
exampleEnglish: An exhibition of modern art.

meaning: دڵخۆشکردن، واکردنی کەسێک کە هەست بە وزە و شادییەکی زۆر بکات
definition: Make (someone) feel very happy, animated, or elated.
definitionEnglish: Make (someone) feel very happy, animated, or elated.
exampleEnglish: The fresh air exhilarated them.
exampleKurdish: هەوا پاکەکە ئەوانی دڵخۆش و پڕ وزە کرد.

meaning: شادییەکی زۆر، هەستکردن بە وزە و خۆشییەکی بێ وێنە
definition: A feeling of excitement, happiness, or elation.
definitionEnglish: A feeling of excitement, happiness, or elation.
exampleEnglish: The exhilaration of speed.

meaning: هاندان، داواکردن لە کەسێک بە جدی بۆ ئەنجامدانی کارێک
definition: Strongly encourage or urge (someone) to do something.
definitionEnglish: Strongly encourage or urge (someone) to do something.
exampleEnglish: The general exhorted his troops to fight bravely.
exampleKurdish: ژەنەڕاڵەکە هانی سەربازەکانی دا کە بە بوێری شەڕ بکەن.

meaning: دەرهێنانەوەی تەرم لە گۆڕ (بۆ لێکۆڵینەوە)

definitionEnglish: Dig out (something buried, especially a corpse) from the ground.
exampleEnglish: The body was exhumed for an autopsy.

meaning: پێویستی بەپەلە، بارودۆخێک کە پێویستی بە چارەسەری خێرا هەیە
definition: An urgent need or demand.
definitionEnglish: An urgent need or demand.
exampleEnglish: The exigencies of the war.

meaning: کەم، زۆر بچووک یان کەم لە بڕدا
definition: Very small in size or amount.
definitionEnglish: Very small in size or amount.

meaning: دوورخستنەوە، دەرکردنی کەسێک لە نیشتمانەکەی خۆی

exampleKurdish: بۆ چەندین ساڵ لە دوورخستنەوەدا ژیا.

meaning: بوون، هەبوون
definition: Have objective reality or being.
definitionEnglish: Have objective reality or being.
exampleEnglish: Does life exist on other planets?
exampleKurdish: ئایا ژیان لەسەر هەسارەکانی تر هەیە؟

meaning: بوون، ژیان
definition: The fact or state of living or having objective reality.
definitionEnglish: The fact or state of living or having objective reality.
exampleEnglish: The existence of God.

meaning: هەبوو، شتێک کە ئێستا بوونی هەیە
definition: Having existence, in being or actuality.
definitionEnglish: Having existence, in being or actuality.
exampleEnglish: The only existent copy of the manuscript.

meaning: بوونی، پەیوەست بە بوونی مرۆڤ و ژیان
definition: Relating to existence.

meaning: دەرچوون، دەروازەی چوونە دەرەوە

definitionEnglish: A way out, especially of a public building, room, or vehicle.
exampleEnglish: The emergency exit.

exampleKurdish: کۆچی بەکۆمەڵی پەنابەران لە ناوچەی جەنگەکە.

meaning: بێتاوانکردن، لادانی تۆمەت لەسەر کەسێک
definition: Absolve (someone) from blame for a fault or wrongdoing, especially after due consideration of the case.
definitionEnglish: Absolve (someone) from blame for a fault or wrongdoing, especially after due consideration of the case.

exampleKurdish: ڕاپۆرتەکە تاقمەکەی لە هەموو بەرپرسیارێتییەک لە پێکدادانەکە بێتاوان کرد.

meaning: زۆر گران، نرخێک کە زۆر لە ڕادەبەدەرە
definition: (Of a price or amount charged) unreasonably high.
definitionEnglish: (Of a price or amount charged) unreasonably high.
exampleEnglish: The prices are exorbitant.
exampleKurdish: نرخەکان یەکجار گران و لە ڕادەبەدەرن.

meaning: دەرکردنی جنۆکە؛ ڕزگاربوون لە یادەوەرییەکی ناخۆش
definition: Drive out an evil spirit from (a person or place).

exampleKurdish: هەوڵیدا لە خێوەکانی ڕابردوو ڕزگاری بێت.

exampleKurdish: کۆمپانیاکە هەوڵ دەدات کارەکانی فراوانتر بکات.

meaning: ڕووبەرێکی فراوان و کراوە (وەک دەریا یان ئاسمان)
definition: An area of something, typically land or sea, presenting a wide continuous surface.
definitionEnglish: An area of something, typically land or sea, presenting a wide continuous surface.
exampleEnglish: The vast expanse of the ocean.

meaning: فراوانبوون، گەشەکردن لە قەبارە یان بڕدا
definition: The action of becoming larger or more extensive.
definitionEnglish: The action of becoming larger or more extensive.
exampleEnglish: The expansion of the city.

meaning: فراوان؛ کەسێک کە زۆر قسە دەکات و دڵاوایە
definition: Covering a wide area in terms of space or scope; (of a person or their manner) relaxed and genially frank and communicative.
definitionEnglish: Covering a wide area in terms of space or scope; (of a person or their manner) relaxed and genially frank and communicative.
exampleEnglish: An expansive view.

meaning: درێژدادڕی کردن، قسەکردن یان نووسین بە درێژی دەربارەی بابەتێک
definition: Speak or write at length or in detail about a subject.
definitionEnglish: Speak or write at length or in detail about a subject.
exampleEnglish: He expatiated on the importance of education.
exampleKurdish: بە درێژی باسی گرنگی پەروەردەی کرد.

meaning: کۆچبەر، کەسێک کە لە دەرەوەی وڵاتی خۆی دەژی
definition: A person who lives outside their native country.
definitionEnglish: A person who lives outside their native country.
exampleEnglish: American expatriates in Paris.

meaning: چاوەڕوانکردن، پێشبینیکردنی ڕوودانی شتێک
definition: Regard (something) as likely to happen.
definitionEnglish: Regard (something) as likely to happen.
exampleEnglish: I expect him to arrive soon.

meaning: چاوەڕوانی، هەستی چاوەڕێکردنی شتێک کە ڕوودەدات
definition: The state of thinking or hoping that something, especially something pleasant, will happen.
definitionEnglish: The state of thinking or hoping that something, especially something pleasant, will happen.
exampleEnglish: Life expectancy.

meaning: گونجاو بۆ سوودی کاتی، چارەسەرێکی خێرا بەڵام ڕەنگە نائەخلاقی بێت
definition: (Of an action) convenient and practical although possibly improper or immoral.

exampleKurdish: لە ڕووی سیاسییەوە گونجاو بوو بۆ بەرژەوەندی کاتی کە پشتگیری لە پلانەکە بکرێت.

meaning: خێراکردن، ئاسانکاری بۆ ئەوەی کارێک زووتر تەواو بێت
definition: Make (an action or process) happen sooner or be accomplished more quickly.
definitionEnglish: Make (an action or process) happen sooner or be accomplished more quickly.
exampleEnglish: We need to expedite the delivery process.

meaning: گەشتێکی گەڕان یان زانستی؛ خێرایی لە کاردا
definition: A journey undertaken by a group of people with a particular purpose, especially that of exploration, research, or war; promptness or speed in doing something.
definitionEnglish: A journey undertaken by a group of people with a particular purpose, especially that of exploration, research, or war; promptness or speed in doing something.
exampleEnglish: An expedition to the North Pole.

meaning: خێرا و لێهاتوو، کارێک کە بە خێرایی و بە باشی ئەنجام دەدرێت
definition: Done with speed and efficiency.
definitionEnglish: Done with speed and efficiency.
exampleEnglish: An expeditious investigation.

meaning: دەرکردن، بێبەشکردن لە قوتابخانە یان وڵات
definition: Deprive (someone) of membership of or involvement in a school or other organization; force out or eject (something), especially from the body.
definitionEnglish: Deprive (someone) of membership of or involvement in a school or other organization; force out or eject (something), especially from the body.
exampleEnglish: He was expelled from school for fighting.

meaning: خەرجکردن، بەکارهێنانی کات یان پارە یان وزە
definition: Spend or use up (a resource such as money, time, or energy).
definitionEnglish: Spend or use up (a resource such as money, time, or energy).
exampleEnglish: They expend a lot of energy on this project.
exampleKurdish: وزەیەکی زۆر لەم پڕۆژەیەدا خەرج دەکەن.

meaning: فڕێدراو، شتێک کە دەکرێت وازی لێ بهێنرێت یان لەناو ببرێت بۆ گەیشتن بە ئامانجێک
definition: Of little significance when compared to an overall purpose, and therefore able to be abandoned or destroyed.
definitionEnglish: Of little significance when compared to an overall purpose, and therefore able to be abandoned or destroyed.
exampleEnglish: Expendable supplies.
exampleKurdish: پێداویستییە فڕێدراوەکان (کە دەکرێت وازیان لێ بهێنرێت).

meaning: خەرجی، بڕی ئەو پارەیەی خەرج کراوە
definition: An amount of money spent.
definitionEnglish: An amount of money spent.
exampleEnglish: Government expenditure on education.

meaning: تێچوو، خەرجی
definition: The cost required for something; the money spent on something.
definitionEnglish: The cost required for something; the money spent on something.
exampleEnglish: Travel expenses.

meaning: گران، شتێک کە تێچووی زۆرە
definition: Costing a lot of money.
definitionEnglish: Costing a lot of money.
exampleEnglish: An expensive car.

meaning: ئەزموون، شارەزایی بەدەستهاتوو لە ڕێگەی کارکردن یان ژیانەوە
definition: Practical contact with and observation of facts or events; knowledge or skill acquired by a period of practical experience of something.
definitionEnglish: Practical contact with and observation of facts or events; knowledge or skill acquired by a period of practical experience of something.
exampleEnglish: She has a lot of experience in teaching.

meaning: بە ئەزموون، شارەزا
definition: Having knowledge or skill in a particular field, especially a profession or job, gained over a period of time.
definitionEnglish: Having knowledge or skill in a particular field, especially a profession or job, gained over a period of time.
exampleEnglish: An experienced doctor.

meaning: تاقیکردنەوە، لێکۆڵینەوەی زانستی بۆ دۆزینەوەی ڕاستییەک
definition: A scientific procedure undertaken to make a discovery, test a hypothesis, or demonstrate a known fact.
definitionEnglish: A scientific procedure undertaken to make a discovery, test a hypothesis, or demonstrate a known fact.
